VISTA achieves the strongest average performance among the evaluated active multimodal agents of comparable size and consistently outperforms same-backbone training baselines across fine-grained perception and general reasoning tasks, demonstrating the value of collective experience for active multimodal learning.

</details>


### [219] [Self-Aligned Forcing: Streaming Video Diffusion with Differentiable Noisy History](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38114)
*Weiqiang Wang,Zhuokun Chen,Yusheng Dai,Boying Li,Yi Zhang,Hossein Rahmani,Qiuhong Ke,Jianfei Cai*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 Self-Aligned Forcing (SAF) 训练方案，通过让历史 K/V 与当前去噪块的噪声水平对齐，并保留历史梯度，解决自回归视频扩散的长时程误差累积问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自回归视频扩散可支持交互式流式生成，但长 rollout 中误差会累积。自 rollout 训练虽能缓解曝光偏差，但有限 rollout 无法解决长程漂移。作者观察到历史 K/V 的噪声水平在视觉质量与运动之间权衡，且恢复历史梯度能让因果训练更接近双向训练。

Method: SAF 将每个块的历史（即同一去噪阶段前序块产生的 K/V）与被去噪块的噪声水平对齐。同一阶段所有块可在单次前向中于因果掩码下去噪，使噪声历史保持可微，未来损失可优化其编码。由此避免单独的无梯度 rollout 与逐块 timestep-zero 重缓存。

Result: 训练速度比先前方法快达 1.8 倍且内存更低；推理时单 GPU 吞吐最高，多 GPU 流水线每阶段保留一个 history bank，4 GPU 下达 49.1 FPS；长时程生成表现更优，视觉质量与运动平衡更好。

Conclusion: SAF 通过噪声对齐且可微的历史 K/V，实现更高效、更接近双向训练的因果自回归视频扩散，兼顾训练效率、推理吞吐与长时程生成质量。

Abstract: Autoregressive video diffusion enables interactive streaming generation, but suffers from error accumulation over long rollouts. Self-rollout training reduces exposure bias, yet finite rollouts leave long-range drift unresolved. We observe that the noise level of the history key-value (K/V) representations trades visual quality against motion, and that restoring gradients through the history aligns causal training far more closely with bidirectional training. Motivated by these observations, we introduce Self-Aligned Forcing (SAF), a training scheme that aligns the history of each block with the noise level of the block being denoised. Specifically, the history is the K/V produced by preceding blocks at the same denoising stage, so all blocks at a stage can be denoised in a single forward pass under a causal mask. This keeps the noisy history differentiable, allowing future losses to optimize how it is encoded. SAF therefore avoids a separate no-gradient rollout and per-block timestep-zero recaching, training up to 1.8x faster than prior methods with lower memory. At inference, SAF achieves the highest single-GPU throughput among existing methods and keeps one history bank per stage for a multi-GPU pipeline, reaching 49.1 FPS on 4 GPUs. Experiments show superior long-horizon generation with a better balance between visual quality and motion. Project page: https://anonymous.4open.science/w/self-aligned-forcing/.

</details>


### [220] [GA-EIRFS: A Geometry-Augmented Repeat-Factor Sampling Method for Long-Tailed LiDAR 3D Object Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38116)
*Taufiq Ahmed,Constantino Álvarez Casado,Daniel Herrera Castro,Sasan Sharifipour,Abhishek Kumar,Miguel Bordallo López*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出GA-EIRFS采样方法，通过几何感知调制重采样概率解决长尾3D检测中频率无法反映几何证据的问题，在nuScenes上提升mAP和NDS。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长尾3D目标检测通常被视为类别频率问题，但LiDAR监督质量实际取决于目标的几何可观测性；相同频率的类别可能隐藏不同的几何证据，因此仅靠频率进行重采样不足。

Method: GA-EIRFS是一种与检测器无关的方法：用固定的几何分数（结合点数、表面法向熵、表面覆盖率）来调制基于频率的重复因子，仅改变帧采样概率，保持检测器与推理过程不变。

Result: 在nuScenes上，用CenterPoint和PointPillars、两个随机种子共四次收敛实验均提升mAP和NDS；CenterPoint(seed 666) mAP从0.552升至0.563，bicycle AP从0.306升至0.359。类别增益与采样权重增幅相关(rho=0.70, p=0.025)，但与几何分数单独不相关(rho=0.32, p=0.37)。KITTI结果随种子波动，最稀有类别波动最大。

Conclusion: 几何分数放大了频率驱动的采样需求而非独立起作用；GA-EIRFS作为即插即用的采样策略能有效缓解长尾3D检测，但KITTI上稳定性仍待改进。

Abstract: Long-tailed 3D object detection is treated as a class-frequency problem, but LiDAR supervision quality depends on object observability: similar frequencies can hide different geometric evidence. We introduce Geometry-Augmented Exponentially Weighted Instance-Aware Repeat Factor Sampling (GA-EIRFS), a detector-agnostic method that modulates a frequency-based repeat factor with a fixed geometry score combining point count, surface-normal entropy, and surface coverage. GA-EIRFS changes only frame-sampling probabilities, leaving the detector and inference unchanged. On nuScenes it improves mean average precision (mAP) and the nuScenes detection score (NDS) in four converged experiments with CenterPoint and PointPillars over two seeds; for CenterPoint at seed 666, mAP rises from 0.552 to 0.563 and bicycle AP from 0.306 to 0.359. Per-class gains correlate with the class sampling-weight increase (Spearman rho=0.70, p=0.025) but not with geometry score alone (rho=0.32, p=0.37), so geometry amplifies frequency-driven need. KITTI results vary across seeds, most for the rarest class. Code: https://github.com/Multimodal-Sensing-Lab/GA-EIRFS.

</details>


### [221] [VideoLoop: Looped Working Memory Against Semantic Thrashing in Long-Form Video Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38119)
*Jinfa Huang,Jianming Xu,Jingyang Lin,Zhengyuan Yang,Jiebo Luo*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出VideoLoop多模态智能体，通过内外双层循环重写有界工作记忆解决长视频理解中的"语义抖动"问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长视频理解需智能体多步推理收集证据，但现有智能体方法存在语义抖动：只增不减的工作记忆膨胀后，对关键证据的注意力崩溃，智能体丢失已找到的信息，噪声累积且上下文无界增长。

Method: 先给出结构性论证：仅追加式记忆可纳入新证据，但若无重写算子则无法移除累积噪声或阻止有序上下文增长。据此提出VideoLoop，含两个耦合循环：外层循环对视频进行推理，内层循环在每步后从无界文件系统（存储过往观察与中间分析）中检索产物，并重写有界工作记忆。

Result: 即插即用提升四种主流LVLM骨干，在VideoMME(long)上平均较基线提升4.2个百分点。在最难的1/4问题上，仅读上下文的盲评判者正确率达81.1%，而仅追加式智能体为60.9%。使用Gemini 3.1 Pro时，VideoMME(long)达88.3%、VideoMMMU达88.8%、LongVideoBench(long)达80.9%。

Conclusion: 引入有界工作记忆与重写算子可有效缓解语义抖动，VideoLoop在长视频理解任务上取得显著且通用的性能提升。

Abstract: Long-form video understanding requires multimodal agents to iteratively gather evidence over many reasoning steps. However, most existing agentic methods suffer from semantic thrashing: as append-only working memory grows, attention to key evidence collapses, and the agent loses access to what it has already found. First, we provide a structural argument showing that append-only memory can incorporate newly observed target evidence, but cannot remove accumulated noise or prevent ordered context growth without a rewrite operator. Second, motivated by this analysis, we propose VideoLoop, a multimodal agent with two coupled loops. The outer loop reasons over the video and the inner loop, after each step, retrieves artifacts from an unbounded filesystem of past observations and intermediate analysis, and rewrites a bounded working memory. Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of VideoLoop, which improves four popular LVLM backbones in a plug-and-play manner, with an average gain of 4.2% points over baseline on VideoMME (long). Further analysis of working memory suggests that VideoLoop mitigates semantic thrashing: on the hardest quarter of VideoMME (long) questions, a blind judge that reads only the agent's context answers 81.1% correctly, versus 60.9% for the append-only agent. With Gemini 3.1 Pro, VideoLoop reaches 88.3% on VideoMME (long), 88.8% on VideoMMMU, and 80.9% on LongVideoBench (long).

</details>


### [222] [HelixWorld: A Real-time Interactive Audio-Visual World Model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38123)
*Lei Ke,Jiahao Pan,Zeyue Tian,Jiaming Wang,Haoyuan Huang,Kam Man Wu,Pengjun Fang,Hongyu Liu,Chenyang Qi,Lin Wang,Ruibin Yuan,Weijia Chen,Fangneng Zhan,Qifeng Chen,Wei Xue,Yike Guo*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: HelixWorld 是首个实时交互式音视频世界模型，视觉与相机对齐的空间立体声在用户交互下原生协同演化，24 FPS 单卡运行。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有交互式世界模型仅关注视觉渲染与控制，完全忽略声学维度，而真实世界模拟本质上是多感官的，需要视觉与声学动态实时同步。

Method: 构建高保真空间音频-视觉数据集（真实立体声+度量相机位姿）；预训练以 6-DoF 相机轨迹和用户动作为条件的双向教师模型；通过在线轨迹蒸馏损失将教师蒸馏为少步流式学生模型，实现低延迟因果交互。

Result: 在单 GPU 上以 24 FPS 实现无漂移的联合音视频推演；视觉保真度与响应性媲美最先进的静音世界模型，且相机对齐的空间声学沉浸感显著超越现有基线。

Conclusion: HelixWorld 将声学维度引入交互式世界模型，形式化空间-声学一致性并提出 HelixBench 基准，验证了实时音视频协同世界建模的可行性。

Abstract: World simulation is inherently multisensory, demanding synchronized visual and acoustic dynamics in real time. Yet prevailing interactive world models remain strictly silent, focusing exclusively on visual rendering and control while overlooking the acoustic dimension. We present HelixWorld, a real-time interactive audio-visual world model where visual scenes and camera-grounded spatial stereo sound co-evolve natively under user interaction. We curate a high-fidelity spatial audio-visual dataset with true stereo acoustics and metric camera poses, upon which we pre-train a bidirectional teacher conditioned on 6-DoF camera trajectories and user actions. To enable low-latency causal interaction, we distill the teacher into a few-step streaming student via an online trajectory distillation loss, sustaining drift-free joint audio-visual rollouts at 24 FPS on a single GPU. Furthermore, we formalize spatial-acoustic consistency and introduce HelixBench to evaluate whether synthesized sound fields faithfully track dynamic viewpoint motion. Extensive experiments demonstrate that HelixWorld matches state-of-the-art silent world models in visual fidelity and responsiveness, while significantly surpassing existing baselines in camera-aligned spatial-acoustic immersion.

</details>


### [223] [CLeaR: A Unified Framework for Resolving the Leakage-Degradation Dilemma in Style Transfer](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38136)
*Teng Zhou,Yunhao Chen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出免训练框架CLeaR，通过正交子空间投影、集成反演和能量引导校准解决风格迁移中的内容泄漏与风格保真度权衡问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有风格迁移方法存在内容泄漏问题，即风格参考图中的物体、布局或语义会出现在生成结果中。数据驱动和免训练方法虽能减少泄漏，但面临"泄漏-退化困境"：更强的内容抑制会削弱风格保真度，而更丰富的风格保留又会重新引入不需要的参考内容；该问题贯穿特征分离、特征空间定位和扩散生成全流程。

Method: CLeaR为免训练框架。(1) 正交子空间投影，在各视觉基础模型(VFM)特征空间中定义内容削减的风格目标；(2) 集成反演，优化一个共享的像素空间风格锚点，使其满足多个VFM上的风格约束；(3) 能量引导校准，在扩散采样时通过将去噪轨迹引导向集成定义的风格流形来维持风格对齐。

Result: 理论分析表明风格锚点估计误差随VFM数量增加而减小。在StyleBench上实验显示，CLeaR相比现有方法提升了风格对齐、减少了内容泄漏，并获得更好的LLM-as-Judge评价。

Conclusion: CLeaR有效缓解了内容泄漏与风格保真度之间的困境，验证了多VFM集成在风格迁移中的有效性，代码已开源。

Abstract: Style transfer aims to render target content in the style of a reference image, but existing methods often suffer from content leakage, where objects, layouts, or semantics from the style reference appear in the generated output. Although prior data-driven and training-free methods can reduce leakage, they often face a leakage-degradation dilemma: stronger content suppression may weaken style fidelity, while richer style preservation may reintroduce unwanted reference content. We identify this dilemma across the full style-transfer pipeline, including feature separation, feature-space grounding, and diffusion generation. To address these issues, we propose CLeaR, a training-free framework for content-leakage-resistant style transfer. CLeaR first uses Orthogonal Subspace Projection to define content-reduced style targets in each vision foundation model (VFM) feature space. It then performs Ensemble Inversion, which optimizes a shared pixel-space style anchor satisfying style constraints across multiple VFMs. Finally, Energy-Guided Calibration maintains style alignment during diffusion sampling by steering the denoising trajectory toward the ensemble-defined style manifold. We further provide a theoretical analysis showing that the style-anchor estimation error decreases with the number of VFMs. Experiments on StyleBench demonstrate that CLeaR improves style alignment, reduces content leakage, and achieves better LLM-as-Judge evaluation compared with existing methods. The code is available at \href{https://github.com/0606zt/CLeaR}{https://github.com/0606zt/CLeaR}.

</details>


### [224] [Breaking the Uniformity Trap: Scaling Video Diffusion Model via SplitMoE](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38140)
*Yu Xu,Yuxin Zhang,Xiao Yang,Haotian Yang,Yizhi Wang,Xinwei Huang,Minxuan Lin,Angtian Wang,Chongyang Ma,Fan Tang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出SplitMoE，将专家池拆分为语义专家与通用专家，并采用原型引导路由与推拉正则，打破传统MoE的"均匀性陷阱"，提升视频生成质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统token-wise MoE独立路由token并强迫专家使用均匀化，难以适配视频数据在时空上冗余、语义长尾的特性，导致路由碎片化和结构失真（均匀性陷阱）。

Method: 提出split-role稀疏架构：将专家池显式分为语义专家（高层语义抽象）和通用专家（保留残差视觉信息与生成能力），配合原型引导路由和pull-push正则，使token按语义属性自然聚类而非人为平衡。

Result: 在等效激活参数预算下，SplitMoE在收敛速度、路由一致性和视频生成质量上均优于传统负载均衡MoE，并在标准基准上取得更好表现。

Conclusion: SplitMoE揭示了涌现的由粗到细去噪逻辑，为社区提供模态感知的扩展路径，可作为构建大规模视频世界模型的重要参考。

Abstract: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE), popularized by large language models, is a promising paradigm for scaling visual generative models. However, conventional token-wise MoE routes tokens independently within a homogeneous expert pool and regularizes expert usage toward uniformity, making it poorly matched to video data that is spatiotemporally redundant and semantically long-tailed. We show that existing visual MoEs fall into a uniformity trap: semantically under-organized routing, compounded by uniform expert-usage regularization, scatters coherent patches across disparate experts, causing routing fragmentation and structural distortion. To address this, we propose SplitMoE, a split-role sparse architecture that breaks the shackles of uniformity. To accommodate the inherent semantic imbalance, we explicitly bifurcate the expert pool into semantic experts and generic experts, with semantic experts capturing high-level semantic abstraction and generic experts preserving residual visual information and flexible generative capacity. Leveraging prototype-guided routing and pull-push regularization, SplitMoE enables tokens to cluster naturally by semantic attributes rather than arbitrary balancing constraints. Extensive results show that under an equivalent activated-parameter budget, SplitMoE outperforms traditional load-balanced MoEs in convergence speed, routing coherence, and video generation quality across standard benchmarks. By revealing an emergent coarse-to-fine denoising logic, SplitMoE provides the community with a modality-aware scaling path, serving as a critical reference for building large-scale video world models.

</details>


### [225] [LIFT: Layout-In-Future Video Generation under Large Viewpoint Change via On-Policy Self-Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38146)
*Shengxiang Ji,Boyang Wang,Haiyang Xu,Bingnan Li,Yucheng Mao,Zeyuan Chen,Xiaojun Shan,Xiang Zhang,Gang Hua,Jianwen Xie,Zezhou Cheng,Zhuowen Tu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: LIFT是一个统一的图像到视频生成框架，通过"末帧布局控制"（Layout-In-FuTure）补充相机控制，让用户指定未来画面中应出现什么内容及其位置，并借助on-policy自蒸馏将密集布局教师模型的能力迁移到末帧布局学生模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在可控视频生成中，给定初始图像，用户不仅关心相机如何运动，还关心未来关键帧（尤其是最后一帧）的场景内容与空间布局。现有相机控制只规定视点轨迹，文本提示仅提供粗略语义，都无法精确决定未来视角的内容与布局；在大视角变化下，相机暴露出首帧不可见的区域，这一问题尤为突出。

Method: LIFT以末帧布局作为未来场景的显式控制信号。由于从稀疏布局指导中学习比基于密集逐帧布局条件更难，作者提出on-policy自蒸馏（OPSD），将密集布局教师模型的控制能力迁移到末帧布局学生模型。此外构建了LIFT-Vista数据集，包含大视角变化以及相机和时间一致的布局标注。

Result: 实验表明，LIFT在视频质量、未来布局可控性和相机可控性方面均优于其他方法。

Conclusion: LIFT通过末帧布局控制与on-policy自蒸馏，实现了对未来视角内容与布局的精确控制，并结合LIFT-Vista数据集，在多项指标上取得优于现有方法的可控视频生成效果。

Abstract: We introduce LIFT, a unified image-to-video generation framework that complements camera control with Layout-In-FuTure control, enabling users to specify what should appear in a future view and where it should appear. This addresses a practical need in controllable video generation: given an initial image, users often care not only about how the camera moves, but also about what the scene should look like at key future moments, especially the final frame. Existing camera controls specify viewpoint trajectories, while text prompts provide only coarse semantic guidance; neither precisely determines the content and spatial layout of future views. This limitation becomes particularly pronounced under large viewpoint changes, where the camera reveals regions that are not visible in the first frame. LIFT therefore uses the last-frame layout as an explicit control signal for the desired future scene. Since learning from such sparse layout guidance is substantially more challenging than conditioning on dense per-frame layouts, we introduce on-policy self-distillation (OPSD) to transfer the control capability of a dense-layout teacher to a last-frame-layout student. We further curate LIFT-Vista, a dataset featuring large viewpoint changes with camera and temporally consistent layout annotations. Experiments show that LIFT improves video quality, future-layout controllability, and camera controllability over other methods.

</details>


### [226] [FracGen: Learning How Objects Stretch and Tear with Physics-Informed Video Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38152)
*Trong-Tung Nguyen,Jiahan Zhang,Anand Bhattad*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: FracGen是一个从单张完好物体图像生成可控裂缝动力学的视频生成模型，通过FracSim仿真框架获得配对数据和物理场监督训练。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视频生成模型难以捕捉真实的物理状态，缺乏对断裂等物理动力学的可控生成能力，而昂贵的测试时仿真或逐场景调参限制了应用。

Method: 构建FracSim仿真框架（MPM+连续损伤模型）生成配对断裂视频与像素对齐物理场；FracGen联合预测物理场与RGB视频，并采用物理信息损失保证预测场间一致性。

Result: FracGen无需测试时仿真或逐场景调参即可捕捉材料特定的断裂行为，可精细控制撕裂位置、裂纹扩展速度与失效前变形；在物理与视觉保真度上均优于现有视频生成基线。

Conclusion: 提出断裂感知视频生成方法及物理合理性评测基准，验证了物理场监督对提升生成断裂视频物理真实性的有效性。

Abstract: We introduce FracGen, a fracture-aware video generation model that produces plausible, controllable fracture dynamics from a single image of an intact object, conditioned on physics signals. To train FracGen, we build FracSim, a fracture-aware simulation framework that augments material point method (MPM) simulation with a continuum damage model, producing paired fracture videos and dense, pixel-aligned physical fields at no additional cost beyond standard rendering. FracGen leverages these maps in two ways: it is trained to jointly predict them alongside RGB video, encouraging the model to capture physical state rather than surface appearance; and it is supervised with physics-informed losses that encourage consistency among the predicted maps. As a result, FracGen captures distinct material-specific fracture behavior without expensive test-time simulation or per-scene tuning, while offering fine-grained control over where an object tears, how fast the crack propagates, and how much deformation precedes failure. We further introduce a benchmark for evaluating the physical plausibility of generated fracture video, and show through extensive experiments that FracGen outperforms existing video generation baselines in both physical and visual fidelity. Results are best viewed in our project website: https://fracgen.github.io/.

</details>


### [227] [PowerSim: Differentiable Physics Simulation and Rendering with Power Diagrams](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38153)
*Trong-Tung Nguyen,Anand Bhattad*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: PowerSim将预训练的PowerFoam场景直接耦合到MPM，实现可微物理动力学，无需中间表示。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 为PowerFoam的power diagram 3D表示引入物理接地的可微动力学，克服以往框架在物理动力学上的局限。

Method: 利用图元几何与外观属性同MPM跟踪量之间的自然对齐，将预训练PowerFoam场景与MPM直接耦合，使模拟运动直接驱动几何与外观。

Result: 在真实与合成场景上实现四类应用：用户交互下模拟静态场景、恢复空间变化材质场、组合多场景图元为可模拟场景、以及随物体形变一致更新的光线追踪反射。

Conclusion: PowerSim在物理接地动力学方面优于以往框架，并解锁动态场景的二次光线照明效果等独特优势。

Abstract: We introduce PowerSim, a method to bring physically grounded, differentiable dynamics to PowerFoam's power diagram based 3D representation. PowerSim directly couples a pre-trained PowerFoam scene to the Material Point Method (MPM) by exploiting a natural alignment between the two: the geometric and appearance properties of each primitive correspond closely to the quantities MPM already tracks as an object deforms. Consequently, simulated motion can drive the scene's geometry and appearance directly, without an auxiliary representation in between. Built on this framework, we enable a range of applications on real and synthetic scenes: (1) simulating a static scene under user interaction, (2) recovering spatially varying material fields, (3) compositing primitives from independently captured scenes into a single simulation-ready scene and (4) ray-tracing reflections that update consistently as the object deforms. Our results suggest that PowerSim excels over previous frameworks for physically grounded dynamics, while unlocking unique advantages-such as secondary ray lighting effects on dynamic scenes. Results are best viewed on our project website: https://power-sim.github.io/.

</details>


### [228] [LongLive-Plug: Once-for-All Distillation for Video Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38154)
*Shuai Yang,Luozhou Wang,Wei Huang,ZhiFei Chen,Bohan Zhang,Xiao Fu,Qianli Ma,Chen-Hsuan Lin,Weian Mao,Bryan Chu,Song Han,Yukang Chen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出LongLive-Plug一次性蒸馏框架，将可复用能力以LoRA形式学习并即插即用部署到下游视频扩散模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视频扩散模型通常针对每个下游任务单独进行蒸馏（加速采样或长视频生成），导致重复训练成本高，缺乏可复用性。

Method: 在基础模型上以LoRA学习可复用能力（单次CFG、少步采样、长上下文纠错），通过推理权重实现文本引导控制；适配器在下游模型增加条件分支或扩展输出通道时仍可复用。

Result: 在3个骨干家族、8类任务的54个下游模型上验证免训练部署，涵盖世界建模、机器人、编辑和多模态生成；CFG LoRA与少步LoRA结合可同时保留少步生成与CFG可控性。

Conclusion: 每种能力只需在每个骨干家族蒸馏一次即可复用，无需针对目标模型重新训练，可支持更多兼容模型。

Abstract: Video diffusion models are increasingly developed into specialized models for diverse downstream tasks, and this development often includes a distillation stage, for example to accelerate sampling or to improve long-video generation. This stage is typically repeated for every specialized model. We introduce LongLive-Plug, a once-for-all distillation framework that learns reusable capabilities as LoRAs on a base model for training-free, plug-and-play deployment to compatible downstream models. These capabilities include single-pass classifier-free guidance, few-step sampling, and long-context error correction for autoregressive generation. The adapters remain reusable even when downstream models add conditioning branches, expand output channels. Despite training at a fixed guidance scale, our dedicated CFG LoRA provides text guidance control through its inference weight. Combining it with a few-step LoRA simultaneously preserves few-step generation and CFG controllability on downstream tasks. We verify training-free deployment on 54 downstream models across three backbone families and eight task categories, including world modeling, robotics, editing, and multimodal generation. The approach may support additional compatible models. Each capability can thus be distilled once per backbone family and reused without per-target retraining.

</details>


### [229] [DMA$^2$: Pixel-space Distribution Matching with Adversarial and Anchor Losses](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38156)
*Xin Lin,Zhifei Zhang,Yuqian Zhou,Haitian Zheng,Shaoteng Liu,Lehan Yang,Zhe Lin,Ming-Hsuan Yang,Truong Nguyen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文针对原生像素空间（RGB）扩散的DMD蒸馏，提出DMA$^2$框架：高噪声匹配带、DINO-Adv去判别器对抗引导、AF-Loss无参语义分布对齐，实现四步学生超越25步教师。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代DMD文本到图像实例主要基于潜空间扩散，忽视了原生RGB的关键特性和设计机会，作者重新审视像素空间教师的DMD接口。

Method: 教师匹配侧诊断发现低噪声RGB匹配由局部纹理线索主导，故采用固定高噪声匹配带；数据侧利用原生干净RGB输出，提出DINO-Adv将判别器移出对抗梯度路径并提供局部参数化patch引导；分布级引入AF-Loss，在共享DINOv2空间对分离的滚动真实/生成支撑做无参辅助语义分布场目标，保留提示条件教师监督，无额外参数与推理开销。

Result: 在DPG-Bench、GenEval、VQAScore和COCO30K上，四步DMA$^2$学生优于25步教师及所评估的少步蒸馏方法。

Conclusion: 原生像素空间为DMD提供了独特设计空间，DMA$^2$以无额外推理开销的方式实现了高质量少步扩散生成。

Abstract: Distribution matching distillation (DMD) provides a general framework for few-step diffusion generation, but its modern text-to-image instantiations have been developed primarily around latent diffusion. It therefore overlooks key properties and design opportunities of native RGB. We revisit two DMD interfaces for pixel-space teachers. On the teacher-matching side, diagnostics show low-noise RGB matching is dominated by a local-texture cue, motivating a fixed high-noise matching band. On the real-data side, native clean-RGB outputs allow guidance from an external visual representation without traversing a decoder or sharing the heavy fake-score critic. DINO-Adv removes this critic from the adversarial gradient path and supplies local parametric patch guidance. For distribution-level guidance, we introduce AF-Loss, a parameter-free auxiliary semantic distribution-field objective designed for text-to-image DMD. It operates on detached rolling real and generated supports in the shared DINOv2 space while preserving prompt-conditioned teacher supervision. AF-Loss adds no learnable parameters or inference-time computation. Together these designs form DMA$^2$. Across DPG-Bench, GenEval, VQAScore, and COCO30K, the four-step DMA$^2$ student performs better than the 25-step teacher and evaluated few-step distillers.

</details>


### [230] [Rethinking Representations for World-Action Modeling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38163)
*Haoyi Jiang,Liu Liu,Xinjiang Wang,Zhihao Sun,Zequn Chen,Sen Wang,Xinjie Wang,Xia Chen,Jingfeng Yao,Weiheng Zhao,Shanglin Yuan,Zhizhong Su,Wei Sui,Wenyu Liu,Xinggang Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出 ReWAM，一种以表示为中枢的世界-动作模型，基于预训练 DINO 特征构建，实现高效机器人策略学习与动力学预测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 世界-动作模型将表示空间作为控制与预测的接口，但重构保真度或预训练感知特征单独都不足以保证有效的策略学习，因此需要重新设计该表示空间。

Method: ReWAM 基于预训练 DINO 特征，采用特征校准（Feature Calibration）与时间表示瓶颈（Temporal Representation Bottleneck）将特征组织为紧凑的世界状态；并通过动作锚定表示塑造（Action-Grounded Representation Shaping）仅将动作损失梯度回传至瓶颈，使策略塑造表示内容，世界模型学习其演化。

Result: 在无需生成式视频预训练的情况下，ReWAM 在 RoboTwin 2.0 上达到 93.6% 成功率；在 RoboDojo 上使用约 600 小时具身预训练数据，平均得分 12.29、成功率 8.28%。

Conclusion: 以表示为中枢的设计优于单纯依赖重构保真度或预训练感知特征，验证了 ReWAM 在策略学习与世界建模联合任务中的有效性。

Abstract: World-action models jointly learn robot policies and predict future observations, making the representation space an interface between control and prediction. We study the design of this space through controlled comparisons, finding that neither reconstruction fidelity nor pre-trained perceptual features alone ensure effective policy learning. These findings motivate ReWAM, a representation-centric world-action model built on pre-trained DINO features. Feature Calibration and a Temporal Representation Bottleneck organize these features into compact world states suited to dynamics modeling. Action-Grounded Representation Shaping routes only action-loss gradients to the bottleneck, thereby letting the policy shape what the representation encodes while the world model learns how it evolves. Without generative video pre-training, ReWAM achieves 93.6% success on RoboTwin 2.0. On RoboDojo, it achieves an average score of 12.29 and a success rate of 8.28% using approximately 600 hours of embodied pre-training data.

</details>


### [231] [Cropland PAtteRNS: Parallel Dimensional Attention Networks and Attention to Dataset Disparity for Crop Segmentation in Satellite Imagery Time Series Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38165)
*Joseph Metcalfe,Sara Sharifzadeh,Fabio Caraffini*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出PAtteRNS模型，首次对Sentinel-2时序数据的时序、光谱、空间三个维度分别应用自注意力，通过并行Transformer架构降低三重因式分解自注意力的计算复杂度，在作物分割任务上超越现有最优模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 卫星影像时序数据集与分割架构发展迅速，但一味追求新颖概念或更大数据集导致细节被忽视。现有模型未对SITS数据的时序、光谱、空间三个方面分别进行自注意力建模，且作物分割数据集存在类别分组缺陷和瓦片尺寸不一致等问题，影响公平比较。

Method: 提出混合Transformer-卷积模型Cropland PAtteRNS，对Sentinel-2多光谱SITS数据的时序、光谱、空间三个维度分别使用自注意力机制，并设计新型并行Transformer架构实现全因式分解注意力，显著降低三重因式分解自注意力的计算复杂度。在PASTIS和MTLCC数据集多个瓦片尺寸变体上进行消融实验与对比。

Result: 模型在作物类别分割任务上超越所有对比模型，在多项分割指标上表现优异，尤其在现有研究常忽略的地块边界质量（Boundary IoU）指标上优势显著。同时发现数据集中的错误类别分组会严重损害模型性能，不同瓦片尺寸变体之间的结果不可比较，导致无法公平对比。

Conclusion: 建议规范SITS作物分割数据集构建的最佳实践，并推动未来动态瓦片尺寸机制以实现理想模型性能。

Abstract: The landscape of satellite imagery time series datasets and boundary-pushing architectures for cropland segmentation has never been richer. However, in this gold rush, important truths are being missed on both fronts, as a drive for the most novel concepts or the largest datasets pushes finer details to the side. In this paper, we present our hybrid transformer-convolutional model, Cropland Parallel Attention and Refinement Network for Segmentation (PAtteRNS), the first model to use self-attention mechanisms separately for each of the temporal, spectral, and spatial aspects of Sentinel-2 multispectral SITS data. To achieve fully-factorised attention in our proposed model, we introduce a novel parallel transformer architecture which significantly reduces the computational complexity of triple-factorised self-attention. We validate our architecture with an in-depth ablation study, and analyse the performance of our model against state-of-the-art crop segmentation models on multiple tile-size variants of the popular PASTIS and MTLCC datasets. Our findings show our model to outperform all others in the task of crop class segmentation, verified across multiple important segmentation metrics, with especially strong performance against compared models seen in the often under-reported parcel delineation quality, for which we use the Boundary IoU metric. We also find that flawed class groupings within datasets can have a significant negative impact on model performance, and report that alternate tile-size variants of crop segmentation datasets produce results incomparable to one-another, invalidating fair comparison between model performance when trained on different tile-sizes. Based on these findings, we suggest further work is required to standardise best practices when constructing SITS crop segmentation datasets, and to enable future dynamic-tile-sizing for ideal model performance.

</details>


### [232] [Adversarial Training for Pixel Diffusion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38170)
*Xin Lin,Zhifei Zhang,Yuqian Zhou,Haitian Zheng,Zhe Lin,Ming-Hsuan Yang,Truong Nguyen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文首次系统研究像素扩散模型的后训练对抗学习，通过在非高噪声时间步对预测输出添加对抗损失，联合提升分布保真度、覆盖度、提示对齐与感知质量，并揭示其机制在于恢复缺失的高频成分。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 像素扩散模型直接生成RGB图像，避免了自编码器瓶颈，但其输出仍系统性欠表达细尺度自然图像统计特征，需要一种有效的后训练校正方法。

Method: 从预训练模型出发，保留原始扩散或流匹配目标，在非高噪声时间步对预测输出添加对抗损失，保持模型架构与采样流程不变；在两个像素骨干网络上验证，并结合频带与功率谱分析、感知损失对比、最近邻/召回/SFT对照实验及潜扩散边界实验探究机理。

Result: 在两个像素骨干网络上，方法联合提升了分布保真度、覆盖度、提示对齐和感知质量；频带与幂律分析显示原模型系统性欠产生高频内容，对抗后训练恢复了缺失的谱功率，而感知损失虽增加高频却牺牲保真度与对齐；对照实验排除了记忆、模式崩塌和额外优化等解释；在测试的潜扩散配置下无类似收益且几乎不增加解码高频功率。

Conclusion: 对抗后训练是像素扩散的有效校正手段，其成功关键在于对所需校正的图像统计量具有直接输出访问权限，这决定了该方法何时有效。

Abstract: Pixel diffusion models generate RGB images directly, avoiding the bottleneck of an autoencoder, yet their outputs still systematically underrepresent fine-scale natural-image statistics. We show that adversarial learning provides an effective post-training correction for this deficiency. Starting from a pretrained model, we retain its original diffusion or flow-matching objective and add an adversarial loss to the predicted output at non-high-noise timesteps, leaving the model architecture and sampling procedure unchanged. To our knowledge, this is the first systematic study of adversarial post-training for pixel diffusion. Across two pixel backbones, the method jointly improves distribution fidelity, coverage, prompt alignment, and perceptual quality. We further investigate why it works. Frequency-band and power-law analyses show that the original models systematically underproduce natural-image high-frequency content, while adversarial post-training restores this missing spectral power. In contrast, perceptual loss also increases high-frequency content but sacrifices distribution fidelity and prompt alignment. Nearest-neighbor, recall, and matched no-GAN SFT controls further rule out memorization, mode dropping, and additional optimization as simple explanations. Finally, we examine the boundary of this effect. Under the tested latent diffusion configurations, the same procedure does not produce comparable joint gains and adds almost no decoded high-frequency power. These results identify direct output access to the image statistics being corrected as a key factor governing when adversarial post-training succeeds.

</details>


### [233] [Point2Part: Unified 3D Partitioning from Point Prompts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38180)
*Hao-Tang Tsui,Yu-Rou Tuan,Xiaoxuan Ma,Nicolas Ugrinovic,Takaaki Shiratori,Kris Kitani*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出一种可提示的3D部件分解模型，将整个形状联合划分为互不重叠且完整覆盖的部件，在图像/网格到部件生成及部件分割三个任务上均超越现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有3D部件分解方法不一定将原始形状划分为互不重叠且完整覆盖的部件，会存在重叠或空隙，阻碍下游部件级应用。作者认为部件分解应联合考虑所有目标部件，而非独立建模每个部件。

Method: 将部件分解建模为整个形状的联合划分。基于预训练3D生成模型，从图像或网格获取形状隐变量；引入提示编码器将每个3D点提示映射为部件token并关注形状隐变量；提出新型部件解码器，以粗到细方式联合对所有部件token评分，将形状体素内每个位置恰好分配给一个部件，在共享形状隐空间中完成分解，统一支持图像到部件生成、网格到部件生成及部件分割。

Result: 在三个任务的所有部件质量指标上均优于现有工作，部件间的兼容性比之前SOTA方法提升一个数量级。

Conclusion: 该可提示的联合划分方法实现了完整覆盖、无重叠的3D部件分解，并统一了多种任务，显著提升部件质量与兼容性。

Abstract: Existing 3D part decomposition methods do not necessarily partition the original shape into non-overlapping parts that collectively cover the entire shape, allowing overlaps or gaps that hinder downstream part-level applications. We instead formulate part decomposition as a joint partitioning of the entire shape, where the predicted parts are non-overlapping and jointly recover the entire shape. Our key insight is that part decomposition should consider all desired parts jointly, rather than modeling each part independently. To this end, we develop a promptable model for 3D part decomposition from images or meshes. Users can specify desired parts through 3D point prompts for controllable decomposition. Given one point prompt per desired part, our model produces the corresponding parts as a complete partition of the entire shape. We build on a pretrained 3D generation model and first obtain a shape latent from either an input image or mesh. We then introduce a prompt encoder that maps each 3D point prompt to a part token while attending to the shape latent. To decode the desired parts, we propose a novel part decoder jointly scoring the entire shape against all part tokens in a coarse-to-fine manner, assigning every position within the shape volume to exactly one part. We perform part decomposition in this shared shape latent space, enabling a unified model for image-to-part generation, mesh-to-part generation, and part segmentation. Our method outperforms existing works on all part-quality metrics across all three tasks, and improves compatibility among parts by an order of magnitude over previous SOTA methods. Code and models will be released.

</details>


<div id='cs.CL'></div>

# cs.CL [[Back]](#toc)

### [234] [FD-VAD: Semantic Endpoint Detection for Streaming Full-Duplex Speech](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35791)
*Puneet Mathur,Dinesh Manocha*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出 FD-VAD，一种免 ASR 的流式语义端点检测方法，将因果音频窗口直接映射为 Continue/Stop 决策，实现全双工语音交互中的自然轮次转换。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 全双工语音交互需从部分语音判断停顿是犹豫还是完成意图。声学 VAD 缺乏语义信息，级联 ASR 端点检测依赖转录并增加处理阶段。

Method: 将语义端点检测建模为因果音频-语言推理任务；结合冻结语音编码器、轻量模态适配器和参数高效微调的语言模型；采用 last-chunk 训练目标；引入置信度门控端点承诺与边界聚焦难负样本采样。

Result: 在域内和对话评测中优于强流式与非流式语义轮次分类器；在 TurnBench 开发集零样本设置下（FP<=0.10）取得合格系统中最高 EOT 召回 0.853。

Conclusion: 语义端点检测可直接从流式音频完成，无需中间 ASR 或对话状态跟踪。

Abstract: Natural turn-taking in full-duplex voice interaction requires determining from partial speech whether a pause reflects hesitation or a completed conversational intent. Acoustic voice activity detection lacks this semantic information, while cascaded ASR-based endpointing introduces transcription dependence and additional processing stages. We formulate semantic endpoint detection as a causal audio-language reasoning task and introduce FD-VAD, an ASR-free streaming endpointer that maps bounded causal audio windows directly to Continue/Stop decisions. FD-VAD combines a frozen speech encoder with a lightweight modality adapter and a parameter-efficiently adapted language model, using a last-chunk training objective for streaming inference. We further introduce confidence-gated endpoint commitment to control interruption versus delay and boundary-focused hard-negative sampling to improve decisions around ambiguous turn boundaries. Across in-domain and conversational evaluations, FD-VAD outperforms strong streaming and non-streaming semantic turn classifiers, and achieves the highest EOT recall among qualifying systems on TurnBench dev set $0.853$ (at FP<=0.10) in a zero-shot setting. These results show that semantic endpointing can be performed directly from streaming audio without intermediate ASR or dialogue state tracking.

</details>


### [235] [Sieve and Sage: Efficient Distraction Filtering for Reliable RALM Abstention](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35794)
*Jongbin Won,Sung Geun An,Jay-yoon Lee*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出将检索失败分为"不可回答"和"被干扰"两种状态，用轻量模块Sieve先过滤干扰证据，再调用LLM进行接地生成与弃答。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有RALM弃答方法依赖单一庞大LLM一步处理异质检索失败，导致弃答性能有限且计算成本高。

Method: 将检索失败分解为不可回答状态（缺少必要证据）与被干扰状态（证据与冲突、否定或对抗信息混杂），据此设计Sieve轻量模块在调用昂贵LLM前筛除文档集中的干扰证据，再由Sage进行接地生成与弃答。

Result: 在通用及高风险专家领域评测中，该框架先发检测干扰噪声，相比单阶段基线系统准确率提升最多69.4个百分点，Macro-F1提升55.2个百分点，并实现最高1.99倍加速。

Conclusion: Sieve与Sage框架构建了高效可靠的RALM弃答流水线，验证了分解检索失败状态的有效性。

Abstract: Just as Socrates recognized the limits of his own knowledge, Retrieval-Augmented Language Models (RALMs) should learn to abstain when the retrieved evidence cannot support a reliable response. Existing approaches largely rely on monolithic LLMs to handle heterogeneous retrieval failures in a single step, resulting in limited abstention performance and high computational costs. We instead decompose retrieval failures into two distinct states: (i) the unanswerable state, where the required evidence is absent, and (ii) the distracted state, where relevant evidence is mixed with conflicting, negated, or adversarial information. Based on this decomposition, we introduce a lightweight module (Sieve) that screens retrieved document sets for distracting evidence before invoking a costly LLM (Sage) for grounded generation and abstention. Evaluated across both general and high-stakes expert domains, our Sieve and Sage framework preemptively detects distracting noise, improving system accuracy by up to 69.4 percentage points and Macro-F1 by 55.2 percentage points compared to one-stage baselines. Furthermore, it achieves up to a 1.99x speedup, establishing a highly efficient and reliable abstention pipeline for RALM with abstention.

</details>


### [236] [Developing an OCR model for Extracting Information from Invoices with Korean Language](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35796)
*Xiem HoangVan,Phu TranQuang,Minh DinhBao,Tien VuHuu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出一种结合深度学习与图像预处理的光学字符识别（OCR）模型，用于从韩语发票中自动提取关键信息，实验在收集的发票数据集上达到87% F1值且处理时间极短。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 发票包含商品、时间、金额等重要信息，信息提取意义重大。韩语是约8000万人的母语，在韩国及越南、菲律宾等设有大量韩企的国家中作用重要，因此需要针对韩语发票的自动信息提取方案。

Method: 将深度学习模型与若干图像预处理技术相结合，构建高效的OCR模型，用于韩语发票的信息提取。

Result: 在收集的丰富发票数据集上评估，模型取得87%的F1值，且处理时间几乎可忽略不计。

Conclusion: 所提出的OCR模型能高效、准确地对韩语发票进行信息提取，兼具高精度与低处理时间，具有实用价值。

Abstract: Invoices are commercial documents that contain various pieces of information, including the purchased items, time, and total money. Making the extraction of important information crucial. The stored information serves different purposes. Korean language is the native language of about 80 million people, playing an important role in not only South and North Korea but also in many other countries such as Vietnam, Philippine where a large number of Korean companies are located. In this context, to automatically extract proper information from the invoices with Korean language, we propose an efficient Optical Character Recognition (OCR) model in which a deep learning model is combined with some image preprocessing techniques. The proposed OCR model is assessed in a rich set of collected invoices showing that 87% F1-score can be achieved with negligible time processing.

</details>


### [237] [Evaluating the Effects of Prompt Perturbation on Bias and Hallucination in Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35804)
*Mamehgol Yousefi,Ahmad Shahi,Mos Sharifi,Alvaro Romera,Simon Hoermann,Tham Piumsomboon*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文评估大语言模型在决策任务中对原始查询扰动变体的鲁棒性，发现扰动在某些模型中有助于缓解偏见与幻觉，且Claude 3整体表现优于GPT-3.5。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM越来越多被用作决策辅助工具，但其可靠性（偏见与幻觉）引发担忧，需评估模型在查询扰动下的鲁棒性。

Method: 对决策任务中原始查询进行扰动，评估多个LLM对扰动变体的鲁棒性，并比较不同模型的表现。

Result: 与以往研究相反，扰动可在某些LLM中缓解偏见与幻觉；Claude 3在多数数据集任务上更有效，GPT-3.5表现参差不齐，部分任务相当但另一些明显落后。

Conclusion: 研究为理解LLM助手作为决策支持工具的实际部署提供了洞见，强调需严格测试与验证以确保可靠性，并为构建更鲁棒可信的AI助手提供参考。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have shown remarkable capabilities in various natural language processing tasks, leading to their widespread deployment as intelligent assistants in decision-making contexts. However, the increasing complexity of these models raises concerns about their reliability, particularly regarding bias and hallucination. In this work, we evaluate the robustness of LLMs to perturbed variations of the original inquiry in decision-making tasks. We show that contrary to previous studies, perturbations can mitigate bias and hallucination in some LLMs over other models. It's found that Claude 3 is more effective for the tasks represented in most datasets, whereas models like GPT3.5 exhibit varying levels of adequacy, performing comparably in some cases but falling significantly behind in others. These insights are crucial for understanding the practical implications of deploying LLM-based assistants as effective decision-support tools in real-world applications, emphasising the need for rigorous testing and validation to ensure reliability and effectiveness. This study contributes to the growing body of research on LLM evaluation and provides insights for developing more robust and trustworthy AI assistants in critical decision-making contexts.

</details>


### [238] [The Collective Turing Test: Large Language Models Can Generate Realistic Multi-User Discussions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2511.08592)
*Azza Bouleimen,Giordano De Marzo,Taehee Kim,Nicol`o Pagan,Hannah Metzler,Silvia Giordano,Anikó Hannák,David Garcia*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本研究测试LLM能否逼真模拟社交媒体群体对话，发现LLM生成内容有39%被误认为真实人类内容，Llama 3更接近随机猜测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM为模拟在线社区和社交媒体提供了新途径，可用于测试推荐算法设计和评估内容政策效果，但其模拟用户间对话的真实性尚未得到充分验证。

Method: 从Reddit收集真实人类对话，并用Llama 3 70B和GPT-4o生成同主题人工对话，将这些对话并排呈现给研究参与者，让其辨别是否为AI生成。

Result: LLM生成的对话有39%被误认为人类创作内容；对于Llama 3生成的对话，参与者仅56%能正确识别为AI生成，几乎与随机猜测无异。

Conclusion: LLM能生成足以欺骗人类的逼真社交媒体对话，既展示了社会模拟的潜力，也警示了其被滥用于生成虚假社交媒体内容的风险。

Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) offer new avenues to simulate online communities and social media. Potential applications range from testing the design of content recommendation algorithms to estimating the effects of content policies and interventions. However, the validity of using LLMs to simulate conversations between various users remains largely untested. We evaluated whether LLMs can convincingly mimic human group conversations on social media. We collected authentic human conversations from Reddit and generated artificial conversations on the same topic with two LLMs: Llama 3 70B and GPT-4o. When presented side-by-side to study participants, LLM-generated conversations were mistaken for human-created content 39\% of the time. In particular, when evaluating conversations generated by Llama 3, participants correctly identified them as AI-generated only 56\% of the time, barely better than random chance. Our study demonstrates that LLMs can generate social media conversations sufficiently realistic to deceive humans when reading them, highlighting both a promising potential for social simulation and a warning message about the potential misuse of LLMs to generate new inauthentic social media content.

</details>


### [239] [Alignment Forecasting: Predicting Misalignment From Training Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35805)
*Chen Yueh-Han,Bruce W. Lee,Ilia Sucholutsky,Tomek Korbak*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出"对齐预测"(Alignment Forecasting)任务与ALIGNMENTFORECASTBENCH基准，用于在微调前预测数据是否会导致模型对齐失败，并验证了结合LLM数据集评分与基率的预测方法优于多个基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 窄域缺陷数据有时会引发模型的广泛失准，仅凭数据表面审查难以判断其是否会涌现，目前只能在训练后通过模型审计发现问题，缺乏训练前的预测手段。

Method: 构建包含5000+预测问题、17个目标模型、32个数据集、16种失败模式的基准；直接提示前沿模型表现不佳，故提出预测框架：LLM阅读数据集并评估其推向失范的强度与广度，再用简单学习模型将该评分与失败模式的基率及目标模型的先验倾向结合。

Result: 该框架预测效果远高于随机，优于在该任务上微调的模型，也优于可见较弱模型微调后行为的简单预测器；信号还能标记前沿模型分类器遗漏的问题训练样本，过滤后（如UltraChat）多数情况下对齐更好，但开放式对话中的收益不明确。

Conclusion: 实现对训练前对齐失败的预测在SFT场景中是可行的，但要让预测可靠地指导实际训练数据筛选仍需更多进展。

Abstract: Training a language model on data with a narrow flaw can sometimes make the model broadly misaligned. Inspecting the data at face value often does not settle whether it will emerge, and today it is caught only after training, by auditing the resulting model. To complement post-hoc audits, we introduce Alignment Forecasting: the task of predicting alignment failures before training. Given a target model, a fine-tuning dataset, and a failure mode such as deception or sycophancy, a forecaster outputs the probability that fine-tuning would meaningfully increase that failure mode. To measure progress on alignment forecasting, we introduce ALIGNMENTFORECASTBENCH, a benchmark of over 5,000 forecasting questions spanning 17 target models, 32 datasets, and 16 failure modes. Frontier models prompted directly perform poorly on ALIGNMENTFORECASTBENCH. We therefore propose a forecasting scaffold in which an LLM reads the dataset and rates how strongly and broadly it pushes the model toward misbehavior, and a simple learned model combines that rating with the failure mode's base rate and the target model's prior tendency. This forecasts well above chance, and beats a model fine-tuned on the task and a simple forecaster allowed to see how weaker models behaved after fine-tuning on the same data. Its signals also flag problematic training examples that a frontier-model classifier misses. Filtering those examples out from real post-training data such as UltraChat results in more aligned models on our multiple-choice evaluation in most cases, though the benefit in open-ended conversations is unclear. More progress is needed before forecasts can reliably guide training data curation in practice, but our results suggest that forecasting many alignment failures before training can be tractable in the SFT setting.

</details>


### [240] [From Lexical Baselines to Agentic Retrieval-Augmented Generation: Structured Skill and Responsibility-Level Extraction with the SFIA Framework](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35806)
*Ranuga Disansa,U. S. Samarasinghe,Lasith Gunawardena*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 首次针对SFIA框架提出结构化、层级感知的技能抽取任务，评测五种策略，给出可复现基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有技能抽取系统将技能表示为扁平标签，缺乏责任层级信息；SFIA定义了147项技能、7个责任层级，但尚无基于LLM的自动化抽取研究。

Method: 将任务形式化为从自由文本预测(skill, level)对的structured prediction，提出三个研究问题；评测五种策略：词典基线、稠密检索+LLM重排、零样本schema约束LLM、单智能体agentic RAG、三智能体（retriever–matcher–verifier）crew；使用自动智能体管线构建的SFIA 9语料，对照专家标注的欧洲ICT职位档案。

Result: 检索式匹配识别出最多技能，生成式策略精度明显更高；只有将层级作为显式决策的策略能可靠预测层级，基于相似度的选择错误率高一倍以上；三智能体crew使延迟翻倍但精度未提升。

Conclusion: 增加智能体角色并不自动有益于封闭分类体系的匹配；本工作提供了面向SFIA的层级感知技能抽取首个可复现基线。

Abstract: Automated skill extraction underpins workforce planning, yet most systems represent skills as flat labels with no notion of the responsibility level at which a skill is practiced. The Skills Framework for the Information Age (SFIA) captures exactly this dimension, defining 147 professional skills across seven responsibility levels, but no automated LLM-based extraction targeting SFIA has been reported. We formalize the task as structured prediction of (skill, level) pairs from free text and ask three questions: how accurately can text be mapped onto SFIA's closed vocabulary, which strategies reliably predict the level alongside the skill, and do agentic designs improve on simpler retrieval and prompting? We evaluate five strategies (a lexical baseline, dense retrieval with LLM reranking, a zero-shot schema-constrained LLM, single-agent agentic RAG, and a three-agent retriever--matcher--verifier crew) against expert-mapped European ICT role profiles, all drawing on an SFIA~9 corpus built by a fully automated agentic pipeline that we release. Retrieval-based matching identifies the most skills while generative strategies are markedly more precise; only strategies assigning the level as an explicit decision predict it reliably, with similarity-based selection more than twice as inaccurate; and the crew doubles latency without improving accuracy, so added agent roles do not automatically benefit closed-taxonomy matching. These results provide the first reproducible baseline for structured, level-aware skill extraction against SFIA.

</details>


### [241] [Look What You Made Us Cluster: Hate Narrative Extraction from Reddit Discourse](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37408)
*Annabelle K. L. Chua,Forster J. Khoo,Joel C. R. Tan,Huey Ting Ang,Kheng Hwee Tan,Joel Y. A. Sim,Shirley W. H. Ow,Ria Mundhra,Elsie C. K. Toh,Youfeng Xu,Lynnette H. X. Ng*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出一种将叙事表示为"实体-评价"对的抽取流水线，利用LLM推理扩展方面级情感分析来识别网络仇恨叙事，并通过Leiden聚类与LLM引导的细化实现多粒度叙事发现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有网络仇恨叙事的计算抽取方法依赖语义表示，往往只能捕捉表层含义，导致精度有限，难以识别精确且可解释的叙事。

Method: 以"实体-评价"对表示叙事；用LLM推理扩展ABSA（识别方面、将其判断类型分类作为评价基础、进而推导评价）；用Leiden对抽取的叙事聚类；再通过LLM引导的细化将簇解析到目标粒度。以2024年英文Reddit中批评Taylor Swift的评论为例进行演示。

Result: 在Reddit批评Taylor Swift的评论上运行该流水线，并分析了一个呈现仇恨言论模式的代表性簇，展示了该方法的解释价值。

Conclusion: 将叙事表示为实体-评价对并结合LLM推理与聚类细化，可提升仇恨叙事检测的精度与可解释性，为构建更严谨的检测系统提供支持。

Abstract: Narrative extraction allows us to identify online hate narratives, supporting the construction of rigorous detection systems. Existing computational approaches, however, are limited in precision as they rely on semantic representations, which tend to capture only surface-level meaning. To detect more precise and interpretable narratives, we present an extraction pipeline that represents narratives as entity-evaluation pairs. Narratives are extracted using a Large Language Model (LLM) reasoning process that extends Aspect-Based Sentiment Analysis, identifying the aspect, classifying its judgement type as the basis for evaluation, and deriving the evaluation accordingly. Extracted narratives are then clustered using Leiden, following which clusters are resolved to an intended level of granularity through an LLM-guided refinement process. We illustrate this narrative pipeline with English Reddit comments from 2024 that criticize Taylor Swift, analyzing a representative cluster that exhibits hate speech patterns to demonstrate its interpretive value.

</details>


### [242] [Environment Steering: Using Data Flow Control to Improve Agent Utility and Safety](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35807)
*Charlie Summers,Prajwal Raghunath,Aaditya Pai,Mayur Kulkarni,Zhuo Zhang,Oliver Kennedy,Eugene Wu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出"环境引导(Environment Steering)":在执行环境中于运行时强制安全并引导智能体走向安全替代路径,而非仅封锁动作。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM智能体即使被指示安全行事仍会进行不安全工具调用;现有防御在执行前约束、修改输入输出或依赖LLM评判,依赖模型行为,且封锁不安全动作却无助于智能体恢复。

Method: 将智能体与harness执行状态建模为数据库表,追踪记录级数据流,运行时用声明式策略检查数据流;检测到违规时给出策略与上下文相关的反馈,引导智能体转向安全轨迹。

Result: 在AgentDyn上,相比无防御,提升了任务成功率,同时实现0%攻击成功率。

Conclusion: 安全应作为运行时环境强制属性,通过环境引导在拦截违规的同时帮助智能体恢复,兼顾安全与任务完成。

Abstract: LLM agents can make unsafe tool calls even when instructed to behave safely. Existing defenses constrain agents before execution, modify tool inputs/outputs, or rely on LLM judges; these approaches may depend on model behavior or block unsafe actions without helping the agent recover. We argue that the execution environment should instead enforce safety as the agent runs and steer it toward safe alternatives when violations occur---we call this Environment Steering. We implement this by modeling the agent and harness execution state as database tables, track the record-level data flows, and check these data flows against declarative policies during runtime. When violations are detected, policy- and context-specific feedback steers the agent toward safe trajectories. On AgentDyn, this enables the agent to improve task success rate over no-defense while achieving 0% attack success rate.

</details>


### [243] [When Successful Memories Mislead Embodied Agents:Memory Adaption For Task-Conditioned Execution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35808)
*Quanquan Li,Hongbo Zhang,Yihe Chi,Liuyang Song,Jingyu Li,Yuxiang Huang,Hongzhen Zhang,Guitao Cao*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: MATE是一种确定性的检索后记忆适配方法，将轨迹转化为面向执行的记忆，在ALFWorld上以约1/10 token量取得81.3%/93.3%成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有记忆系统主要优化构建与检索，但检索到的经验可能包含不兼容动作或结构不当，语义相关性和历史成功不足以判断其是否适用于当前执行上下文。

Method: MATE在检索后进行确定性处理：移除过时控制上下文、提取条件-动作-效果转移、执行经验证的动作归一化、选择任务相关表示，并在固定预算下序列化，无需额外LLM推理。

Result: 在134个ALFWorld任务上，Qwen2.5-14B和72B成功率分别为81.3%和93.3%，token用量约为原始轨迹的十分之一；对照实验表明动作归一化是恢复经验效用的关键机制。

Conclusion: 记忆适配应作为检索与具身执行之间的独立阶段。

Abstract: Experience reuse can reduce repeated exploration in embodied agents, but a trajectory that succeeded previously may be unsuitable for the current execution context. Existing memory systems pri marily optimize construction and retrieval; semantic relevance and historical success therefore remain insufficient when retrieved ex perience contains incompatible actions or an inappropriate level of structure. We introduce Memory Adaptation for Task-Conditioned Execution (MATE), a deterministic post-retrieval procedure that converts trajectories into execution-oriented memory. MATE re moves obsolete control context, extracts condition-action-effect transitions, applies verified action normalization, selects a task dependent representation, and serializes the result under a fixed budget without additional LLM inference. On 134 ALFWorld tasks, MATE achieves task success rates of 81.3% and 93.3% with Qwen2.5-14B and 72B while using approximately one-tenth of the tokens required by raw trajectories. Controlled comparisons show that verified action normalization is the principal mechanism by which MATE restores the utility of retrieved experience, support ing memory adaptation as a distinct stage between retrieval and embodied execution.

</details>


### [244] [Can Multimodal Large Language Models Generate and Detect Multimodal Social Media Fake News?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35809)
*Jiyao Yang,Yang Liu,Zhenyue Qin,Qingyu Chen,Xiuzhen Zhang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 论文提出多智能体框架生成多模态假新闻，并评测16个MLLM的检测能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生成式AI快速发展，MLLM可能被滥用于社媒大规模虚假信息传播；现有研究多聚焦文本假新闻，尚不清楚MLLM能否被用来伪造逼真的多模态假新闻，以及能否可靠检测。

Method: 构建由story agent、image agent和critic agent协作的多智能体框架，生成能可信反驳真实新闻的假社媒帖子；应用于科学、健康、娱乐领域，生成超过9000对配对的真假多模态新闻帖子；并对16个开源与闭源MLLM进行自动化检测基准评测。

Result: 大多数MLLM的检测准确率显著低于人类水平，且在识别图像真实性方面存在严重失败。

Conclusion: 研究为开发针对社媒假新闻的稳健防御提供了基础，代码与数据已开源。

Abstract: The rapid advancement of generative AI raises concerns about the misuse of Multimodal LLMs (MLLMs) for large-scale disinformation campaigns on social media. Despite existing research on textual disinformation, a fundamental question remains unanswered: can MLLMs be exploited to fabricate realistic multimodal fake news, and can they reliably detect it? We introduce a multi-agent framework in which a story agent, an image agent, and a critic agent collaborate to produce fake social media posts that plausibly counter true news. We apply the framework to generate over 9,000 paired multimodal news posts across science, health, and entertainment domains, and benchmark 16 open- and closed-source MLLMs for automated detection. We find that most models fall substantially short of human-level accuracy and fail critically on identifying image authenticity. Our research provides a foundation for developing robust defenses against social media fake news. Code and data are available at https: //github.com/xiuzhenzhang/Multimodal.

</details>


### [245] [TRACE: Deployable Tree-Relational Structure Enhancement for Oncology LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35810)
*Jizheng Lai,Yingyun Li,Ying Qin,Haiyang Qian*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: TRACE是一个树-关系增强框架，通过分离离线结构学习与在线轻量推理，为肿瘤学LLM提供可更新的显式医学结构证据，提升准确性与可解释性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM在肿瘤学应用中预测往往缺乏显式医学结构支撑，即预测与医学知识结构的关联较弱，需要更强的结构性地据。

Method: 将肿瘤概念与关系组织为可更新的树-关系结构，利用LM损失派生的证据进行细化，推理时检索为紧凑的提示证据，实现任务自适应证据选择，零样本下无需监督标签。

Result: 在10个肿瘤分类任务和1个MedQuAD CancerGov QA基准上，TRACE在无标签评估和有监督微调中均提升；优于vanilla RAG和通用GraphRAG；在泄漏控制的METABRIC输入下仍有效；产生与临床推理一致的可解释证据路径。

Conclusion: 显式、可更新的医学结构是通向更准确、可审计肿瘤学LLM部署的实用路径。

Abstract: Large language models are increasingly used in oncology applications, but their predictions are often weakly grounded in explicit medical structure. We present TRACE, a deployable tree-relational enhancement framework for oncology LLMs. TRACE separates expensive offline structure learning from lightweight online inference: oncology concepts and relations are organized into an updatable tree-relational structure, refined using LM-loss-derived evidence, and retrieved at inference time as compact prompt evidence. This design supports task-adaptive evidence selection without requiring supervised labels in the zero-shot setting. Across ten oncology classification tasks and one MedQuAD CancerGov QA benchmark, TRACE improves both label-free evaluation and supervised fine-tuning. Additional analyses show that TRACE improves over vanilla RAG and generic GraphRAG, remains useful under leakage-controlled METABRIC inputs, and produces interpretable evidence paths aligned with clinical reasoning. These results suggest that explicit, updatable medical structure is a practical path toward more accurate and auditable oncology LLM deployment.

</details>


### [246] [Lookahead-R: Budget-Aware Tool Retrieval via Execution-Centric Planning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35811)
*Zongze Wu,Yani Guo,Runnan Li*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出Lookahead-R，将工具检索重构为资源受限的序列决策问题，用轻量级执行感知代理世界模型驱动蒙特卡洛树搜索，在ToolBench上取得更优的精度-效率权衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM智能体在大规模异构API生态中面临工具检索瓶颈：语义检索快但存在"语义-功能鸿沟"，执行验证精度高但延迟过大，二者存在固有权衡。

Method: Lookahead-R引入轻量级执行感知代理世界模型，在不调用真实API的情况下联合预测工具执行成功率、延迟成本和语义效用；该模型驱动成本敏感、不确定性引导的蒙特卡洛树搜索，在严格预算约束下导航工具空间。

Result: 在ToolBench基准上所有测试场景均实现更优的精度-效率权衡；在最难的I3划分上NDCG@5达91.40%，超过SOTA的ToolGen（90.16%）1.24%。消融实验表明显式延迟建模是资源约束下识别高质量工具的关键判别信号。

Conclusion: 通过将工具检索建模为资源受限的序列决策并引入执行感知世界模型与MCTS，可在不调用真实API的前提下有效缓解语义-功能鸿沟与执行延迟之间的权衡。

Abstract: Tool retrieval is a critical bottleneck for LLM-based agents operating over large, heterogeneous API ecosystems. Existing approaches face an inherent trade-off: semantic retrievers are fast but suffer from the semantic-functional gap, while execution-based validation improves precision at the cost of prohibitive latency. We propose Lookahead-R, a planning-based framework that reformulates tool retrieval as a resource-constrained sequential decision-making problem. At its core, Lookahead-R introduces a lightweight execution-aware surrogate world model that jointly predicts tool execution success, latency cost, and semantic utility---without invoking real APIs. This world model drives a cost-sensitive, uncertainty-guided Monte Carlo Tree Search that navigates the tool space under strict budget constraints. Evaluated on the large-scale ToolBench benchmark, Lookahead-R achieves a superior accuracy-efficiency trade-off across all test scenarios. On the most challenging I3 split, it attains an NDCG@5 of 91.40\%, outperforming the state-of-the-art ToolGen (90.16\%) by 1.24\%. Ablation studies confirm that explicit latency modeling is the key discriminative signal for identifying high-quality tools under resource constraints.

</details>


### [247] [Automated Evaluation of Multi-Turn Dialogues in In-Car Conversational Assistants](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35812)
*Vaishnav Negi,Lev Sorokin,Soroosh Tayebi Arasteh,Andrea Stocco*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出一个面向车载对话助手(ICA)多轮能力测试的自动化框架，采用黑盒闭环仿真+策略引导用户模拟器+对抗策略管理器+两级LLM评判，在工业ICA上验证有效。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 车载对话助手需在多轮交互、无显式真值、严格安全约束下保证可靠性，但现有评测方法仅针对单轮场景，无法覆盖跨轮次的约束处理、上下文保持和安全关键行为。

Method: 将系统视为黑盒，采用闭环仿真：包含策略引导的用户模拟器、对抗性策略管理器，以及两级LLM评判器（分别评估轮级失败与整段对话质量）。

Result: 在工业级ICA上评估，涉及6个LLM后端和12名人工标注者。自动评判与人类评判高度一致；策略引导相比无引导仿真每段对话多发现2.96倍的独特失败类型，失败对话数量翻倍以上。

Conclusion: 策略引导的自动化多轮测试框架能有效暴露车载对话助手的多样化失败，且自动评判与人工判断一致性良好，适用于安全攸关的车载场景评测。

Abstract: In-car conversational assistants (ICAs) are increasingly integrated into vehicles to support route planning, vehicle control, and information access. Ensuring their reliability is challenging due to multi-turn interactions, the absence of explicit ground truth, and strict safety constraints. Existing evaluation techniques fall short, as they target single-turn settings and fail to capture constraint handling, context retention, and safety-critical behavior across turns. We propose an automated framework for testing the multi-turn conversational capabilities of ICAs. The system is treated as a black box and evaluated via closed-loop simulation with a strategy-guided user simulator, an adversarial strategy manager, and a two-tier LLM judge assessing turn-level failures and conversation-level quality. We evaluate the approach on an industrial ICA with six LLM backends and twelve human annotators. The automated judge shows substantial agreement with humans, and strategy guidance uncovers 2.96 times more unique failure types per conversation and more than doubles the number of unique failing conversations compared to unguided simulation.

</details>


### [248] [Constructing Challenging Browser-Use Tasks by Controlled Environment Interventions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35814)
*Xunjian Yin,Tianchen Guan,Jinao Wang,Weili Cao,Daisy Xinlei Lin,Royce Cheng-Yue,Keagan Long,Kyle Wong,Bhuwan Dhingra,Xiangjun Wang,Shuyan Zhou*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: BreakingWeb 通过“干预”把已有任务转化为可控难度的挑战：保持用户指令、潜在目标与后端成功标准不变，只在 Web 栈不同层改变环境。含 519 对任务、7 个站点、29 类干预族。实验显示干预使 6 个 browser-use agent 平均通过率下降 22.9%，并推翻近半原本可解任务；人类首试仅降 10.0%。主要失败是“信念失败”：75% 的失败以声明成功告终，但所需改变从未发生。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有浏览器 agent benchmark 依赖不断收集新任务/网站/应用来提升难度，导致难度刷新成本高、不可控，且多重因素同时变化时难以判断真正造成困难的原因。作者希望把难度变成可编程的环境属性，而不是不断堆叠新任务。

Method: 提出 BreakingWeb：为每个基础任务配对若干干预条件，保持用户指令、潜在目标和后端成功标准不变，在不同 Web 栈层改变环境。每个干预具有确定性、可检测、可恢复，并标注主要加载的认知原语。构建了 519 个 clean/intervention 任务对，覆盖 7 个自托管网站和 29 类干预族，并按最终结果评分。

Result: 评测 6 个强 browser-use agent、3 个仅看截图的 GUI-only agent 和人类。干预平均使 agent 通过率下降 22.9%，并推翻几乎一半各 agent 原本 clean 可解的任务；人类首试下降 10.0%，一次熟悉尝试后下降 5.7%。主要失败模式是 belief failure：6 个 agent 的失败中 75% 以声明成功结束，但所需改变从未发生。

Conclusion: BreakingWeb 表明可通过环境干预系统性地、可控地制造难度，并揭示当前浏览器 agent 的核心弱点不是执行能力而是信念/状态验证失败：agent 容易误以为任务成功。代码、数据和环境已公开于 www.breakingweb.app。

Abstract: As browser-use agents improve, benchmarks keep pace by collecting new tasks, websites, and applications, often making tasks longer or more novel. This makes difficulty expensive to refresh and difficult to control: when many aspects change at once, it is unclear what actually makes a task challenging. We instead construct challenging instances from tasks agents already solve, turning difficulty into a programmable property of the environment. BreakingWeb pairs every base task with an intervention condition that preserves the user instruction, latent target, and backend success criterion while changing the environment at different web stack layers. Each intervention is deterministic, detectable, and recoverable, and is annotated with the cognitive primitive it primarily loads. The benchmark contains 519 clean/intervention task pairs across seven self-hosted websites and 29 intervention families, all graded against outcomes. We evaluate six strong browser-use agents, three GUI-only agents that see only screenshots, and humans. The construction is effective: interventions cut agent pass rate by 22.9% on average and overturn nearly half of the tasks each agent solves cleanly, whereas humans lose 10.0% on a first attempt and 5.7% after one familiarisation attempt. The dominant failure is belief failure: 75% of the six agents' failures end with a declared success although the required change never happened. Our code, data and environment are publicly available at www.breakingweb.app.

</details>


### [249] [How to Run Statistics over LLM Judges and Trust the Results: Calibrated Inference for Small-Sample AI Evaluation with evalstats](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35815)
*Ian Arawjo*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 论文指出现有基于LLM评委分数和小样本AI评估的显著性声明缺乏校准的置信区间、假设检验与评委偏差校正，提出统计分析方法与evalstats工具包。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 学术界越来越多依赖LLM评委分数和小样本AI评估来支撑显著性结论，但缺少良好校准的置信区间、假设检验和评委偏差校正，导致这些结论不可靠；研究者需要负责任的LLM评委统计分析方法指导。

Method: 1) 揭示对原始LLM评委分数做统计会导致假阳性膨胀，且在许多评分者一致性指标上假阳性风险在"几乎完美"的人机一致性处达到峰值；2) 提供混合人-AI评委设计的统计分析指导与工具；3) 通过预测驱动推断(PPI)实现九种假设检验，包括首次针对四种秩检验(Wilcoxon符号秩、Mann-Whitney U及综合变体)的PPI校正；4) 提出bootstrap自适应功效调优，通过将估计权重向基于标注数据的目标收缩并考虑权重自身抽样方差，使PPI++在小规模人工标注校准集下保持稳定；5) 通过蒙特卡洛模拟给出N<100小样本AI评估中CI、p值与FWER校正方法的选择建议，并警告避免bootstrap CI。

Result: 给出小样本AI评估的方法选择建议；发现一个真实LLM评委在"substantial agreement"验证下会导致研究者发表虚假发现；打包为开源Python包evalstats，可自动选择校准方法，并在三个场景中验证。

Conclusion: 研究者应使用经校准的统计方法（如PPI校正、bootstrap自适应功效调优、非bootstrap CI），并通过evalstats自动选择合适方法，以避免LLM评委与小样本评估中的假阳性与不可靠结论。evalstats已在GitHub公开。

Abstract: Researchers across academia increasingly base significance claims on LLM judge scores and small-sample AI evaluations. Yet without well-calibrated confidence intervals (CIs), hypothesis tests, and judge-bias corrections, such claims are unreliable. We address these issues in several contributions. First, we find that running statistics over raw LLM judge scores leads to inflated false positives: counterintuitively, for many inter-rater agreement metrics, false positive risk peaks at "almost perfect" human-LLM agreement. To help researchers understand how to run statistics over LLM judges responsibly, we present guidance and tooling for the statistical analysis of mixed human-AI judge designs, and implement nine hypothesis tests via prediction-powered inference (PPI), including the first known PPI corrections for four rank-based tests (Wilcoxon signed-rank, Mann-Whitney U, and omnibus variants). To keep PPI++ stable with small human-labeled calibration sets, we introduce bootstrap-adaptive power tuning, which shrinks the estimated weight toward a target estimated from the labeled data, and accounts for that weight's own sampling variance. Second, through Monte Carlo simulations, we derive recommendations for what CI, p-value, and FWER correction methods to use for small-sample AI evaluations (N<100), and warn researchers against bootstrap CIs. We package these recommendations into evalstats, an open-source Python package that selects calibrated methods automatically, and demonstrate it in three scenarios, including one where a real LLM judge validated at "substantial agreement" would have led a researcher to publish a spurious finding. evalstats is publicly available at https://github.com/ianarawjo/evalstats.

</details>


### [250] [PrimeSeeker: Capability-Oriented Supervision for Deep Search Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35816)
*Linzhi Peng,Hanting Chen,Heng Chang,Ke Cheng,Bowen Du,Weifeng Lv*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出latent anchor reasoning检索原语与PrimeSeeker框架，通过构建可解锚点结构与参考证据骨架来训练搜索智能体，在五个深度搜索基准上以更少工具调用取得强性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有搜索智能体训练用更大的证据图、更多跳数和更长轨迹来提升难度，但这些全局属性只是局部检索能力的间接代理，与搜索所需的实际检索能力不匹配。

Method: 提出latent anchor reasoning：从描述性规格中解析未命名检索锚点并迁移到后续信息需求，将深度搜索分解为耦合操作链。据此构建PrimeSeeker框架，生成基于网络的锚点结构，联合推导问题与参考证据骨架；骨架保留支持证据并通过当前工具观测的抽取高亮指导专家生成，训练前移除高亮，RL阶段复用骨架审计参考步骤覆盖度作为奖励。

Result: 构建9,221条专家轨迹，训练30B搜索智能体；在五个深度搜索基准上表现强劲，参考步骤优化进一步提升监督策略，轨迹检索冗余低，固定预算下以远少于长程系统的工具调用实现强解覆盖。

Conclusion: 以能力为导向的锚点推理建模优于依赖全局难度的合成数据构建，可提升检索效率与解覆盖，为训练高效深度搜索智能体提供新范式。

Abstract: Large language model search agents are often trained with synthetic questions whose difficulty is increased through larger evidence graphs, additional hops, and longer trajectories. These global properties, however, are only indirect proxies for the local retrieval capabilities required during search. To address this mismatch, we introduce latent anchor reasoning, which consists of resolving an unnamed retrieval anchor from descriptive specifications and transferring the recovered anchor into a subsequent information demand. This primitive retrieval unit decomposes deep search into chains of coupled operations and organizes question construction around anchor resolution and relation transfer, without prescribing a canonical search path. Based on this formulation, we propose PrimeSeeker, a capability-oriented framework that constructs web-grounded anchor structures and jointly derives a question and a reference evidence skeleton. The skeleton preserves supporting evidence from construction and guides expert generation through extractive highlights of current tool observations. These highlights are removed before supervised fine-tuning, while the skeleton is subsequently reused to audit reference-step coverage for reinforcement-learning rewards. We construct 9,221 expert trajectories, training a 30B search agent. Across five deep-search benchmarks, PrimeSeeker achieves strong performance, while reference-step optimization further improves the supervised policy. The resulting trajectories exhibit low retrieval redundancy, and fixed-budget evaluation shows strong solution coverage with substantially fewer tool calls than long-horizon systems.

</details>


### [251] [Less Uniform Discrete Diffusion is More Powerful and Scalable](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35817)
*Kaibo Wang,Ding Ding,Fangyu Ding,Zijin Feng,Han Shi,Haili Bai,Jiacheng Sun,Yang Xiang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出统一扩散语言模型框架 LUDI，通过"非均匀损失"与"逐 token 时间嵌入"解决过均匀训练目标和采样时条件-目标混淆问题，并在 7B 规模上验证其少步生成与复杂推理能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 统一扩散语言模型（UDLM）虽有前景，但难以扩展。作者指出核心障碍有二：(1) 训练目标过度均匀；(2) 采样过程中条件与目标混淆。

Method: 提出 LUDI 框架：(i) 设计"less uniform loss"，使每个反向转移直接指向干净 token；(ii) 引入逐 token 时间嵌入，提供 token 级损坏提示，从而支持基于置信度的少步采样。此外将 7B 自回归模型继续训练为 LUDI-7B。

Result: 在不同规模实验中，LUDI 提供更干净的监督信号并改善少步生成。LUDI-7B 相较 AR 解码实现 3 token/步的加速，且与掩码扩散基线性能相当，并具备复杂推理能力。

Conclusion: UDLM 在复杂生成任务上的全部潜力尚未被充分挖掘，LUDI 展示了向该方向推进的可行性。

Abstract: Although uniform diffusion language models (UDLMs) represent a promising diffusion paradigm, scaling them remains challenging. We identify the core obstacle as an over-uniform training objective and condition-target confusion during sampling. To address these, we propose Less Uniform Diffusion (LUDI), a novel UDLM framework. Specifically, we (i) introduce a less uniform loss that directs each reverse transition toward the clean token, and (ii) equip the model with per-token time embeddings that supply token-level corruption hints, enabling confidence-based few-step sampling. Experiments across scales show that LUDI yields cleaner supervision and improves few-step generation. We further continue-train a 7B autoregressive model into LUDI-7B, resulting in a UDLM capable of complex reasoning. It achieves a 3-token-per-step speedup over AR decoding and competitive performance compared with masked diffusion baselines, revealing that the full potential of UDLMs for complex generation remains to be unlocked.

</details>


### [252] [$τ$-Multilingual: Benchmarking Voice Agents Across Languages](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35820)
*Soham Ray,Edgard dos Santos Paiva,Ruben Valenzuela,Karthik Narasimhan,Keshav Dhandhania,Victor Barres*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出 τ-Multilingual 多语言语音代理评测基准，覆盖西/葡/印地/韩/普通话，发现韩、普通话任务完成率显著下降且失败模式各异，主张任务/交互/生成分开报告。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基准以英语为主，无法全面反映语音代理的真实多语言行为，需要母语者参与的多语言评测来揭示语言相关的性能差异与失败模式。

Method: 将 τ-Voice 扩展到西班牙语、巴西葡萄牙语、印地语、韩语和普通话，加入母语者审校，并评测生成语言与语音输出；基于 4500 次全双工通话和五种语音配置进行评估。

Result: 西/葡/印地语任务完成率与英语差距在 3.2 分以内，韩语和普通话分别下降 14.7 和 8.4 分；韩语系统漏答更多、普通话系统打断更多，两者在工具与实体处理上均较弱；Grok 任务完成领先但生成质量最低。

Conclusion: 多语言语音代理性能存在显著语言差异与不同失败模式，应分别报告任务、交互与生成指标；发布语言包、验证评委与工具以推动社区多语言评测。

Abstract: English-only benchmarks expose only a narrow slice of voice-agent behavior. We introduce $τ$-Multilingual, extending $τ$-Voice to Spanish, Brazilian Portuguese, Hindi, Korean, and Mandarin with native-speaker review and evaluation of generated language and spoken output. Across 4,500 full-duplex calls and five voice configurations, Spanish, Portuguese, and Hindi remain within 3.2 task-completion points of English, but Korean and Mandarin fall by 14.7 and 8.4 points. The failure modes also vary: Korean systems miss more responses, Mandarin systems interrupt more often, and both struggle with tools and entities. Grok leads task completion but scores lowest on generation quality, motivating separate task, interaction, and generation reporting. We release language packs, validated judges, and tools for community-built multilingual voice-agent evaluation.

</details>


### [253] [Can We Still Trust Disaster Social Sensing? Empirical Evidence on Detecting AI-Generated Social Media Posts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35821)
*Xiaoshan Zhou,Zaifu Zhan*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文检验文本AI检测器能否可靠区分人类撰写与AI生成的灾害社交媒体帖子，发现现有检测器跨模型泛化性能接近随机，不足以作为运营级信任门控。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 灾害社会感知依赖社交媒体证据进行态势感知与人道需求评估，但生成式AI可产出貌似真实目击报告的虚假信息，因此需要判断文本AI检测器是否可靠。

Method: 构建12,000条文本、3,000个语义匹配单元的九类灾害数据集（人类原文H0、经LLM校对的人类文本H1、基于事实的AI生成文本A0、情感化AI文本A1），另有6,000条来自42个事件的语料用于模型选择与阈值校准；评估OSM-Det、Fast-DetectGPT、Binoculars及直接LLM评判器，并进行灾害域校准、冻结编码器线性读出、配对变换敏感性及数据集伪影控制实验。

Result: 14个冻结跨家族配置AUROC仅0.402-0.517，最佳前瞻召回率3.6%；OSM-Det AUROC 0.521、召回10.4%（假阳性6.7%）。灾害训练线性头AUROC达0.817，但七特征表面分类器在H0-vs-A0上达0.784，消除表面差异后线性头从0.733降至0.594；该头还能区分来源相同的A0与A1。

Conclusion: 文本检测不足以作为运营信任门控，应依赖多模态证据、可问责来源及其他情境证据来保障灾害社会感知的可信度。

Abstract: Disaster social sensing converts public social-media posts into evidence for situational awareness and humanitarian needs, but generative artificial intelligence (AI) can produce plausible messages that resemble eyewitness reports. This study investigates whether text-based AI detectors can reliably distinguish human-authored from AI-generated disaster posts. We construct a dataset of 12,000 texts organised into 3,000 matched semantic units from nine disasters: original human posts (H0), minimally LLM-proofread human posts (H1), factual AI-generated posts based on the same verified facts (A0), and affectively framed versions of those AI posts (A1). A separate 6,000-text corpus from 42 events supports model selection and threshold calibration. We evaluate OSM-Det, Fast-DetectGPT, Binoculars, and direct large language model (LLM) judges across five model families, then test disaster-domain calibration, a frozen-encoder linear readout, paired transformation sensitivity, and dataset artifact controls. Across fourteen frozen cross-family configurations, AUROC is 0.402-0.517 and the best prospective recall at a calibration-derived low-false-positive operating point is 3.6%; OSM-Det reaches AUROC 0.521 and 10.4% recall at a realised 6.7% false-positive rate. A disaster-trained linear head reaches AUROC 0.817, but a seven-feature surface classifier reaches 0.784 on the H0-versus-A0 contrast, and neutralising identified surface asymmetries reduces the head from 0.733 to 0.594. The head also separates A0 from A1 even though provenance is unchanged. The results show that text-based detection is not reliable enough to serve as an operational trust gate; multimodal claims, accountable sources, and other contextual evidence should be rested on to safeguard trust in disaster social sensing.

</details>


### [254] [Tracing mechanisms of sycophantic agreement in language models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35822)
*Sixing Chen,Zhuofan Josh Ying,Logan Riggs Smith,Jeremy Wertheimer,Natalie Shapira*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文用因果中介分析揭示语言模型谄媚性认同的机制：用户观点早期被注入最后一个提示词的残差流，通过稀疏的早期注意力头携带并偏置答案检索。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 谄媚性认同（过度附和用户信念而牺牲事实准确性）虽被广泛视为对齐失败，但其底层机制尚不清楚，阻碍了针对性干预。

Method: 采用因果中介分析（causal mediation analysis），识别观点信号如何进入残差流、由哪些注意力头携带，并通过消融（ablation）验证其因果作用。

Result: 观点在早期即被写入最后提示词的残差流并偏置后续答案检索；一组稀疏的早期注意力头携带该信号，消融后大幅降低谄媚而基本保留事实准确性。显式观点无论表述方式如何均由同一组头承载；而当观点通过无内容的施压（如"你确定吗？"）隐式传达时，则由另一组不同的头抑制原正确答案以推出修改后的答案。

Conclusion: 该研究提供了观点如何诱发谄媚性认同的机制性解释，为更精准、可靠的对齐干预奠定基础。

Abstract: Sycophantic agreement in language models refers to the tendency to overly affirm a user's stated beliefs or preferences, often at the expense of factual accuracy. Although it is widely recognized as an alignment failure, its underlying mechanisms remain poorly understood. In this work, we use causal mediation analysis to identify the mechanisms behind sycophantic agreement. We show that a stated opinion is incorporated into the residual stream of the final prompt token early, where it biases subsequent answer retrieval. A sparse set of early attention heads carries this opinion signal. Ablating these heads substantially reduces sycophancy while leaving factual accuracy largely intact. The same heads carry the opinion when it is explicitly stated, regardless of how it is phrased. When an opinion is not stated explicitly but instead conveyed through content-free pushback (e.g., ``Are you sure?"), we find a distinct set of heads that suppresses the model's original correct answer to promote a revised answer. By providing a mechanistic account of how opinions induce sycophantic agreement, this work takes a step toward developing more targeted and reliable alignment interventions.

</details>


### [255] [Reliable but Design-Sensitive: Instrument Uncertainty in LLM Annotation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35824)
*Thomas Reiter,Christoph Kern,Fedor Miasnikov,Sofiia Nikolenko,Rob Chew,Stephanie Eckman,Frauke Kreuter*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该论文提出"工具不确定性"（instrument uncertainty）概念：LLM在不同任务设计和模型选择下对同一批推文的标注结果存在显著差异，这种差异远超采样方差，且置信度无法解决该问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM可在一种设置下给出可靠标签，但当研究者做出其他合理设计选择时标签会改变。作者希望量化并揭示这种由任务设计和模型选择引起的不稳定性，填补对LLM标注可靠性认知的空白。

Method: 测试7个LLM、12种任务设计、3次独立运行，对3000条推文进行攻击性语言和仇恨言论标注；对比相同设置重复、改变任务设计、以及5种人类工具版本下的结果；并检验置信度分数是否可缓解问题。

Result: 同一设置重复一致性高（中位Fleiss' κ=0.91）；改变任务设计后一致性下降（中位Cohen's κ=0.76）。任务设计与模型选择使估计流行率的方差相对于单纯采样方差增加76.7倍（攻击性语言）和110.6倍（仇恨言论）。LLM任务设计间变异达560-572基点，人类工具版本仅270-331基点。置信度未解决问题：更贴近重复模型输出而非人类标签一致性，且单提示打包6条推文使平均置信度降低660基点。

Conclusion: 由任务设计和模型选择导致的变异称为"工具不确定性"，只能通过比较多种合理任务设计来测量；重复单一设置或依赖置信度分数无法替代该检验。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) can give reliable labels under one setup yet change those labels when researchers make other reasonable design choices. We tested seven LLMs, 12 task designs, three independent runs, and 3,000 tweets labeled for offensive language and hate speech. Repeating the same model and task design produced high agreement (median Fleiss' $κ= 0.91$). Agreement fell when we changed the task design for the same tweets (median Cohen's $κ= 0.76$). Task design and model choice increased the variance of estimated prevalence by factors of 76.7 for offensive language and 110.6 for hate speech compared with sampling variance alone. Variation across LLM task designs reached 560-572 basis points, compared with 270-331 basis points across five human instrument versions. Confidence scores did not solve this problem. They tracked repeated model outputs more closely than agreement with human labels, and grouping six tweets in one prompt lowered mean offensive-language confidence by 660 basis points. We call the variation caused by task design and model choice instrument uncertainty. Researchers can measure it only by comparing reasonable task designs. Repeating one setup or relying on confidence scores cannot replace that test.

</details>


### [256] [Beyond the Context Window: An Adaptive Entropy-Based Routing Framework for Hybrid Retrieval and Long-Context Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35831)
*Isaac Olufadewa,Miracle Adesina,Ezekiel Oladejo,Owen Adeniyi,Fadare Fadekemi,Olamide Oso,Uthman Babatunde,Matthew Olawoyin*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出EDAR框架，用预测熵在推理时决定RAG或长上下文处理，保留97.4%准确率并降低70.7%token消耗。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长上下文窗口虽大但昂贵且对中间信息关注不足；纯RAG快但受检索质量限制。需在两者间自适应选择。

Method: 基于RAG响应前几个生成token的预测熵做路由决策，阈值在验证集上通过成本-准确率权衡扫描确定。

Result: 预测熵与幻觉率强相关(r=0.85)；在LongBench v2和Infinity-Bench上保留纯LC基线97.4%准确率，token消耗降70.7%，仅升级18.2%查询，准确率差距统计不显著。

Conclusion: 预测熵是有效的模型内部路由信号，基于阈值的混合系统能以低代价恢复大部分长上下文准确率，且不依赖特定检索器或LC骨干，无需额外监督。

Abstract: Modern large language models now support context windows of more than one million tokens, which has raised the question of whether retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) is still necessary.
