Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文通过28个语言-任务对（MasakhaNEWS新闻主题分类16种语言、AfriSenti推文情感12种语言）实证研究了非洲语言文本分类的两个核心问题：需要多少标注样本，以及能否跨语言复用标签。使用字符n-gram线性模型，无需预训练权重和GPU。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 非洲语言文本分类面临预算问题：需要多少标注样本，其他非洲语言的标签能否替代。研究者希望为缺乏GPU和预训练资源的团队提供实证性标注指导。

Method: 采用字符n-gram线性模型，双CPU核心数秒内训练，无预训练权重、无加速器。对28个语言-任务对（MasakhaNEWS 16种语言新闻主题分类，AfriSenti 12种语言推文情感）进行单语学习曲线分析（预算25至数千标注），并构建完整的零样本迁移矩阵，考察跨语言池化数据的效果。

Result: 主题分类中位数语言约400标注即达全量macro-F1的90%；情感分类在12种语言中11种全量训练仍在提升。池化其他语言全量训练数据在小预算下价值大：25目标标注时新闻平均提升0.20 macro-F1（Lingala最高0.43），情感提升0.08；800标注后增益归零；全量时池化在新闻9/16、情感8/12语言中反而有害。25目标标注加池化数据可匹配新闻语言100-400单语标注效果。零样本迁移仅恢复中位数13%（新闻）、4%（情感）的差距，例外由共享文字（阿姆哈拉语/提格里尼亚语）、共享词汇（英语/尼日利亚皮钦语、阿拉伯方言）或标签先验解释，而非语言系属。

Conclusion: 跨语言标签复用在小预算下有效但随标注增多迅速衰减甚至有害；零样本迁移效果有限且由文字、词汇、标签先验而非语言系属驱动。作者发布可复现代码，并为无GPU的非洲语言分类团队提供具体标注指导。

Abstract: Every text classifier for an African language begins with a budgeting question: how many labelled examples are needed, and can labels from other African languages stand in for them? We answer both questions empirically for 28 language-task pairs, news topic classification in 16 languages (MasakhaNEWS) and tweet sentiment in 12 languages (AfriSenti), using a character n-gram linear model that trains in seconds on two CPU cores with no pretrained weights and no accelerator. Monolingual learning curves at budgets from 25 to several thousand labels show that topic classification reaches 90\% of its full-data macro-F1 with about 400 labels in the median language, while sentiment is still improving at the full training size in 11 of 12 languages and needs thousands of labels. Pooling the full training data of the other languages in the benchmark is worth a great deal at small budgets and nothing at large ones: at 25 target labels it adds 0.20 macro-F1 on average for news (up to 0.43 for Lingala) and 0.08 for sentiment, the gain decays to zero by 800 labels, and at full size pooling hurts in 9 of 16 and 8 of 12 languages. Twenty-five target labels plus pooled data match what 100 to 400 monolingual labels achieve for most news languages. A complete zero-shot transfer matrix shows that transfer without any target labels recovers a median of only 13\% (news) and 4\% (sentiment) of the gap between a majority-class predictor and the in-language model, with the exceptions explained by shared script (Amharic and Tigrinya), shared lexicon (English and Nigerian Pidgin, the Arabic dialects), or a shared label prior rather than by language family. We release code that regenerates every number from the public benchmark files and translate the results into concrete annotation guidance for teams building African-language classifiers without GPUs.

</details>


### [366] [Zero-shot Dependency Parsing with Unsupervised Cross-Lingual Bootstrapping](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37883)
*Lalita Lowphansirikul,Attapol Rutherford,Jian Gang Ngui,Sarana Nutanong,Peerat Limkonchotiwat*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出跨语言无监督自举方法，提升预训练语言模型在依存句法分析中的零样本跨语言迁移能力，尤其改善低资源语言表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于编码器的PLM在零样本跨语言迁移中表现优异，但在依存句法分析上因句法特性而难以奏效，需增强模型对跨语言句法结构的泛化能力。

Method: 提出一种跨语言无监督自举（bootstrapping）方法，在预训练语言模型内部强化句法知识。

Result: 在低资源语言的零样本句法分析性能上取得显著提升；参数无关的树探针测试（tree probing）得分更高，表明对句法结构的识别鲁棒性增强。

Conclusion: 自举后的模型具备更强的句法结构识别能力，验证了该方法在提升零样本跨语言依存句法分析方面的有效性。

Abstract: Pre-trained language models (PLMs) with encoder-based architectures have shown impressive capabilities in zero-shot cross-lingual transfer for various language understanding tasks. However, applying this technique to dependency parsing remains a significant challenge due to its syntactic nature. To boost model generalizability across linguistic typologies, we propose a cross-lingual unsupervised bootstrapping method to improve syntactic knowledge within the PLM. We show that our method achieves a significant improvement in zero-shot parsing performance in low-resource languages. Analysis of these bootstrapped models uncovers increased robustness in recognizing syntactic structures, evidenced by higher scores in parameter-free tree probing tests.

</details>


### [367] [It's All Training: A Fully Synthetic Single-Stage Recipe for LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37891)
*Pierre-Carl Langlais,Pieter Delobelle,Yannick Detrois,Pavel Chizhov,Carlos Rosas-Hinostroza,Neil Si Smail,Benjamin Burtin,Hanna Shcharbakova,Ivan Yamshchikov,Anastasia Stasenko*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出 SYNTH，首个开源合成语料库，将预训练、中期训练和后训练合并为单一训练阶段，用更少token训练出有竞争力的模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有预训练数据来自网络爬取，存在缺陷且缺乏显式推理，不适合中后训练管线；前沿实验室自建内部合成数据集但均不公开，合成数据对模型知识与技能获取的影响尚不清楚。

Method: 基于 58,698 篇维基百科文章构建 SYNTH，通过结构化放大精选百科种子数据，把预/中/后训练坍缩为单一阶段；训练 Monad(56M)、Baguettotron(0.3B-0.6B) 及 13B/1B-active MoE 等模型进行评估。

Result: 等算力下 SYNTH 优于过滤后的网络数据，模型与同规模开源权重基线竞争力相当；因回译自基于事实的段落，训练token少 10-140 倍仍具高事实精度；已公开 SYNTH 数据集和 Baguettotron 模型。

Conclusion: 合成数据能用少量训练数据产生有竞争力的通用模型，实现快速迭代；有望提升数据效率的通用模型，以及无指令/对话数据的领域专用模型。

Abstract: Current pre-training datasets are derived from web crawls, with all their issues, and were not designed to support mid- and post-training pipelines--for instance, they contain little explicit reasoning. Thus, many frontier labs have begun to develop their own internal datasets, starting from state-of-the-art models, to augment their pre-training data mix, eg, with reasoning traces to address cold-start problems. While demonstratively effective, none of these datasets are public, and the effect of this so-called synthetic data on knowledge and skill acquisition of language models, including small ones, remains poorly understood. We present SYNTH, the first open-source synthetic corpus derived from 58,698 Wikipedia articles that collapses pre-, mid-, and post-training into a single training stage via structured amplification of curated encyclopedic seeds. We evaluate SYNTH by training a suite of models: a 56M tiny model (Monad), 0.3B-0.6B dense models (Baguettotron), and a 13B / 1B-active MoE. At iso-compute, SYNTH outperforms filtered web data, and our models remain competitive with similarly-sized open-weight baselines. Because SYNTH is back-translated from grounded passages, SYNTH-trained models achieve high factual precision despite 10-140x fewer training tokens, with memorization targeted by the seed corpus. These results show that synthetic datasets, including our SYNTH dataset, are capable of producing competitive generalist models from a fraction of the training data, enabling rapid iteration as the frontier advances. These findings open up possibilities for both generalist models with significantly increased data efficiency, as well as domain-specific models where no instruction or conversational data is available. Finally, we publicly release our SYNTH dataset and the suite of Baguettotron models under a permissive license, thus supporting open-source language model development.

</details>


### [368] [The Unequal Influence of Bad Advice: Using Training Data Attribution to Modulate Emergent Misalignment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37914)
*Gonçalo Paulo,Louis Jaburi,Nora Belrose,Lucia Quirke,Stella Biderman*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文用训练数据归因量化每个有害样本对"涌现失配"(EM)的贡献，并通过重训练验证归因质量，发现基于分数过滤数据可显著增强或减弱EM，且影响分数在同模型上过滤效果最佳。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 微调大模型于狭窄、失配任务会破坏对齐并产生新失配行为（EM），其与"邪恶人格"表示相关，但尚不清楚哪些训练数据属性驱动该效应：是否所有有害样本贡献相同、不同模型是否同样受影响。

Method: 使用训练数据归因（influence scores）定量估计每个有害样本对EM的贡献；通过重训练基准归因质量，按分数过滤数据以增强或减弱EM；并与黑盒有害性分数对比，测试跨模型泛化。

Result: 基于分数的过滤能显著增强或减弱EM；数据归因分数与黑盒有害性分数均能识别关键样本；所有被测模型在相同数据集训练后都会失配；影响分数在同模型过滤时表现最佳，跨三个模型家族有泛化但无法恢复同模型过滤性能。

Conclusion: 并非所有有害样本贡献相同，归因可识别关键样本；影响分数具有模型特异性，同模型过滤效果最优，跨模型泛化有限。

Abstract: Fine-tuning large language models on narrow, misaligned tasks can undo their post-training alignment and induce novel misaligned behaviors -- a phenomenon known as \emph{emergent misalignment} (EM). EM has been linked to persona-like representations, where fine-tuning might reduce loss by amplifying a harmful or 'evil' persona. It remains unclear which properties of the training data drive this effect: whether all harmful examples contribute approximately equally to misalignment and whether different models are equally affected by the same fine-tuning examples. In this work, we use training data attribution to quantitatively estimate how much each harmful example contributes to EM. We benchmark the quality of the attribution via retraining -- a sound attribution score should enable us to enhance or attenuate EM by filtering data on that score. Score-based filtering can substantially enhance or attenuate EM; we find that both data-attribution scores and a black-box harmfulness score can identify consequential examples. All models we test become misaligned when trained on the same dataset, and influence scores perform best when filtering data from the same model that computed them. We find cross-model generalization of influence scores from scores derived from the three model families we tested, but this generalization does not recover same model filtering performance.

</details>


### [369] [Learning What to Remember: Long-horizon Counterfactual Memory Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37930)
*Jiaming Tang,Mingyan Liu,Armin Sarabi*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出Memory Gain Policy Optimization (MGPO)，通过边际贡献归因来学习"该记住什么"，在文档级信息抽取任务中提升效果并将记忆长度缩短近80%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 持久文本记忆让语言模型能跨长交互传递信息，但"学什么该记"本质是信用分配难题：一次记忆改写可能多步后才见效，且其效用常继承自改写前已存的信息，导致难以判断改写的真实价值。

Method: MGPO将每次记忆改写的增量价值单独隔离，只依据其对当前与未来下游效用的边际贡献进行奖励分配，从而把延迟的记忆效用转化为直接的学习信号；在文档级信息抽取任务上验证，因结构化监督使单次记忆更新的效果可直接测量。

Result: MGPO提升了抽取性能，同时相对优化前的初始记忆策略将平均记忆长度减少近80%；学到的记忆策略还支持跨领域、跨下游模型的复用与迁移，无需额外训练。

Conclusion: 有效的记忆学习不仅在于保留有用信息，更在于识别哪些记忆更新能带来持久的增量价值。

Abstract: Persistent textual memory allows language models to carry information across long interactions, but learning what to remember is fundamentally a credit-assignment problem. A memory rewrite may only become useful many steps later, while much of the observed utility may be inherited from information already stored before the rewrite. We introduce Memory Gain Policy Optimization (MGPO), which isolates the incremental value of each memory rewrite by crediting it for its marginal contribution to current and future downstream utility. This turns delayed memory utility into a direct learning signal for optimizing what information should persist. We study MGPO on document-level information extraction, where structured supervision makes the effects of individual memory updates directly measurable. MGPO improves extraction while reducing average memory length by nearly 80% relative to the initial memory policy before optimization. The learned memory policy also supports reuse and transfer across domains, downstream models without further training. These results show that effective memory learning depends not only on preserving useful information, but on identifying which memory updates create lasting incremental value.

</details>


### [370] [BITEM at the NTCIR-19 R2C2 Task: Predicting Confidence from Agentic RAG Pipeline Signals](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37993)
*Julien Knafou,Luc Mottin,Alexandre Flament,Paul van Rijen,Esteban Gaillac,Patrick Ruch*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: BITEM团队用单一智能体流水线参加NTCIR-19 R2C2两个子任务：模型在电影语料上检索、阅读并记录证据，编排器负责裁定可提交内容。检索两跑分列22队中第4、5名，合并多次通过提升0.0709 nDCG@20；答案准确率0.9219（第6/25），HMR 0.4915（第13）；基于记录信号手工加规则后升至准确率0.9375（第5）、HMR 0.6985（第9）。作者提出accHMR=准确率×HMR以修正仅按HMR排名的偏差。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: HMR只奖惩置信度与对错的一致性，可能奖励"答错但低置信"的系统，因此需要一种将奖励与准确率成比例结合的指标，并探索用流水线自身产生的数值训练模型而非手工写规则。

Method: 单智能体流水线：模型在电影语料中搜索、阅读、记录证据，编排器持有记录并裁定提交。论断须经蕴含级联验证其引用段落后方可采纳，答案须有足够已核实证据支撑才发布。每问运行3-4次，每轮从未见过前几轮内容的裁剪语料中检索。置信度由编排器根据运行留下的记录计算，不询问模型也不让其自评。另手工编写少量基于已记录信号的规则，无需额外模型调用或检索。

Result: 检索两跑分列22队中第4、5名；合并各轮带来0.0709 nDCG@20增益，在多跳和后处理密集问题上增益最大（主办方将合并跑列该领域第一）。25个答案跑中16个基于这两跑提供的段落，其中12个由他队提交。准确率0.9219（第6/25），HMR 0.4915（第13）；修订规则后准确率0.9375（第5），HMR 0.6985（第9），accHMR 0.6549（第5）。

Conclusion: 该智能体流水线在检索与答案生成上均有竞争力，尤其多跳问题；手工规则可显著提升HMR而不需额外模型调用。作者指出仅按HMR排名存在偏差，提出accHMR；未来工作应基于流水线已产生的数值拟合模型，而非手工编写规则。

Abstract: The BITEM team entered both subtasks of the NTCIR-19 R2C2 task with a single agentic pipeline, in which a model searches, reads and records evidence over a movie corpus while an orchestrator holds the record and rules on what may be submitted. A claim is admitted only once an entailment cascade has checked it against the passage it cites, and an answer is released only once enough checked evidence stands behind it. Each question is run three or four times, every pass retrieving from a corpus stripped of what the earlier passes have already seen. The confidence filed with each answer is computed by the orchestrator from what the run leaves behind and is never asked of the model, which is offered no way to rate itself. The two retrieval runs placed 4th and 5th of 22, pooling the passes was worth 0.0709 nDCG@20, and the gain was largest on the multi-hop and post-processing-heavy questions, where the organisers rank the pooled run top of the field. Sixteen of the 25 answer runs were built on passages these two runs supplied, 12 of them filed by other teams. HMR rewards a system whose confidence is high where it answers right and low where it answers wrong. The pipeline reached an accuracy of 0.9219, 6th of 25, while the confidence filed with those answers gave an HMR of 0.4915, 13th. A few rules crafted over those same recorded signals, with no further model call and no further retrieval, raise that to an accuracy of 0.9375, 5th, and an HMR of 0.6985, 9th. Ranking on HMR alone can reward a system for answering wrongly with low confidence, so we propose accHMR, the accuracy multiplied by HMR, which reports the reward in proportion to the accuracy, and on which the revised rules would have scored 0.6549, 5th. For future work, fitting a model on the numbers the pipeline already produces, rather than writing such rules by hand, would be a real step forward.

</details>


### [371] [Auditable Long-Term Memory: A Deterministic Retrieval Chain Measured at 479/475 of 500 on LongMemEval-S](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38021)
*Christopher J. Chanhnourack*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 在LongMemEval-S上评测一个可审计的长期记忆系统：检索链在468/470题中召回全部金标会话，462/470生成完整证据包；但headline成绩与Chronos High不可比，且缺少留出集与人工裁决。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 评估一个可审计的长期记忆系统的真实能力，并检验其声明成绩相对于已发表基准（Chronos High 478/500）是否构成优势或等价。

Method: 检索链采用混合候选检索、cross-encoder重排、覆盖率优先的证据包编译与确定性推理脚手架，LLM仅作为可替换的最终reader。在LongMemEval-S的500题上测试，并做第二judge复评、字节相同答案重打分等对照。

Result: 候选池覆盖金标会话468/470，完整证据包462/470。两轮Claude Opus reader得479/500与475/500。grok-4.6-high为476/474，最大推理effort的agentic变体反而退化至461/465。第二judge与headline judge在每轮493/500（98.6%）一致，两轮均给472/500；官方judge对相同答案重打分翻转了3个判决。负对照中verifier修好3个错答但打坏11个正确答。

Conclusion: 因reader版本、评分prompt、可能的数据版本差异及系统内方差，该成绩与Chronos High既不能证明优越也不能证明等价。所有组件在同一500题上开发，无留出评测或独立人工裁决，且存在reader获得额外操作上下文、请求未留存、工具可用性未澄清等问题；作者公开证据包、脚手架、reader输出与judge判决以供再评分。

Abstract: We evaluate an auditable long-term memory system on LongMemEval-S. Its retrieval chain uses hybrid candidate retrieval, cross-encoder reranking, coverage-first packet compilation, and deterministic reasoning scaffolds; an LLM is used only as a replaceable final reader. The chain places all gold sessions in the candidate pool for 468/470 answerable questions and produces gold-complete packets for 462/470. With a Claude Opus reader called through an unpinned CLI alias, two 500-question passes score 479/500 and 475/500 under GPT-4o. The 72 answerable knowledge-update rows used a substantively modified scoring prompt whose effect under the official text has not been measured. The pair straddles Chronos High's published 478/500; differences in reader generation, scoring prompt, and possibly data version, plus within-system variance, establish neither superiority nor equivalence. A grok-4.6-high reader on the same packets scores 476/474, while a maximum-reasoning-effort agentic variant regresses to 461/465. The headline passes differ on eight verdict-flip rows. A second judge agrees with the headline judge on 493/500 rows (98.6%) in each pass and scores both passes 472/500; the official judge also flips three verdicts when re-scoring byte-identical pass-1 answers. Negative controls rejected a verifier that repaired three wrong drafts but broke eleven correct drafts. All components were developed on the same 500 questions, with no held-out evaluation or independent human adjudication; retrieval and scaffold method sources and transcript-derived audits are held; and the headline reader received extra operator context, its complete requests were not retained, and MCP tool availability is unresolved. We release materialized packets, scaffolds, reader outputs, judge verdicts, and controls for inspection and re-scoring.

</details>


### [372] [Layer-Informed Fine-Tuning via Three-Stage Functional Segmentation of LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38027)
*Junning Shao,Siwei Wang,Zhixuan Fang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出假设：LLM层可分“概念化—推理—文本化”三阶段分工，用敏感性分析定位任务关键瓶颈层，仅微调这些层（LIFT），加速训练并提升性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM在推理任务上表现优异甚至超越人类，但学界对其内部结构与参数如何逐步解决复杂推理问题缺乏清晰理解。

Method: 以跨语言材料为对象研究LLM推理过程，提出概念化、推理、文本化的分层分工假设；基于敏感性分析设计瓶颈识别机制，定位任务最关键功能阶段；据此提出LIFT方法，选择性地只更新功能关键层。

Result: 大量实验表明，LIFT不仅加快训练过程，还显著提升模型性能。

Conclusion: LLM层存在结构化功能分工，定位并微调关键层可实现高效且有效的推理能力优化。

Abstract: In recent years, the performance of large language models (LLMs) on reasoning tasks has been remarkable, even surpassing human capabilities on various benchmarks. However, there remains a lack of clear understanding in the academic community regarding how the structure and internal parameters of LLMs progressively solve complex reasoning problems. In this study, we investigate the inference process of LLMs on cross-linguistic materials and propose the hypothesis that LLM layers exhibit a structured division of labor across conceptualization, reasoning, and textualization. Based on this hypothesis, we introduce a bottleneck identification mechanism using sensitivity analysis to pinpoint the most critical functional stage for a specific task. Leveraging this insight, we propose a novel approach, Layer-Informed Fine-Tuning (LIFT), which achieves efficient and effective fine-tuning by selectively updating only these functionally critical layers. We then conduct extensive experiments to show that the LIFT method not only accelerates the training process but also significantly improves model performance.

</details>


### [373] [Gender bias across LLMs is common and highly heterogenous](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38036)
*Edoardo Bolzoni,Valerio Capraro*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该研究评估了九个厂商的十个大语言模型在性别归因与道德判断任务中的性别偏见，发现偏见普遍存在但方向和程度高度异质。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM正被嵌入具有真实后果的决策支持系统，理解其性别偏见日益重要；但既有研究仅覆盖少数模型，无法判断性别偏见的普遍性与跨模型异质性。

Method: 选取2025年4月至2026年6月发布的十个模型（九个厂商），采用两种范式：研究1为对刻板印象短语进行性别归因；研究2为对"为避免灾难性后果而虐待或折磨女性/男性"进行道德判断。

Result: 研究1中，10个模型有2个更常将男性刻板印象短语归因于女性作者，另有3个呈相反模式；研究2中，若干模型表现出与人类"保护女性受害者"倾向方向一致的男性不利不对称，但具体条件因模型而异，另有3个模型在各条件下无差异。

Conclusion: 性别相关偏见在LLM中普遍存在，但方向和幅度高度异质，部分模型甚至完全相反；因此偏见审计应作为持续的、多厂商的过程，而非一次性评估。

Abstract: Understanding gender biases in large language models (LLMs) is increasingly important as these systems become embedded in decision-support tools with real consequences. Prior research has focused only on a small set of models, leaving open the extent to which gender biases are common and heterogeneous across LLMs. We address this gap across ten models released between April 2025 and June 2026, spanning nine vendors, using two paradigms: gender attribution to stereotyped phrases (Study 1) and moral judgment of abuse or torture against a woman or a man to prevent a catastrophic outcome (Study 2). In Study 1, two of ten models attributed masculine-stereotyped phrases to female writers more often than the reverse, while three models showed the opposite pattern. In Study 2, several models converged on a male-disadvantaging asymmetry that was directionally consistent with a documented human tendency to protect female targets from harm, though the specific conditions under which this asymmetry emerged varied by model; three other models, by contrast, showed no variation across conditions. These results indicate that gender-related biases are common in LLMs. Their direction and magnitude, however, are highly heterogeneous, to the point that some models behave in diametrically opposite ways to others. Bias auditing should therefore be treated as an ongoing, multi-vendor process, rather than a one-time assessment.

</details>


### [374] [Correct Answers, Invalid Traces: What Verifiable Grade-School Math Reveals About Chain-of-Thought Traces](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38107)
*Ratish Puduppully,Pranabendu Misra,Paarth Iyer,Durgesh Kalwar,Vardhan Palod,Subbarao Kambhampati*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 在合成基准iGSM上对思维链轨迹做逐步程序化验证，发现答案正确与轨迹有效分布上近乎一致，但分布外会脱钩（最难实例31.6%正确答案轨迹无效），且轨迹监督干预可削弱轨迹作为推理/规划证据的可信度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 思维链轨迹常被视为模型如何得出答案的记录，支撑调试、智能体审计与推理能力主张，但自然语言思维轨迹难以机械化验证，该解释缺乏严格检验。

Method: 采用合成小学数学基准iGSM，其暴露正确解所需精确量与依赖关系，可对生成轨迹逐步程序化验证；先评估仅用有效最小轨迹训练的模型，再对轨迹监督进行干预（非最小轨迹、换查询、打乱10%轨迹句token、交换轨迹）。

Result: 分布上答案正确与轨迹有效近乎重合，但分布外脱钩：最难实例中31.6%正确答案轨迹无效，其中过半通过语法与算术检查却未过语义依赖检查。非最小训练轨迹诱导非最小输出；换查询暴露继承原查询的计算；打乱10%训练轨迹句token虽无轨迹通过验证仍保持接近干净准确率（含分布外）；交换训练轨迹也保持高分布内准确率。

Conclusion: 思维链轨迹并非可靠反映模型推理过程，最小性不能作为选择性规划的证据，且高准确率可在轨迹无效时维持，对AI安全中的思维链监控与可解释性主张提出警示。

Abstract: Chain-of-thought traces are widely read as records of how models reach their answers, informing debugging, agent auditing, and claims about reasoning. Testing this interpretation is difficult because natural-language thinking traces are rarely mechanically verifiable. We revisit it in iGSM, a synthetic grade-school mathematics benchmark designed to study thinking traces and used to support claims of learned reasoning and planning. Crucially, iGSM exposes the exact quantities and dependencies that a correct solution should use, allowing generated traces to be checked programmatically step by step and enabling us to test whether correct answers are reliably accompanied by valid traces. We first evaluate models trained exclusively on valid, minimal traces. Answer correctness and trace validity nearly coincide in distribution but decouple out of distribution: on the hardest instances, 31.6% of correct answers have invalid traces, over half of which pass all syntactic and arithmetic checks but fail semantic dependency checks. We then intervene on trace supervision. Non-minimal training traces induce non-minimal outputs, while re-asking the same problem with a different query reveals computations inherited from the original query, weakening minimality as evidence of selective planning. Shuffling tokens in 10% of training trace sentences preserves near-clean accuracy even out of distribution despite no trace passing verification. Swapped training traces likewise retain high in-distribution accuracy. We discuss the implications of these findings for chain-of-thought monitoring and interpretation in the context of AI safety.

</details>


### [375] [How Local Mixing Encodes Relative Position in Global NoPE Attention](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38109)
*Cutter Dawes,Nick Alonso,Tom Figliolia,Beren Millidge*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文解释了混合模型（SWA/门控线性注意力+全局NoPE注意力）如何在全局层隐式编码位置：局部混合层在残差流中引入近因偏置，传播并被全局注意力logits选中，且该偏置可在长序列中维持。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 注意力本身位置不变，传统需显式位置编码（如RoPE）。但近期发现局部混合层（SWA、门控线性注意力）配合全局NoPE注意力层在大规模下有效，其机理尚不清楚。作者希望解释这种混合模型如何隐式编码位置。

Method: 理论与实证分析相结合：论证SWA和门控线性注意力会在残差流中诱导近因偏置，该偏置传播到全局注意力logits并被选择；并与仅含全局NoPE注意力（位置信息仅来自因果掩码）的情况进行对比。

Result: 混合模型中的近因偏置能够跨长序列维持，而仅靠全局NoPE注意力的隐式位置编码则无法做到。

Conclusion: 研究深化了对混合模型位置编码机制的理解，并为设计可无限外推到更长序列长度的位置编码方式提供了启示。

Abstract: The attention operation is naively position invariant. However, positional information is fundamental to natural language, and therefore a variety of explicit position encodings have been developed in transformer-based models, such as rotary position encoding (RoPE). Although explicit position encodings have long been assumed to be required, recent methods that interleave local mixing layers, such as sliding window attention (SWA) and gated linear attention, while not encoding position (NoPE) in global attention layers has recently been shown to be successful at scale. How and why this approach works is not well-understood. In this paper, we develop an explanation of how hybrid models of this sort can implicitly encode position at global NoPE layers. Supported by both theoretical and empirical evidence, our central argument is that SWA and gated linear attention induce a recency bias in the residual stream that propagates to, and is selected by, the global attention logits. Moreover, in contrast to the implicit position encodings found in models with only global NoPE attention, in which positional information arises solely from the causal mask, the recency bias in hybrid models can be maintained across long sequences. In addition to deepening our understanding of how hybrid models encode position, these findings may provide insights for how to encode position in a way that can extrapolate to longer sequence lengths indefinitely.

</details>


### [376] [From Routing Signals to Selective Review: Visual regrounding in MoE VLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38111)
*Hongzhu Guo,Mohsen Fayyaz,Nanyun Peng*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该论文提出首个利用MoE视觉语言模型内部路由决策来检测目标缺失的框架，在生成前识别虚假视觉前提并触发选择性纠正，无需修改模型权重即可显著提升准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: VLM可能接受虚假视觉前提，对不存在的目标回答其颜色、数量、位置或状态等问题，这种"目标缺失接地失败"是可靠性关键问题。现有检测器主要依赖生成响应、隐藏状态或不确定性度量，缺乏生成前检测手段。

Method: 从Qwen3-VL-30B-A3B-Instruct和Gemma-4-26B-A4B-it中提取目标token的路由概率，为每个模型分别训练L2正则化线性检测器，用其预测结果选择性调用目标感知的复查提示（target-aware review prompt）。

Result: 仅用路由信号，Qwen与Gemma检测器在GQA-Inpaint上ROC-AUC达0.9988和0.9956，在外部OBER数据集上保持0.8095和0.7781；路由门控策略使端到端准确率在GQA-Inpaint和OBER上分别提升+22.25%/+12.17%（Qwen）和+13.42%/+1.39%（Gemma）。分析显示信号定位于目标物体token，早期MoE层即出现，并分布于部分可替代的专家中。

Conclusion: 路由概率单独即可保留关于视觉感知的可操作信息，使MoE VLM已产生的计算能支持低成本检测与选择性视觉重新接地。跨数据集阈值漂移需重新校准，但误报复查危害有限，可通过联合选择检测阈值与复查提示控制干预风险。

Abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) may accept false visual premises, answering questions about a target object's color, count, location, or state even when it is absent. We call this reliability-critical behavior a target-absence grounding failure. Existing visual-grounding detectors primarily rely on generated responses, hidden states, or uncertainty measures. We present the first framework to leverage internal routing decisions in Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) VLMs to detect target absence before generation and guide selective correction. We extract target-token routing probabilities from Qwen3-VL-30B-A3B-Instruct and Gemma-4-26B-A4B-it, train a separate L2-regularized linear detector for each model, and use its predictions to selectively invoke a target-aware review prompt. Using routing alone, the Qwen and Gemma detectors achieve ROC-AUCs of 0.9988 and 0.9956 on GQA-Inpaint and retain 0.8095 and 0.7781 on the external OBER dataset, respectively. The resulting routing-gated policy improves end-to-end accuracy on GQA-Inpaint and OBER by +22.25% and +12.17% for Qwen, and by +13.42% and +1.39% for Gemma, without modifying model weights. Further analysis shows that the signal is localized to the target-object token, emerges in early MoE layers, and is distributed across partially substitutable experts. Although cross-dataset threshold shifts require recalibration, false-positive review causes limited harm overall, suggesting that intervention risk can be controlled through joint selection of the detector threshold and review prompt. Overall, we show that routing probabilities alone preserve actionable information about visual perception, allowing computation already produced by an MoE VLM to support low-cost detection and selective visual regrounding.

</details>


### [377] [LongHarness Bench: Stress-Testing Language Model Harnesses for Long-Context Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38137)
*Quang Hieu Pham,Thuy Duong Nguyen,Jocelyn Qiaochu Chen,Xi Ye*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出一个用于评估长上下文 harness（语言模型框架）效果与效率的新基准，通过需要多样化检索与自适应推理的任务，揭示效率是长上下文评估中被忽视的重要维度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有长上下文评估无法区分现代 harness 的优劣，表现为不同 harness 间准确率饱和、评估成本相近，因此缺乏能同时衡量效果与效率的评测手段。

Method: 构建包含四个评估套件的基准，任务需词汇搜索、语义匹配及全局/局部自适应推理；上下文多为语义相关但每步仅少量有用，形成困难搜索问题。用多种前沿语言模型搭配四种先进 harness 进行评测。

Result: 基准对强模型-harness 组合仍有挑战，最佳仅达 68% 宏观平均准确率；更重要的是，相同底层模型在不同 harness 下效率差异显著。

Conclusion: 效率应成为长上下文评估的重要维度，该基准为开发"策略性而非穷举式"处理上下文的 harness 提供了测试平台。

Abstract: Language-model (LM) harnesses enable LMs to operate effectively over long contexts using additional compute. However, existing long-context evaluations are insufficient for distinguishing modern harnesses, reflected by saturated accuracy across harnesses and largely similar evaluation costs. In this paper, we introduce a benchmark for evaluating both the effectiveness and efficiency of long-context harnesses. Our tasks require diverse retrieval strategies, including lexical search and semantic matching, together with strategic and adaptive reasoning over global and local context. Much of the context is semantically relevant but only a small subset is useful at each step, creating both a challenging search problem and different accuracy--cost tradeoffs across processing strategies. For example, one task requires identifying every person satisfying several conditions using evidence scattered across documents; strategically checking the most selective condition first can narrow the search before verifying the remaining conditions. We evaluate multiple families of frontier language models with four state-of-the-art harnesses. Our benchmarks remain challenging even for strong model--harness combinations: the best reaches 68\% macro-average accuracy across four evaluation suites. More importantly, we find that the same underlying model can exhibit markedly different efficiency under different harnesses. Our results establish efficiency as an important axis for long-context evaluation and provide a testbed for developing harnesses that process context strategically rather than exhaustively.

</details>


### [378] [Pretraining Latent Information Feedback Transformers with Teacher Supervision](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38149)
*Dor Tirosh,Ido Amos,Mor Geva*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: LIFT将循环状态学习转为教师强制预测问题，通过预计算状态实现并行预训练，在推理时反馈自身状态，提升语言建模、推理与程序性任务表现，同时保持高效。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准Transformer是前馈结构，深层表示不会回传到浅层，跨生成步信息仅能通过解码token传递，导致模型需重复计算且丢弃备选延续，形成信息瓶颈。

Method: 提出LIFT架构与训练方法：每个输入token配对由现成预训练LM下一token分布导出的信息密集状态；扩展少量参数让模型同时预测下一token与下一状态；输入状态预计算使预训练位置完全并行；推理时反馈模型自身预测状态。

Result: 在135M至1B参数模型上，LIFT在token匹配预算下于语言建模、下游推理和程序性任务上持续优于标准Transformer及基线，与计算匹配Transformer持平或更优；状态跟踪任务中，小型LIFT胜过训练数据多8倍的同尺寸Transformer。

Conclusion: LIFT证明语言模型可通过可扩展的教师监督，在预训练中学习利用深层到浅层的反馈信息。

Abstract: Transformer language models (LMs) are feed-forward: deep-layer representations are never fed back to shallower layers, and the only pathway for information to flow downward across generation steps is the decoded token. This narrow channel forces models to recompute intermediate results and to discard alternative continuations. In this work, we remove this bottleneck during pretraining, introducing the LIFT (Latent Information Feedback Transformer) architecture and training method which enable LMs to propagate state across generation. We achieve this by turning recurrent-state learning into a teacher-forced prediction problem: each input token is paired with an information-dense state, derived from the next-token distribution of an off-the-shelf pretrained LM. The model, extended with a small number of additional parameters, is then trained to predict both the next token and the next state. As the input states are precomputed, pretraining remains fully parallel across positions. At inference, the model's own predicted states are fed back, with a minor computational overhead that decreases with model size. Experiments with pretrained models ranging from 135M to 1B parameters show that LIFT consistently outperforms standard Transformers and baselines on language modeling, downstream reasoning tasks, and procedural tasks under token-matched budget, while being on par with or ahead of compute-matched Transformers. Moreover, a controlled study on a state-tracking task shows that a tiny LIFT outperforms same-size Transformers trained on 8x more data, even when trained with the states of a Transformer that fails the task. Overall, we show that LMs can learn to exploit deep-to-shallow feedback during pretraining via scalable teacher supervision.

</details>


### [379] [STEPQuant: When and Where Errors Matter in Delta-Rule Recurrent State Quantization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38169)
*Bingchen Yao,Haobo Xu,Haokun Lin,Yichen Wu,Ziyu Guo,Renrui Zhang,Zhichao Lu,Zhenan Sun,Ying Wei*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: STEPQuant是一个面向Delta-rule循环状态的时空后训练量化框架，通过按误差幅度与记忆寿命分配精度，在6-bit下接近FP32精度并大幅压缩服务内存。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 线性注意力用固定大小的循环状态替代增长的KV缓存，但在并发服务下这些持久状态成为内存瓶颈。直接低精度量化会因误差在状态更新中传播导致严重精度下降。

Method: 基于两个互补维度观察：时间上长寿命记忆误差持续多步，空间上不同key行对输出影响不同且状态幅度差异大。STEPQuant据此分配精度，并联合拟合key行与value列缩放。

Result: 在Qwen3.8-27B和Kimi-Linear-48B-A3B-Instruct上，6-bit预算接近FP32状态精度，4-bit配置优于均匀INT8；集成SGLang后6-bit实现超5倍状态压缩，服务总内存最多降低68.7%。

Conclusion: STEPQuant有效缓解循环状态量化的精度-内存权衡，为线性注意力并发服务提供实用压缩方案。

Abstract: Linear attention replaces growing KV caches with fixed-size recurrent states, yet these persistent states can become a substantial memory bottleneck under concurrent serving. Directly quantizing recurrent states to low precision often leads to severe accuracy degradation, as quantization errors propagate through successive state updates. We discover that the impact of these errors depends on two complementary dimensions: temporally, errors in long-lived memory can persist across many decoding steps; spatially, errors in different key rows affect model outputs differently, while state magnitudes vary substantially along both rows and columns. Motivated by these observations, we propose STEPQuant, a spatial-temporal post-training quantization framework for Delta-rule recurrent states. STEPQuant allocates precision according to error magnitude and memory lifetime, and jointly fits key-row and value-column scales based on state distributions and key-row impact on output error. Experiments on Qwen3.8-27B and Kimi-Linear-48B-A3B-Instruct across both long- and short-generation benchmarks show that STEPQuant closely matches FP32-state accuracy under a nominal 6-bit budget and outperforms uniform INT8 in its 4-bit configuration. Integrated into SGLang with optimized GPU kernels, 6-bit STEPQuant achieves over 5x recurrent-state compression and reduces total serving memory by up to 68.7%. Our code is available at https://github.com/Dreamer-Toby/STEPQuant.

</details>


<div id='cs.SI'></div>

# cs.SI [[Back]](#toc)

### [380] [Group dynamics of engagement with AI topics on Bluesky](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36011)
*Bradley Huynh,Moyi Tian,Nancy Rodríguez*

Main category: cs.SI

TL;DR: 本文构建了一个结合经验数据收集与网络动力学建模的框架，以DeepSeek R1发布为案例，研究Bluesky上不同群体对AI事件的参与机制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 社交媒体上AI相关事件引发的在线参与可能外溢到现实世界，但经验研究与群体层面传播动力学的数学建模之间缺乏联系，需要理解不同在线社区如何回应AI事件及其参与机制。

Method: 收集并组织Bluesky平台上的活动数据，将用户划分为不同群体（AI相关社区和学术学科两种分组方案），采用带外生参与项的网络SIR-type动力学模型进行拟合，量化内生网络驱动传播与直接外部响应的相对强度。

Result: 以DeepSeek R1发布为案例，发现各群体中强烈的直接事件响应并不必然伴随强烈的网络驱动传播，揭示了被总体活动量掩盖的差异化参与模式。

Conclusion: 该框架连接了AI在线参与的经验研究与群体传播动力学建模，揭示了不同群体参与AI事件机制的差异，对研究信息传播和AI社会接受度具有重要意义。

Abstract: Social media increasingly shapes everyday life, serving as both a central venue for discussion of major events and a space where online collective behavior can spill over into real-world activity, while artificial intelligence (AI) is likewise becoming increasingly influential across society. Understanding how different online communities respond to AI-related events, and disentangling the mechanisms underlying the development of such engagement, are therefore increasingly important for studying information spreading and the societal reception of AI. Our work addresses the limited connection between empirical studies of AI-related online engagement and mathematical modeling of group-level spreading dynamics. We develop a framework to collect and organize empirical Bluesky activity into distinct user groups, then use a network-based dynamics model to investigate the mechanisms underlying their engagement. We use the release of DeepSeek R1 as a case study under two complementary grouping schemes: AI-related communities and academic disciplines. For each group, we fit a network-based Susceptible-Infected-Recovered (SIR)-type model augmented with an exogenous engagement term, allowing us to quantify the relative strengths of endogenous network-driven spreading and direct external response. Across groups, we find that strong direct responses to the event do not necessarily coincide with strong network-driven propagation, revealing distinct engagement patterns that may be obscured by aggregate activity alone.

</details>


### [381] [The Surge of Anti-Semitism in German Social Media following the October 7 Attacks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36290)
*Gregor Wiedemann,Daniel Wehrend*

Main category: cs.SI

TL;DR: 研究2023年10月7日哈马斯袭击以色列对德国社交媒体上关于犹太教和以色列讨论的影响，用LLM检测26类反犹主义内容。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探究该袭击事件是否以及多大程度上改变了德国社交媒体上关于犹太教与以色列的讨论，特别是反犹主义言论的变化。

Method: 通过大语言模型（LLM）在用户发帖中检测26种反犹主义类别；分析事件前后各三个月、来自Facebook和Telegram的帖子（N=125,718）；测试不同开放权重模型，并比较是否将用户信息作为上下文加入提示词。

Result: 最佳设置在人工编码验证集上二分类反犹主义检测的F1分数最高达83%；用户上下文对多数LLM有帮助，能大幅减少误报，例如在批评性报道反犹事件时。反犹主义在两个平台上均显著上升，Telegram上的普遍程度约为Facebook的10倍。Facebook用户的反犹言论多出现在关于以军实施“种族灭绝”的帖子中，而Telegram上则以与权力和阴谋论相关的经典反犹刻板印象为主。袭击后两平台话语模式呈现趋同迹象：Facebook上经典反犹主义增加，Telegram上以色列相关类别激增。

Conclusion: 10月7日袭击后德国社交媒体反犹主义显著上升且平台间存在差异，但话语模式出现趋同；将用户信息作为上下文可提升LLM检测效果并减少误报。

Abstract: We investigate the extent to which the Hamas attacks on Israel of October 7, 2023, have affected German social media debates about Judaism and Israel. For this, we develop an approach to detect 26 anti-Semitic categories in user postings via large language models (LLMs). The approach is applied to Facebook and Telegram posts (N=125,718) from three months before and after the event. Methodically, we test different open-weight models in two setups---with and without user information as additional context to the post text. The best setup achieves up to 83 % F1-score for binary anti-Semitism detection on our manually coded validation set. User context provides valuable information for most LLMs and drastically reduces false positives, for example, when (critically) reporting on anti-Semitic incidents. Concerning our topic, we find that anti-Semitism is surging significantly on both platforms, while being about ten times more prevalent on Telegram compared to Facebook. Facebook users express anti-Semitic views most likely in posts about an alleged genocide in Gaza carried out by the Israeli army, whereas classic anti-Semitic stereotypes related to power and conspiracy theories are dominant on Telegram. After the attack, the discourse patterns on both platforms show signs of convergence, as classic anti-Semitism increases on Facebook, whereas Israel-related categories surge on Telegram.

</details>


### [382] [Influence Ranking Improvement via Link Addition in Social Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36791)
*Taiki Ikemoto,Sho Tsugawa*

Main category: cs.SI

TL;DR: 本文研究了通过为目标节点添加有限数量出边来提升其在影响力最大化(IM)排名中的名次,提出Link Selection Problem for Influence Ranking Improvement (LSP-IRI),并比较贪心与随机搜索两种启发式策略。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 社交媒体中"影响力"带来的价值促使节点有动机进行策略性操作,但不足在于尚不清楚通过有限的本地结构修改(加边)能在多大程度上提升基于IM的影响力排名。

Method: 将问题形式化为LSP-IRI:在固定预算下为目标节点选择一组新增出边以最大化排名提升;采用两种代表性启发式策略——直接优化排名提升的贪心方法和计算高效的随机搜索方法。

Result: 在4个真实网络(规模从数千到数十万节点)上实验:仅添加3条边,贪心方法可将初始排名约50的节点平均提升数十位,有时进入前10;随机搜索在严格预算下增益较小,但计算时间最多减少约98%,在更大预算下变得有效。

Conclusion: 基于IM的影响力排名对有限的局部结构修改高度敏感,揭示了排名提升与计算效率之间的权衡。

Abstract: Social media platforms increasingly rely on influential users for information dissemination in domains such as marketing and political campaigns. As the value of being recognized as influential grows, users may have incentives to strategically enhance their influence. In this study, we investigate whether and to what extent the influence ranking of a target node can be improved by adding a limited number of outgoing links in the context of influence maximization (IM). We formulate the Link Selection Problem for Influence Ranking Improvement (LSP-IRI) as the problem of selecting a fixed-size set of additional outgoing links from a target node in order to maximize its rank improvement. To examine this problem, we consider two representative heuristic strategies: a greedy method that directly optimizes rank improvement and a computationally efficient random search method. We conduct experiments on four real-world networks ranging from thousands to hundreds of thousands of nodes. The results show that even a few added links can substantially improve IM-based influence rankings. In particular, the greedy method improves the ranks of nodes initially ranked around 50 by several tens of positions on average with only three added links, sometimes moving them into the top 10. The random search method achieves smaller gains under strict budgets but reduces computation time by up to approximately 98% compared with the greedy method and becomes effective when larger budgets are allowed. These findings show that IM-based influence rankings are sensitive to limited local structural modifications and highlight a trade-off between ranking improvement and computational efficiency.

</details>


### [383] [Luxury resale volume and composition shifted during the COVID-19 tourism shock, but co-purchase network tests were inconclusive and construction-sensitive](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36825)
*Tengfei Shao*

Main category: cs.SI

TL;DR: 研究比较2019与2020年二手奢侈品转售网络的共购图，发现标准统计检验无法区分年份，且所检验的度量对真实的网络重组缺乏检测能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 2020年日本旅游冲击导致二手奢侈品转售中介买家减少27%、GMV下降35%。作者想检验这一冲击是否反映在品牌共购网络的拓扑结构变化上，即网络比较方法能否检测到冲击期的重组。

Method: 比较2019与2020年品牌标签的共购投影图，使用五种标签不变度量（Holm校正）及Portrait Divergence，并以两个置换零模型（含重建两图的设计匹配配对交换零模型）做检验。另用随机二块品牌划分植入30%多品牌购物篮重定向，检验统计功效；并做仅组分模型模拟、构造稳健性（去除残差与材质标签）分析。

Result: 完整年份无法被区分（最小Holm p=0.407；配对交换零模型下0.097）。在100次模拟中仅83次检出植入的30%重定向（178/10399第二组购物篮，1.7%）；Portrait Divergence仅在完全重定向时达到80%功效。观测到的平均度与聚类下降类似20-30%重定向，但植入的度同配性上升缺失。仅组分模型仅15/100可被检出。去除残差和材质标签（事后）后，平均度在配对交换零模型下可区分年份（Holm p=0.030），Portrait Divergence在未校正下于最宽构造及4-12月内低于0.05。

Conclusion: 冲击期网络比较需要重建图零模型和逐度量的检测下限；网络重组的真实信号可能被构造选择所掩盖，标准检验易得出虚假阴性或依赖构造的结论。

Abstract: Japan's 2020 tourism shock coincided with 27% fewer buyers and 35% lower gross merchandise value at one second-hand luxury resale intermediary. We compared 2019 and 2020 co-purchase projections of recorded brand labels with a Holm-corrected battery of five label-invariant metrics and Portrait Divergence against two permutation nulls rebuilding both graphs. Neither test separated the full years (smallest Holm p 0.407; 0.097 under the design-matched paired-swap null). For one random two-block split of brands, the battery detected a planted redirection of 30% of multi-brand baskets (178 of 10,399 second-group baskets, 1.7%) in 83 of 100 simulations (83-92 of 100 across 11 splits, all at least 80); Portrait Divergence reached 80% power only at full redirection. Observed falls in mean degree and clustering resembled those of 20-30% redirection, but the planted rise in degree assortativity was absent. A composition-only model of the observed attrition would be detected in only 15 of 100 simulations. Results moved with construction: without residual and material labels (post hoc), mean degree separated the years under the paired-swap null (Holm p = 0.030), and Portrait Divergence fell below 0.05, unadjusted, at the widest construction and within April-December. Shock-period network comparisons need rebuilt-graph nulls and a per-metric detection floor.

</details>


### [384] [Partition Space Maps for Community Detection: Visualizing Algorithmic Behaviour and Guiding Search](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36977)
*Fabio Morea*

Main category: cs.SI

TL;DR: 本文提出两种互补工具（基于RGS的规范标号与(Γ,Q)分区空间图），使网络分区空间可解析、可视化，用于精确刻画模块度退化与可行域结构。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 社区检测算法在可能的分区上搜索，但分区空间的结构很少被直接研究，缺乏精确、无需假设的参照框架。

Method: 采用基于受限增长序列(RGS)的规范标号，为每个分区赋予唯一且置换不变的标识，避免NMI等成对相似度度量；定义粒度Γ并与模块度Q结合构成二维投影PSM；在(Γ,Q)平面中Γ仅取离散整数值，并从偏差矩阵直接推导Q的上下界。

Result: 通过对小型基准图的完全枚举展示工具效果，揭示了模块度退化的精细结构与塑造可行域的组​​合约束。

Conclusion: 该框架为评估启发式社区检测算法提供精确、无假设的参照，并为大规模网络中几何感知的分区空间探索奠定基础。

Abstract: Community-detection methods search over possible partitions of a network, but the structure of this partition space is rarely examined directly. This paper introduces two complementary tools that make~$\mathcal{P}$ analytically and visually accessible. First, a canonical labelling scheme based on the Restricted Growth Sequence~(RGS) is adopted, assigning each partition a unique, permutation-invariant identifier and eliminating the need for pairwise similarity measures such as the Normalized Mutual Information. Second, granularity~$Γ$ is defined and combined with modularity~$Q$ to produce a two-dimensional projection: the Partition Space Map~(PSM). Within the $(Γ,Q)$ plane, only a discrete set of integer values of~$Γ$ is attainable, and upper and lower bounds on~$Q$ are derived directly from the deviation matrix. These tools are demonstrated through complete enumeration of~$\mathcal{P}$ for small benchmark graphs, revealing the fine structure of modularity degeneracy and the combinatorial constraints that shape the feasible region. The framework provides an exact, assumption-free reference for evaluating heuristic community detection algorithms and lays the groundwork for geometry-aware exploration of partition space in larger networks.

</details>


### [385] [Constrained Enumeration Reveals Hidden Optima and Precision-Dependent Degeneracy in Modularity-Based Community Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36998)
*Fabio Morea*

Main category: cs.SI

TL;DR: 提出两阶段工作流：先采样至新颖性饱和，再定位不稳定节点并在锁定稳定核心下枚举残余歧义，以扩展模块度平台的覆盖并提升模块度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 模块度景观在顶部往往平坦，许多不同划分得分难以区分，启发式算法反复运行仍可能错过可达最优解，需要更好的解空间探索方法。

Method: 两阶段流程：(i) 采样划分直到新颖性饱和；(ii) 将不稳定性定位到少量节点，并在锁定稳定核心的情况下仅对该残余歧义进行约束枚举。

Result: 在50节点基准网络和真实加权合作网络上，约束枚举系统性地扩大了平台覆盖，并可超越大量Louvain重启的模块度；边权取整会定性重塑平台结构。

Conclusion: 约束枚举是探索模块度平台的有效手段，且精度敏感性应成为解空间报告的必要组成部分。

Abstract: Modularity landscapes are often flat near the top: many distinct partitions achieve indistinguishable scores, and repeated runs of heuristic algorithms can still miss accessible optima. We introduce a two-phase workflow that (i) samples partitions until novelty saturates, then (ii) localises instability to a small subset of nodes and enumerates only that residual ambiguity under a locked stable core. Across a simple 50-nodes benchmark network, and a real weighted collaboration network, constrained enumeration systematically expands plateau coverage and can improve modularity beyond extensive Louvain restarts. Finally, we show that edge-weight rounding qualitatively reshapes plateau structure, making precision sensitivity an essential part of solution-space reporting.

</details>


### [386] [Explicit objective functions in modularity-based community detection on multiplex networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37253)
*Elizaveta Evmenova,Petr Chunaev*

Main category: cs.SI

TL;DR: 本文对多层网络中模块度社区检测的三种融合策略（EF、SF、LF）的目标函数进行了解析比较，揭示它们之间的显式关系，并通过合成及真实网络实验验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 尽管已有分类学与综述在概念上区分了EF、SF、LF三种策略，但它们的目标函数很少被解析比较，缺乏对其内在关系的理论理解。

Method: 针对共享节点、归一化非负边权与层权、统一分辨率参数、无层间边的多层网络（含节点属性网络），用统一符号推导三种策略目标函数间的显式关系；并结合合成多层网络的穷举实验与真实网络的启发式实验。

Result: 证明EF目标等于SF目标加一个非负异质性项；SF目标在单纯形顶点处存在最优层权向量（但在并列情形下也可能出现非顶点最优）；EF目标对固定划分关于层参数是凹的，其联合最优可能位于单纯形内部；LF的结论强烈依赖于瞬态图的构建方式（本文仅关注其中一种LF方法）。

Conclusion: 三种融合策略的目标函数存在明确的解析联系，实验验证了理论结果，并显示启发式优化器会影响观察到的比较结论。

Abstract: Modularity-based community detection in multiplex networks is commonly approached through one of three strategies: early fusion (EF), which first aggregates the layers into a single network and then applies community detection; simultaneous fusion (SF), which combines information from the layers during modularity optimization; and late fusion (LF), which combines the community assignments obtained by detecting communities separately in each layer. Although recent taxonomies and surveys distinguish these strategies conceptually, their objective functions have rarely been compared analytically. We provide such a comparison for shared-node multiplex networks with normalized non-negative edge and layer weights, a common resolution parameter, and no interlayer edges. Node-attributed networks are represented by topology and attribute-similarity layers. We use a common notation for the three formulations and derive explicit relationships between their objective functions. In particular, we show that the EF objective equals the SF objective plus a non-negative heterogeneity term. We prove that the SF objective admits an optimal layer-weight vector at a simplex vertex, although nonvertex optima may also occur under ties, whereas the EF objective is concave with respect to the layer parameter for each fixed partition, and its joint optimum may occur in the interior of the simplex. For LF methods, the resulting objective and conclusions depend heavily on how the transient graph is constructed. In this study, we focus only on one of such LF methods. We complement the analytical results with brute-force experiments on synthetic multiplexes and heuristic experiments on real-world networks, including node-attributed networks represented as multiplexes. The experiments illustrate the analytical results and the influence of heuristic optimizers on the observed comparisons.

</details>


<div id='cs.SE'></div>

# cs.SE [[Back]](#toc)

### [387] [Agent-Callable Feature Coverage: Measuring Software Readiness for AI Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35789)
*Zedong Peng*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 论文提出GUI-API parity原则，并给出ACFC度量与ARC评估框架，用30个系统和10个部署系统的实验表明：软件对AI代理的结构化支持在可发现性与安全治理上明显滞后。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI代理已能通过截图操作图形软件，因此关键问题不再是代理能否操作软件，而是软件能否通过结构化、可控的渠道良好地支持代理。

Method: 形式化提出GUI-API parity原则：人类通过GUI可获得的能力，代理也应能通过具备安全元数据的结构化可调用接口获得。构建两个工具：ACFC（产品级就绪度量，量化人类功能中代理可访问使用的比例）；ARC（从Accessibility、Discoverability、Controllability三维度各0-3分打分，合成0-9就绪分，借鉴Richardson成熟度模型）。

Result: 在5类30个系统的实证研究中，基于ARC的ACFC分数远低于仅看Accessibility的指标：多数系统API覆盖中等，但代理导向文档与安全治理滞后。在10个部署系统的受控测试中，纯API代理完成58个任务中的56个；文档消融后降至50/58，说明Discoverability会影响可访问能力的执行；作为负对照的不可访问能力均未被解决。结论在三个代理模型上成立，包括本地运行的Gemma4。

Conclusion: 仅靠结构化接口覆盖不足以保证代理就绪，可发现性与安全可控性是关键瓶颈；ARC/ACFC提供了比二元覆盖更细粒度的评估方式。

Abstract: AI agents already operate graphical software through screenshot-based computer use, so the pressing question is not whether agents can operate software, but how well software supports them through structured, controllable channels. We formalize this need as the GUI-API parity principle: every capability available to human users through a graphical interface should also be accessible to agents through a structured, callable interface with appropriate safety metadata. To operationalize this principle, we introduce two contributions. First, Agent-Callable Feature Coverage (ACFC), a product-level readiness metric quantifying how much of a system's human-facing functionality agents can access and use. Second, Agent Readiness Conformance (ARC), a framework that scores each capability on three axes: Accessibility (can an agent call it), Discoverability (can an agent find and understand it), and Controllability (can an agent use it safely), each on a 0-3 scale, yielding a composite 0-9 readiness score. Drawing on the Richardson Maturity Model, ARC provides finer-grained assessment than binary coverage. In an empirical study of 30 software systems across five categories, ARC-based ACFC scores are substantially lower than Accessibility-only metrics would suggest: most systems achieve moderate API coverage but lag on agent-oriented documentation and safety governance. In a controlled testbed of ten deployed systems, API-only agents completed 56 of 58 tasks whose target capabilities were exposed through structured interfaces; a documentation ablation reduced this to 50 of 58, showing that Discoverability affects execution even among accessible capabilities, while inaccessible capabilities, included as negative controls, were not solved. These findings hold across three agent models, including Google's open-weights Gemma4 run locally.

</details>


### [388] [A Leakage-Safe, Cost-Aware Regression Testing Methodology for the Quantum Transpiler](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35834)
*Furqan Nasir,Muhammad Arif Shah,Ifitkhar Alam*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 面向 Qiskit 量子转译器的成本感知回归测试选择研究，通过预注册评估发现复合风险评分反而不如简单基线，最终以"多样性优先"选择器缩小差距并报告负结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 量子 SDK（如 Qiskit）持续修订，单个转译器 pass 改动即可引入软件回归，因此 CI 需在固定预算下从大规模、成本异质的测试套件中选择并排序测试。现有方法需避免数据泄漏并正确处理成本异质性。

Method: 提出防泄漏、成本感知的回归测试选择方法；预算在读取任何测试预言标签前依据实测成本预先绑定。第一轮评估用 116 个单元、成本跨度 9,945X（T_full = 69.17 s）的语料，对比透明 risk_score 选择器与测试用例优先级基线及成本/历史/变更阶段基线。第二轮独立预注册评估用 19 个变异测试事件检验分解后的多样性优先选择器。

Result: 第一轮：risk_score 的检测-预算平均 AUC 为 0.721 [95% CI 0.44, 0.94]，低于仅多样性基线的 0.874（δ = -0.64，大效应），成本/历史基线 0.840，随机 0.821；消融显示有效信号是多样性与新颖性而非严重度或成本。第二轮：多样性优先选择器将差距缩至可忽略（0.880 vs 0.880，δ = -0.08），并显著优于原复合选择器（0.880 vs 0.768，δ = +0.57）；两个真实 CI 前向回归事件逐事件印证。

Conclusion: 复合风险评分选择器未胜过简单基线，其有效成分是多样性与新颖性而非严重度或成本；据此机制设计的多样性优先选择器达到与最强基线相当且优于原复合方法的性能。研究以预注册方式诚实报告该负结果及其机制，并公开全部代码、数据与制品以保证可复现。

Abstract: Quantum SDKs such as Qiskit are revised continually, and a single transpiler-pass change can introduce a software regression, so continuous integration (CI) must select and prioritize tests from a large, cost-heterogeneous suite under a fixed budget. We present a leakage-safe, cost-aware regression-test-selection methodology for the Qiskit quantum transpiler, with a pre-registered, budget binding evaluation that avoids data leakage. The evaluation uses a cost-heterogeneous corpus (116 units, per-unit cost spread 9,945X, T_full = 69.17 s) whose budgets were fixed from measured cost before any test-oracle label was read. A transparent risk_score selector does not beat simple test case-prioritization baselines: mean detection-vs-budget AUC is 0.721 [95% CI 0.44, 0.94] versus 0.874 [0.65, 1.00] for diversity-only (Cliff's δ = -0.64, large), with cost/history/change-stage baselines at 0.840 and random at 0.821. A component ablation shows the composite underperforms its own best signal: diversity and novelty, not severity or cost, are the effective signal. A second, independently pre-registered evaluation (19 mutation-testing events: nine original plus ten new, verified operators) tests the decomposed, diversity-first selector this mechanism implies: it closes the gap to the strongest baseline to a negligible effect size (0.880 vs 0.880, δ = -0.08) while decisively beating the original composite (0.880 vs 0.768, δ = +0.57). Two verified forward-regression events from real Qiskit CI history corroborate it, reported per event, not pooled, under a pre-declared claim-scope rule. We report the negative result as an honest, pre-registered finding with its mechanism. All code, data, and artifacts from this empirical software engineering study are released for reproducibility.

</details>


### [389] [Beyond Rule-Based Mutation Testing: Test-Aware Mutant Generation Using Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35841)
*Nils Kiele,Zainab Saad,Zirui Wang,Steve Drew,Samira Ebrahimi Kahou*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 提出"测试感知"(test-aware)变异体生成方法：让LLM在单一提示中接收问题描述、标准解和基础测试，生成能通过基础测试但被扩展测试捕获的非平凡变异体，显著优于测试盲方法和传统工具。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统基于规则的变异测试工具常生成大量琐碎、冗余或等价变异体，限制其实用性；现有LLM方法虽生成更真实的缺陷，但大多是"测试盲"的，只看源码而不了解现有测试覆盖了什么，无法针对性地发现测试套件的弱点。

Method: 提出测试感知变异体生成：LLM在单个提示中接收问题陈述、标准解和基础单元测试，必须生成能通过所有基础测试的非平凡变异体。在HumanEval和MBPP上评估五种LLM（Gemini 3.1 Pro、Gemini 3 Flash、GPT 5.1 Codex Mini、GPT 4.1 Mini、Qwen3-32B），用EvalPlus扩展测试套件作为自动判定依据，验证存活变异体是否为真实缺陷。

Result: 测试感知提示的验证缺陷率为87.7%(HumanEval)和79.1%(MBPP)，远高于匹配的测试盲提示(12.2%和23.0%)及规则工具mutmut(4.4%和5.7%)。缺陷隐蔽性(变异体失败的扩展测试比例)三种方法相当，但测试感知方法将每个验证缺陷的计算成本降至最低。

Conclusion: 让LLM接触现有单元测试，可将变异体生成从无针对性的缺陷注入转向有效发现测试套件弱点，为将测试感知变异体生成扩展到生产环境奠定基础。

Abstract: Mutation testing evaluates test-suite adequacy by injecting synthetic faults into program code. However, traditional rule-based tools often generate large numbers of trivial, redundant, or equivalent mutants that limit their practical use for identifying gaps in a test suite. While recent large language model (LLM)-based approaches generate more realistic faults, most remain test-blind: The model sees only the source code and cannot reason about what existing tests already cover. We propose test-aware mutant generation, in which an LLM receives the problem statement, canonical solution and base tests in a single prompt, and must generate a nontrivial mutant that passes the base unit tests. We evaluate this approach across a set of five LLMs -- Gemini 3.1 Pro, Gemini 3 Flash, GPT 5.1 Codex Mini, GPT 4.1 Mini, Qwen3-32B -- on the HumanEval and MBPP benchmarks. The extended EvalPlus test suites serve as an automated oracle to verify whether surviving mutants represent genuine bugs. Test-aware prompting yields verified fault rates of 87.7% (HumanEval) and 79.1% (MBPP), meaning these mutants pass all base tests but are caught by the oracle. This vastly outperforms the matched test-blind prompting (which yields only 12.2% and 23.0%, respectively) and the traditional rule-based tool mutmut (4.4% and 5.7%). While fault subtlety (the fraction of extended tests a mutant fails) remains comparable across all three methods, test-awareness minimizes the computational cost per verified fault, compared to test-blind prompting. Exposing an LLM to existing unit tests shifts mutant generation from untargeted bug injection toward effective discovery of weaknesses in an existing test suite. Our work establishes a concrete foundation for future research to scale test-aware mutant generation to production-level environments.

</details>


### [390] [PoliVEM: a Python-driven virtual element framework for computational solid mechanics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35878)
*Paulo Akira F. Enabe,Rodrigo Provasi*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 提出PoliVEM虚拟单元法软件框架，用C++17核心与Python接口统一实现梁、二维/三维弹性、轴对称、瞬态扩散及有限应变超弹性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 虚拟单元法在固体与结构力学中缺乏统一、可复用的实现，不同 formulations 往往各自为政，需要共享网格、自由度编号、装配与求解等基础设施。

Method: 采用C++17计算核心与Python界面，将顶点、边、面、单元自由度纳入统一层级，从公共多项式数据构造能量、应变与L²投影，并在单元层面保留一致性—稳定化分解；核心按网格、材料、单元、装配器、求解器职责分离并通过组合连接。新形式只需提供投影、离散形式与稳定化，即可复用其余基础设施。数值设施包括多边形/多面体网格、高阶编号、投影算子缓存、静态凝聚、着色稀疏装配、按矩阵结构选择线性求解器、带线搜索与正则化的增量牛顿法及显/隐式时间积分。

Result: 三个数值实验通过多项式再现、静态凝聚后恢复、高阶自由度处理、多边形与多面体网格、分片试验、刚度谱及与独立有限元计算的比较进行验证，确认了梁及二维、三维弹性形式的共同核心，并识别出各向异性单元上高阶多项式基的缩放与稀疏直接分解的内存需求是当前实现的主要限制。

Conclusion: PoliVEM验证了统一核心在多种VEM形式中的有效性，同时明确了高阶各向异性基缩放与稀疏直接分解内存两大局限。

Abstract: This work presents PoliVEM, a software framework for the Virtual Element Method (VEM) in computational solid and structural mechanics. A C++17 computational core and a Python interface place one-dimensional beams, two- and three-dimensional elasticity, axisymmetric elasticity, transient diffusion, and finite-strain hyperelasticity in a common implementation. The framework stores vertex, edge, face, and cell degrees of freedom in one hierarchy, constructs the energy, strain, and $L^2$ projections from common polynomial data, and retains the consistency--stabilization split at the element level. The core separates the mesh, material, element, assembler, and solver responsibilities and combines them by composition. A new formulation supplies its projection, discrete form, and stabilization while reusing the mesh representation, degree-of-freedom numbering, boundary-condition treatment, sparse assembly, algebraic solvers, and Python binding pattern. The numerical infrastructure includes polygonal and polyhedral mesh input, higher-order entity numbering, cached projection operators, static condensation, coloured sparse assembly, linear solver selection based on the matrix structure, an incremental Newton method with line search and regularization, and explicit and implicit time integration. Three numerical experiments examine the shared implementation through polynomial reproduction, recovery after static condensation, higher-order degree-of-freedom handling, polygonal and polyhedral meshes, patch tests, stiffness spectra, and comparisons with independent finite element calculations. The results verify the common core for the beam and two- and three-dimensional elasticity formulations. They also identify the scaling of high-order polynomial bases on anisotropic cells and the memory required by sparse direct factorizations as the main limitations of the current implementation.

</details>


### [391] [The Artifact Promotion Control Model: An Implementation Case Study. Build on Target Machines vs. Build Once and Promote Artifacts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35891)
*Vasili Gavrilov,Enkli Ylli*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文把"制品晋升"（一次构建、同一副本跨测试与生产环境流转）形式化为严格的控制模型（Part I），并以AWS上一生产Web应用的匿名案例（Part II）验证：31次生产发布、单服务器36秒、四周22次发布，并列出控制覆盖表与未覆盖的发布单元。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 此前工作仅以工程散文形式提出制品晋升，缺乏严格定义；而合规框架（FedRAMP/SI-7、SOX 404、FFIEC、DO-178C、FDA 21 CFR Part 11、HIPAA、DoD IL）的完整性与变更控制要求，用"目标机上重复构建"（build-on-target）难以直接满足，需要形式化模型说明制品晋升为何更契合。

Method: Part I将已有文献要素（build-once原则、build/release/run拆分、二进制授权、供应链分离性、NIST SP 800-204D）整合为统一模型：定义发布对象、部署跨越的控制域、制品身份与环境身份的区分，将源码库被攻陷视为控制域问题；提出构建期注入密钥会破坏制品身份、部署期下载依赖库是随数量增长的攻击面、发布角色无需生产口令等推论。Part II为AWS生产Web应用的匿名案例研究：一次发布即一条命令，制品从上传到运行集群全自动；按阶段统计31次发布耗时，报告服务等级、控制覆盖表（缺签名、扫描、审批记录、部署校验）及两类未被流水线覆盖的发布单元，并用末表逐条核验Part I的论断。

Result: 31次生产发布按阶段计时：单服务器36秒，整体rollout约六分钟；前四周共22次发布；给出该应用的服务等级；控制表明确已有与缺失的控制项；并识别出流水线未覆盖的两个发布单元。

Conclusion: 制品晋升可作为满足多项合规完整性/变更控制要求的统一部署控制模型，其属性比build-on-target更直接地符合监管要求；同时案例表明模型可落地，但其实施仍存在控制缺口（无签名、无扫描、无审批记录、无部署期验证）与未覆盖的发布路径，需在后续补齐。

Abstract: Artifact promotion means building the software once and moving that same built copy through the test and production environments, instead of building it again on each server. A previous treatment by the first author presented it as a control model for cloud deployment in accessible engineering prose. Part I of this paper restates the model in stricter form: the release object, the control domains a deployment crosses, the artifact-versus-environment identity distinction, source-control compromise as a control-domain question, and the regulatory controls (FedRAMP/SI-7, SOX 404, FFIEC, DO-178C, FDA 21 CFR Part 11, HIPAA, DoD IL) whose integrity and change-control requirements the model's properties meet more directly than build-on-target does. The parts of the model are each in the literature already: the build-once principle, the build/release/run split, binary authorization, separation as a supply-chain property, NIST SP 800-204D. The paper assembles them as one model, whatever form the built copy takes; states that a secret injected at build time breaks artifact identity; restates why downloading libraries at deployment time is an attack surface that grows with their number; and derives that the releasing role needs no production password. Part II is an anonymized case study of a production web application on AWS in which a release is one command and the artifact's path from upload to running fleet is autonomous. It reports 31 production rollouts timed stage by stage from the platform's records (36 s per server inside a six-minute rollout), 22 releases in the first four weeks, the application's service levels, a control table stating which controls the implementation has and which it lacks (no signature, no scan, no approval record, no verification at deploy), and the two release units the pipeline did not cover. A closing table checks each claim of Part I against that record.

</details>


### [392] [UNBIND: UNlearning By INference-time Directional Steering for Code LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35913)
*Zhengyang Shan,Jiayun Xin,Yanjun Lin,Xu Qian,Zhiang Liu,Minghui Xu,Yue Zhang,Qin Hu,Kun Li,Xiuzhen Cheng*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: UNBIND：一种在推理时选择性代码遗忘的框架，分离"哪些隐状态对应目标代码"与"如何抑制其重现"两个目标，保持模型权重不变，实现高强度遗忘同时保留编程能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 代码大模型从大规模代码语料学习，可能记忆需要移除的实现。版权或安全疑虑出现时需控制其继续重现，但目标代码与保留代码共享计算模式，导致"遗忘特定实现"与"保留通用编程能力"之间存在张力。

Method: 提出UNBIND框架，将"哪些隐状态对应目标代码"与"如何抑制其重现"分开处理，通过为这两个目标构建不同方向，在推理时实现选择性遗忘，且模型权重固定不变。

Result: 评测涵盖2个代码模型、2个语料、14个基线；UNBIND在每种设置下取得最高的遗忘与效用联合得分。F-BLEU使目标代码重现降低97.3%–99.1%，HumanEval+最多少解2题、MBPP+最多少解6题。固定预算重复抽取测试中，产出≥50 token精确片段的目数量从188–262降至每设置300个中0–2个；无片段达到100 token，平均最佳恢复比为0.43%–6.45%。多语言及相关代码评测也显示有效遗忘且对编程能力影响有限。

Conclusion: UNBIND可作为选择性代码遗忘的实用方案，在强遗忘与能力保留间取得良好平衡。

Abstract: Code large language models acquire programming capabilities from large code corpora, but can also memorize implementations that later require removal. Code unlearning is needed to control their continued reproduction when copyright or security concerns arise. However, targeted and retained code share computational patterns, creating a tension between forgetting specific implementations and preserving general programming ability. We propose \textbf{UNBIND}, a code unlearning framework that separately considers which hidden states correspond to the target code and how to suppress its reproduction. By constructing separate directions for these objectives, UNBIND achieves selective unlearning at inference time while keeping model weights fixed. Our evaluation covers fourteen baselines across two code models and two corpora. UNBIND achieves the highest joint forgetting and utility score in every setting. It reduces target code reproduction by 97.3\% to 99.1\% as measured by F-BLEU, with at most two fewer HumanEval+ and six fewer MBPP+ problems solved than the original models. In repeated extraction tests under a fixed budget, the number of targets yielding exact spans of at least 50 tokens falls from 188--262 to 0--2 out of 300 per setting. No extracted span reaches 100 tokens, and the mean best recovery ratio ranges from 0.43\% to 6.45\%. Multilingual and related-code evaluations further show effective forgetting with limited impact on useful programming capabilities, supporting UNBIND as a practical approach to selective code unlearning.

</details>


### [393] [Evaluating Name-Only Directory Routing for One-Shot Code Search](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35918)
*Manoj Bajaj*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 测试语言模型能否通过目录/文件名（name-only routing）找到固定词法查询遗漏的标注代码文件；结果显示路由在文件召回和行召回上优于FTS5，但成本更高，且不能归因于层级结构或证明提升问题解决。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 编码代理早期难点是定位正确文件；固定词法查询可能遗漏相关文件，作者想验证仅靠目录和文件名导航能否补足这些遗漏。

Method: 在11个仓库、82个已审计issue（固定pre-fix commit）上，比较name-only directory routing、FTS5、固定全issue rg查询；设置八候选文件名限制与16K token共享上下文预算，并做扁平路径对照与仓库聚类bootstrap。

Result: 8候选内gold文件召回：routing 0.465 vs FTS5 0.352 vs rg 0.245；相对FTS5配对增益0.113（95% CI 0.053–0.168）。16K预算下，55个完全对齐案例的标注行召回0.443 vs FTS5 0.246。8文件限制下routing+FTS5达0.491，但增益不确定；扁平路径对照0.572，需24.6次调用 vs routing 8.9次。routing平均8.9秒/issue，FTS5每查询7毫秒（构建0.9秒）。

Conclusion: 在该队列中，目录路由能为一击式词法搜索补充相关文件候选，但无法将收益归因于层级结构，也未证明能改善issue解决效果。

Abstract: Finding the right files is an early challenge for coding agents. We test whether a language model can follow directory and file names to find annotated code files missed by fixed lexical queries. Across 82 audited issues from 11 repositories at pinned pre-fix commits, name-only directory routing recovered 0.465 of gold files within eight candidates, compared with 0.352 for FTS5 and 0.245 for a fixed full-issue rg query. The paired gain over FTS5 was 0.113 (95% repository-cluster bootstrap interval, 0.053 to 0.168). Under a shared 16K-token context budget, routing delivered 0.443 of annotated lines versus 0.246 for FTS5 on 55 cases with fully aligned annotations. At the same eight-file limit, combining routing with FTS5 reached 0.491 file recall, but its gain over routing alone was uncertain. An exploratory flat path control reached 0.572 recall while using 24.6 model calls per issue, compared with 8.9 for routing. Routing averaged 8.9 seconds per issue; FTS5 took 7 milliseconds per query after a 0.9-second build. On this cohort, directory routing added relevant file candidates to one-shot lexical search, but the study cannot attribute the gain to hierarchy or show that it improves issue resolution.

</details>


### [394] [The Uneven Decline of Collective Knowledge Production: Evidence from Stack Overflow After Generative AI](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36069)
*Myokyung Han,Taegyoon Kim,Jinhyuk Yun,Lanu Kim*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 该论文以ChatGPT-3.5发布为自然冲击，利用Stack Overflow 2020-2025年超200万问题，发现生成式AI对集体知识的影响不均衡：易题和数据丰富主题先被侵蚀，难题与数据稀缺主题相对存留。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生成式AI正改变个体学习与工作，但其对在线社区共同生产的"集体知识"的影响尚不清楚。已有研究只记录了知识分享平台参与度的总体下降，却未揭示哪些类型的知识先流失。

Method: 以Stack Overflow为研究对象，将ChatGPT-3.5发布视为自然实验冲击，分析2020至2025年间超200万条问题。围绕"难度"与"数据可得性"两个维度，追踪发布后的变化，并使用多种方法与稳健性检验加以验证。

Result: 简单问题大幅下降，难题占比上升（代码复杂度上升可佐证）。数据丰富的话题与标签问题份额流失，数据稀缺者占比上升。两维度存在交互：易题下降集中于数据丰富领域，而难题增加不受数据可得性影响。该模式跨多种编程语言成立，且流行语言中变化更明显。

Conclusion: 生成式AI对集体知识的影响是不均衡的：它最先侵蚀简单、易获取的知识，而更复杂、较冷门的知识得以存续。这提示社区知识的构成正被重塑，而非仅规模缩减。

Abstract: Generative AI (Gen AI) is reshaping how individuals learn and work, but its consequences for collective knowledge, the shared body of knowledge that online communities produce together, remain poorly understood. Prior work has documented an aggregate decline in participation on knowledge-sharing platforms, but it remains unclear which specific kinds of knowledge are being lost first. We study this question using Stack Overflow, one of the largest online communities for software engineering, treating the release of ChatGPT-3.5 as a natural shock. Analyzing over two million questions posted between 2020 and 2025, we track how two dimensions of collective knowledge, difficulty and data availability, change following Gen AI's release. Using diverse methods and robust checks, we find consistent patterns. Easy questions decline sharply while difficult questions become more common, a pattern corroborated by rising code complexity. Data-rich topics and tags lose share of questions, while data-scarce ones gain ground. The two dimensions also interact: the decline in easy questions is concentrated specifically within data-rich domains, while difficult questions increase regardless of data availability. This pattern extends beyond Python across programming languages, with more prevalent languages showing sharper shifts. Together, our findings reveal that Gen AI's impact on collective knowledge is uneven, eroding easy, accessible knowledge first while more complex, less common knowledge persists.

</details>


### [395] [The Invisible Scheduler: Dragging a Sprite Can Change What a Scratch Program Does](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36147)
*Xinyue Feng,Hanyuan Shi,Yuan Si*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: StackSwap 工具通过重排 Scratch 中精灵的初始堆叠顺序，系统性地暴露因并发调度（脚本启动顺序）导致的程序结果不确定性：在767个真实项目中，26.4%（课程）和18.2%（公开）的有调度选择的程序在不同叠放顺序下行为不同。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Scratch 程序是并发的：点击绿旗后，所有精灵的脚本同时启动并共享项目状态，哪个脚本先运行由精灵的前后堆叠顺序决定，但没有任何积木块能读取该顺序。拖动精灵会把它移到最前，且顺序随项目保存。因此同一程序可能在作者屏幕上正确、在老师屏幕上失败。这一隐藏的调度依赖是编程教育中被忽视的正确性隐患。

Method: 关键观察：在文件其余部分不变的情况下，对启动脚本的精灵进行位置重排，恰好产生其初始堆叠顺序的所有排列。StackSwap 在这些顺序下运行项目（最多五个精灵时穷举全部顺序；更多时每类冲突图取一个代表，外加一个两者都不可行的样本），并用四种观察视角比较运行结果。它返回：一个双运行见证（指出交换后改变结果的相邻精灵对，及其共享资源作为候选原因）；否则给出穷举或图条件式的鲁棒性证书，或未决结论。

Result: 在来自课程、在线评测系统和随机公开样本的767个真实程序上：有调度选择的程序中，26.4%（课程）和18.2%（公开）在某些叠放顺序下行为不同。在所有顺序都能运行完的敏感程序中，保存顺序的结果复现率中位数仅为17%（课程）和50%（公开）。脚本化测试中，427份有调度选择的学生提交里有5份在一个顺序下满足指定需求的谓词、在另一个顺序下失败。对一半敏感程序而言，随机流是竞争精灵对的最高优先级共享资源。

Conclusion: Scratch 中精灵堆叠顺序造成的调度不确定性在真实学生程序中普遍存在，会导致同一程序在不同环境下结果不一致。作者最后为学习者、评分者和 Scratch 平台提出建议（如显式管理启动顺序、增强平台对调度依赖的检测与提示等）。

Abstract: Tens of millions of children program in Scratch, whose programs are concurrent: when the green flag is clicked, every sprite's scripts start together and share the project's state. Which script starts first is decided by the sprites' front-to-back stacking order, which no block reads. Dragging a sprite brings it to the front, and the order is saved with the project. Hence, a program can work on the author's screen and fail on the teacher's, with the same blocks. Our key observation is that, with the rest of the file fixed, rearranging the sprites that start scripts among their positions produces exactly the permutations of their initial stacking order. Under a fixed input and seed the unmodified virtual machine reproduces every one of them. StackSwap runs a project under these orders, all of them for up to five sprites, one per class of a conflict graph beyond, and a sample where neither is feasible, and compares the runs under four observation lenses. It returns a two-run witness naming an adjacent pair of sprites whose swap changes the outcome, with the resources they share as candidate causes; otherwise an exhaustive or graph-conditional robustness certificate, or an unresolved verdict. On 767 real programs from a course, an online judge, and a random public sample, 26.4% (course) and 18.2% (public) of those with a scheduling choice behave differently under some stacking order. Among the sensitive programs whose every order ran, the saved order's outcome recurs under a median 17% (course) and 50% (public) of the orders. Under scripted play, a predicate written from a stated requirement holds under one order and fails under another for 5 of 427 student submissions with a scheduling choice. For half of the sensitive programs the random stream is the racing pair's highest-priority shared resource. We close with recommendations for learners, graders, and the Scratch platform.

</details>


### [396] [Live Architecture Models for Cloud-Native Architecture-as-Code: Early Results from Kubernetes Conformance Checking](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36148)
*Denis Mamatin,Andrey Salov*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 该论文研究"活架构模型"：将可编辑架构建模与Kubernetes运行时事实通过显式对应关系和周期性一致性检查相连，基于KDL子集和Archer原型验证可行性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基础设施漂移会使运行中的Kubernetes系统偏离其记录的架构意图。作者希望通过可编辑、与运行时同步的架构模型，暴露模型与集群之间的不一致。

Method: 提出活架构模型方法：编辑性架构表示通过显式对应关系连接到选定运行时事实，并周期性做一致性检查。用KDL的Archer专用子集和VS Code原型Archer（文本与图形同步视图）实现。快照恢复将选定Kubernetes事实提取为KDL；周期性及按需只读检查报告模型-集群不一致，不强制或修复部署状态。评估采用3个精选功能Kubernetes示例应用和作者自定义协议，报告快照恢复与选定不一致检测的精确率和召回率。

Result: 在所评估的KDL范围内支持可行性；恢复分数可由保存的ground-truth和恢复模型复现，检测使用文档化的手动扰动协议。结果不证明比较优越性、任意生产漂移检测、可扩展性或开发者收益。

Conclusion: 该工作初步证明活架构模型在受限范围内可行，但存在存储覆盖率与ingress-host表示/默认处理等局限，未来需验证更广泛的漂移类型、可扩展性和实际开发者价值。

Abstract: Infrastructure drift can separate a running Kubernetes system from its documented architectural intent. This paper investigates live architecture models: editable architectural representations connected to selected runtime facts through explicit correspondences and recurring conformance checks. The approach is instantiated through an Archer-specific subset of Kubernetes Deployment Language (KDL) and Archer, a VS Code prototype with synchronized textual and graphical views. Snapshot recovery extracts selected Kubernetes facts into KDL; periodic and on-demand read-only checks report model-cluster inconsistencies without enforcing or repairing deployment state.
  We assess feasibility on three feature-selected Kubernetes example applications under an author-defined protocol, reporting precision and recall for snapshot recovery and selected inconsistency detection. Recovery scores can be reproduced from saved ground-truth and recovered models; detection uses a documented manual perturbation protocol. The results support feasibility within the evaluated KDL scope. They do not establish comparative superiority, detection of arbitrary production drift, scalability, or developer benefit. Storage coverage and ingress-host representation/default handling remain limitations.

</details>


### [397] [The Invisible Throttle: Running on Borrowed Time in Scratch](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36152)
*Xinyue Feng,Hanyuan Shi,Yuan Si*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: Scratch中"循环每帧一次"的说法其实是例外；循环速度受重绘门控和机器预算影响，可被隐藏精灵/改变预算/无渲染器改变，导致速率敏感程序，ThrottleCheck检测并报告此类问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Scratch教学声称循环每帧执行一次，但实际虚拟机的帧循环由重绘门控决定，导致循环速度依赖可见精灵和机器性能，文档未说明此规则，造成程序行为不一致与评分不公。

Method: 观察重绘门控是整个运行时的一个标志；ThrottleCheck在未修改虚拟机上实现带预算语义（规定每帧轮数、模拟重绘门控），通过各旋钮运行项目并报告速率敏感项目及见证。

Result: 500个流行游戏中59%含永不绘制或不等待的循环；静音绘制精灵请求在24%游戏中10秒后状态改变，隐藏18%，无渲染器且无门控61%；固定时间读取位置/分数/时钟的规则在此后17%示例测试和19%教程检查（224个remix）中反转。

Conclusion: 无渲染器的评分器实际评估的是编辑器从不运行的程序，除非模拟门控并声明预算；作者给出评分器与平台应做之事，并用一句孩子能懂的话总结。

Abstract: Scratch has 135 million registered users, most of them children, and 164 million shared projects. What they are taught about the speed of a script fits in one sentence: a loop iterates once per frame. Unfortunately, that sentence describes the exception. In the public virtual machine a frame repeats the scripts until something visible asks the screen to redraw, no script is left running, or three quarters of the frame's wall-clock time are spent. Hence a loop that does not draw is paced by whatever else is visible and by the machine. Hide the moving sprite of a two-sprite project, and the other's counting loop runs 77,000 times faster on a laptop. No documentation states the rule. Our key observation is that the redraw gate is one flag for the whole runtime, so a loop's speed can be changed without touching its code: hide the sprite that draws, change the machine's budget, or run the program in a tool with no renderer. ThrottleCheck implements a budgeted semantics (a stated budget of rounds per frame, the redraw gate emulated) on the unmodified virtual machine, runs a project under each knob, and reports a rate-sensitive project with a witness. On 500 popular public games, 59% contain a loop that never draws and never waits. Muting the requests of the sprites that draw changes the state of a played game after ten seconds in 24% of the games that have one; hiding them changes 18%; running the game without a renderer and without the gate changes 61%. Rules that read a position, a score or a clock after a fixed time reverse between pass and fail once the throttle is released, in 17% of Whisker's own example tests and 19% of a tutorial's checks on 224 of its remixes. A grader without a renderer grades a program the editor never runs, unless it emulates the gate and states a budget; we say what graders and the platform should do, and close with the sentence a child could be taught.

</details>


### [398] [From Dead Code and Static Requirements to Working Engines: Software Revival with Coding Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36161)
*Tianyu Liu,Dingyuan Dai,Yufan Du,Zhen Yang*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 提出ReviveBench基准，含"复活"与"重建"两类任务，用隐藏验证器评估编码智能体恢复和重构软件的能力，并揭示验证器本身的测量误差。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探究编码智能体能否在保留底层方法的前提下恢复无法运行的软件，以及能否从开放规范重建工业软件引擎。

Method: 构建ReviveBench基准，包含两大家族：复活家族（10个任务，涉及依赖不兼容、核心模块删除、遗留构建、GPU基础模型）与重建家族（13个任务，涵盖数值、几何、硬件、事务系统），由隐藏验证器评分，验证器对照原生执行环境、成熟工程工具或专门参考实现进行校准；并开展污染控制实验与验证器缺陷审计。

Result: 复活任务中每个初始工作区均验证失败，最强模型各至少一次通过全部10项；标识符混淆使相似度从0.51–0.96降至0.03–0.44且不影响通过率；知识截止后新建仓库任务中9次运行通过8次。重建任务中两个模型全部通过13项，但CFD任务无法证明数值求解能力。共发现28个验证器缺陷（24个假阴性、2个假阳性）。

Conclusion: ReviveBench既评估软件复活与引擎重建，也说明可执行验证本身会引入显著测量误差；提出三项实用检查：验证规定方法能否达到评分阈值、考察独立生成候选间的一致性、从提交产物重算诊断指标。
