TL;DR: 提出Co-PiLOT潜空间逆设计框架，通过生成式编解码器+物理信息黑箱优化，结合MERIDIAN优化器实现镁合金微观结构逆设计，误差降低3-22%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 逆设计问题中，高维结构优化面临空间非欧几里得、可行性难编码、每次仿真评估昂贵的困难，直接搜索难以进行。

Method: Co-PiLOT将候选者映射通过生成式编解码器，用解码器作为学习到的有效性先验，在潜空间用物理信息黑箱优化搜索。基于视觉Transformer编码器，配合扩散/DiT/整流流解码器在约8万EBSD微观结构数据集学习最小瓶颈z。ViT-FMDiT（z=768）重建图像，自分割取向编解码转为晶体塑性求解器输入。MERIDIAN由深度核GP不确定性、失败感知可行性预测、流形感知信任域和目标感知采集驱动。

Result: ViT-FMDiT重建高保真微观结构（FID 27.86，MS-SSIM 0.178）。在160次仿真预算内，该组合取得最佳目标驱动得分，相对目标误差较七个基线（DANTE、TuRBO、BAxUS、CMA-ES、DDOM、SEIKO、DDPO）降低3-22%。

Conclusion: Co-PiLOT+MERIDIAN框架在镁合金微观结构/织构逆设计中有效，显著优于多个主流基线。

Abstract: Inverse design of physical systems (molecules, devices, microstructures) often reduces to optimizing a high-dimensional structure against an expensive black-box simulator. Direct search is difficult because the space is non-Euclidean, feasibility is hard to encode, and each evaluation is expensive. We present Co-PiLOT, a latent optimization approach that maps candidates through a generative encoder-decoder, uses the decoder as a learned validity prior, and searches the latent space with physics-informed black-box optimization. The framework is applied on the inverse design of magnesium alloy microstructure/texture. We develop a vision transformer based-encoder; paired with latent diffusion, diffusion transformer and rectified-flow transformer-based decoders on $\sim80{,}000$ EBSD-derived microstructure dataset to learn a minimal bottleneck, $z$. The ViT-FMDiT model ($z$=$768$) reconstructs high-fidelity microstructure images (FID $27.86$, MS-SSIM $0.178$), which our self-segmenting orientation codec converts into input grids for crystal plasticity solver. Finally, we introduce MERIDIAN, an active latent optimizer driven by deep-kernel Gaussian-process uncertainty, failure-aware feasibility prediction, manifold-aware trust regions, and target-aware acquisition. Within a budget of $160$ simulations, the ViT-FMDiT and MERIDIAN combination yields the best target-driven objective score, reducing the relative target error by $3$--$22\%$ against seven baselines (DANTE, TuRBO, BAxUS, CMA-ES, DDOM, SEIKO, DDPO) on the same decoder.

</details>


### [609] [Guide, Then Let Go: Gap-Adaptive Teacher Scheduling for Sparse-Reward Agentic RL](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37898)
*Youling Huang,Tiankuo Xu,Jiaji Liu,Tong Zheng,Shuo Zhou,Shaotong Qi,Junchi Yao,Shiyang Liu,Hao Xu,Pengcheng Xu,Bo Huang,Hongyi Fu,Lin Lin*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出GATS，通过自适应调整教师指导权重的on-policy蒸馏解决长程智能体RL的冷启动问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长程任务的稀疏结果奖励导致严重冷启动：早期策略失败使奖励信号稀缺；蒸馏的收益取决于师生性能差距，差距大时有益、差距缩小甚至反转时有害。

Method: 用on-policy蒸馏(OPD)在学生自身rollout上提供token级指导；提出Gap-Adaptive Teacher Scheduling (GATS)，在RL目标中加入OPD项，其权重随师生性能差距自适应调整——学生接近教师参考性能时逐步降低指导，达到后撤除。

Result: 在ALFWorld、WebShop、ScienceWorld上，三种Qwen2.5师生配置中GATS平均成功率均为最高，在相同学生rollout预算下比纯奖励GRPO提升4.37%-11.87%。

Conclusion: 自适应师生调度可有效利用（甚至更小的）任务训练教师缓解冷启动，Y先引导后放手（guide-then-let-go）策略优于持续蒸馏。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning for long-horizon agents typically relies on sparse outcome-based rewards. This leads to a severe cold-start problem, as early-stage policies often fail to solve sampled tasks, leaving little useful reward signal for learning. To mitigate this problem, we use on-policy distillation (OPD) to provide token-level guidance on the student's own rollouts. We find that the benefit of this guidance depends on the performance gap between the teacher and the student. When the teacher substantially outperforms the student, distillation helps guide the student through the early training stage where outcome rewards provide little learning signal. As the gap narrows and eventually reverses, however, continued distillation becomes less beneficial and may hinder further improvement. Motivated by this observation, we propose Gap-Adaptive Teacher Scheduling (GATS), which augments the student's RL objective with an OPD term whose weight adapts to the teacher-student performance gap. Specifically, GATS gradually reduces teacher guidance as the student approaches the teacher's reference performance and withdraws it once that reference is reached. This enables GATS to leverage task-trained teachers smaller than the student, since teacher guidance is primarily needed during early training. Across ALFWorld, WebShop, and ScienceWorld with three Qwen2.5 teacher-student configurations, GATS achieves the highest average success rate among the compared methods in all three configurations, improving over reward-only GRPO by 4.37%-11.87% under matched student rollout budgets. Code is available at https://github.com/Ricardo-H/guide-then-let-go.

</details>


### [610] [You Cannot Pick a Provider From the Price List: Market-Aware Routing for Open-Weight LLM Inference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37902)
*Liang He,Jingbo Wen,Yixiong Chen,Yue Yang,Qizhen Lan,Kangning Cui,Xilu Wang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文揭示开放权重推理市场中"同模型不同供应商"是一个被忽视的决策维度，并提出市场感知的路由方案FACET，通过认证每个(供应商×任务)的可行性来在保证质量的同时选择更便宜的端点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM路由器仅基于静态的每模型成本做选择，忽略了开放权重市场引入的第二个决策轴：选定模型后还需选择由哪个供应商提供服务。测数据显示同一模型在不同供应商间的质量、延迟、可用性和价格差异巨大，无法从价格表推断，且供应商可行性具有任务选择性。

Method: 将同模型供应商选择形式化为价格接受者的市场感知路由问题。先提出简单的"测量地图"策略，路由到既质量等价又健康的最便宜供应商。针对地图漂移问题，提出在线路由器FACET，为每个(供应商×任务)认证可行性facet，在服务未认证臂之前安全回退到锚点，并处理不完美任务分配、稀疏反馈和评估者偏差。

Result: 在[nummodels]个开放模型、多供应商、多任务类型及三次测量波次上验证：高价供应商持续更快，但价格不能可靠预测质量或可用性；FACET在放宽部署假设下容忍不完美任务分配与稀疏反馈；系统性评估者偏差暴露了质量信号信任边界，可通过真值探针或审计缓解；实测运行确认认证可将真实流量从高价锚点迁移到更便宜的认证端点。

Conclusion: 市场感知的LLM路由不仅要测量"用哪个模型"，还要测量"由谁提供服务"。供应商选择是同模型推理中独立且重要的决策维度，需要在线认证机制来应对地图漂移与任务选择性问题。

Abstract: Existing LLM routers choose among models using static per-model costs. We show that open-weight inference markets introduce a second, largely ignored decision axis: after choosing a model, a client must still choose which provider serves it. Measuring live endpoints across [nummodels] open models, competing providers, multiple task types, and three measurement waves, we find that provider choice cannot be inferred from the price list. The same model can vary sharply in quality, latency, availability, and price across providers; higher-priced providers are consistently faster, but price does not reliably predict quality or availability; and provider feasibility is task-selective, with one deployment nearly normal on knowledge tasks but catastrophically degraded on multi-step reasoning. We formulate same-model provider selection as a price-taker market-aware routing problem. A simple measured-map policy routes to the cheapest provider that is both quality-equivalent and healthy, yielding matched-quality savings while avoiding degraded endpoints. Because the map drifts, we introduce FACET, an online provider router that certifies per-(provider x task) feasibility facets and fails safe to an anchor before serving uncertified arms. Across relaxed deployment assumptions, FACET tolerates imperfect task assignment and sparse feedback, while systematic evaluator bias exposes a quality-signal trust boundary that can be mitigated with ground-truth probes or audits. Live provider runs further confirm that certification can move real traffic from a premium anchor to a substantially cheaper certified endpoint. Our results suggest that market-aware LLM routing must measure not only which model to use, but also who serves it.

</details>


### [611] [Pixels to Keys: Exploring Spatial and Motion Cues in Gameplay Inverse Dynamics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37907)
*Abhishek Pillai,Ekta Prashnani,Joohwan Kim,Iuri Frosio*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文研究数据受限场景下的逆动力学模型（IDM），分析空间运动特征、模型架构和训练目标对从游戏视频推断玩家输入的影响，并强调逐动作与平衡指标评估的重要性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在线游戏视频丰富但缺少玩家输入标注，IDM可用于从帧推断输入。已有大规模IDM展示可行性，但未明确关键组件，且仅报告聚合准确率，掩盖了稀有动作的失败。

Method: 在数据受限场景下，针对Trackmania游戏，系统评估空间运动特征、模型架构与训练目标对IDM的影响，并采用逐按键与平衡指标（如F1_macro）进行分析；随后将相同架构与训练方案应用于Cyberpunk 2077。

Result: Trackmania实验表明模型架构和预处理中的运动流提取很关键，且非平衡指标会掩盖问题；Cyberpunk 2077上表现随游戏机制不同而不均。逐动作评估揭示出相机运动、延迟效应和按键频率不均衡带来的歧义。

Conclusion: 未来IDM实现需显式建模3D场景结构与长期状态，并采用合适的损失函数，以应对相机运动、延迟效应和输入分布不平衡等问题。

Abstract: Video games offer scalable environments for studying perception and control in embodied agents.Abundant online gameplay videos could supply demonstrations, but they rarely include player inputs for training. Inverse Dynamics Models (IDMs) have thus been proposed to infer inputs from frames. Large (up to 1B parameters) IDMs trained on $\sim$1K-2K gameplay hours demonstrate feasibility and cross-environment generalization at this scale, but researchers do not clarify what the key components are to recover individual actions and often report only aggregate accuracy that can mask rare-action failures. We study the problem in a data-constrained scenario to evaluate how spatial motion features, model architectures, and training objectives affect an IDM's outcome and we analyse our models on per-key and balanced metrics such as $F_1^{macro}$. Our experiments on Trackmania highlight the importance of factors like the model architecture and motion flow extraction in preprocessing, while also showing the limits of evaluation through unbalanced metrics. The application of the same architecture and training recipe to Cyberpunk 2077 reveals uneven performance across game mechanics. Our per-action evaluation and failure analysis highlight ambiguities from camera motion, delayed effects and imbalanced key-press frequencies that call for explicit modeling of 3D scene structure, long-term state and the adoption of proper losses in future implementations.

</details>


### [612] [GRFBrain: Graph-Structured Rectified Flows for EEG Dynamic Modeling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37934)
*Haohui Jia,Zheng Chen,Jathurshan Pradeepkumar,Xu Cao,Yasuko Matsubara,Yasushi Sakurai,Takashi Matsubara*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出图结构残差流框架，将条件均值预测与随机残差传输分离，用于EEG动态功能连接预测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: EEG功能连接预测需同时建模历史依赖趋势与跨通道结构化变异；条件流匹配虽可用于分布预测，但图信息源分布相较各向同性噪声和强确定性预测器是否有实际优势尚不明确。

Method: 用仅基于历史的预测器估计未来连接图作为条件均值；以拉普拉斯协方差构建图高斯源分布编码过去连接依赖；用条件速度场将源样本传输到未来图残差，并区分传输时间与物理EEG时间。

Result: 研究识别了区分有效残差传输与来自确定性预测、学习表征及采样效应的改进所需的条件与控制（摘要未给出具体数值结果）。

Conclusion: 图结构残差流框架为EEG动态功能连接预测提供了分离均值预测与随机传输的研究路径，并强调需控制混淆因素以评估其真实增益。

Abstract: Forecasting time-varying functional connectivity from electroencephalography (EEG) requires modeling both history-dependent trends and structured variability across channels. Conditional flow matching provides a framework for distributional forecasting, yet it remains unclear whether graph-informed source distributions offer practical advantages over isotropic noise and strong deterministic predictors. We introduce a graph-structured residual flow framework that separates conditional mean prediction from stochastic residual transport. A history-only predictor estimates the future connectivity graph, while a graph Gaussian source encodes dependencies derived from past connectivity through a Laplacian-based covariance. A conditional velocity field transports source samples to future graph residuals, with transport time explicitly distinguished from physical EEG time. Our study identifies the conditions and controls needed to distinguish useful residual transport from improvements attributable to deterministic prediction, learned representations, and sampling effects.

</details>


### [613] [Video-RSI: Recursive Self-Improvement of Video Understanding Agents via Harness Evolution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37950)
*Bingjun Luo,Jialin Guo,Siqi Li*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出Video-RSI框架，让视频理解智能体用自身语言模型改写执行工具链（harness），通过主动视频调查验证失败原因，并结合成本感知演化提升准确率同时降低帧数。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视频理解智能体的执行轨迹仅包含当前harness获得的证据，无法分辨相互竞争的失败解释，限制了自我改进的依据。

Method: 递归自我改进框架：模型通过主动视频调查回看原始训练视频，用额外观察检验竞争性失败解释，将诊断落地于轨迹之外的证据；采用成本感知的harness演化，把诊断转为可复用修订，并综合答案准确率与视觉成本决定保留哪些修订。

Result: 在视频理解基准的多项评估设置中，演化后的智能体在更少帧数下提升准确率，并在准确率-效率权衡上优于现有视频理解智能体。

Conclusion: 结果表明视频理解智能体能够通过harness演化改进自身的证据获取与使用。代码已开源。

Abstract: Video understanding agents acquire evidence through an executable harness that controls what they observe and how they use those observations. However, execution traces contain only the evidence acquired by the current harness, leaving competing explanations for failure unresolved and limiting the basis for self-improvement. We introduce Video-RSI, a framework for recursive self-improvement in which a video understanding agent uses its own language model to revise its harness. Through active video investigation, the model revisits the original training videos to test competing failure explanations with additional observations, grounding proposed changes in evidence beyond the existing trace. Cost-aware harness evolution turns these diagnoses into reusable revisions and determines which revisions to retain by considering both answer accuracy and visual cost. Across our evaluation settings on video understanding benchmarks, the evolved agent improves accuracy while processing fewer frames and achieves competitive accuracy-efficiency trade-offs against existing video understanding agents. These results demonstrate the potential for video understanding agents to improve their own evidence acquisition and use through harness evolution. Code is available at https://github.com/bingjunluo/Video-RSI .

</details>


### [614] [Topological Coherence for Self-evolving Multi-agent Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37953)
*Sen Zhao,Ruiqi Kong,Zuyu Zhang,Lifeng Shen,Xinyu He,Xu Zhang,Qinghua Zhang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出TOCOMAS，一种拓扑一致的多智能体系统，将任务图锚定到工具接口，划分责任域，并推导协作与记忆可见性，实现智能体、协作和记忆的联合自演化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法可联合优化智能体与通信结构，但优化本身不要求责任、交接与记忆边界同任务依赖保持一致，这种一致性（拓扑一致性）被忽略。

Method: TOCOMAS将任务图锚定到工具接口，把兼容任务节点组织为可复用责任域，推导依赖诱导与profile条件的协作，以及边界调控的记忆可见性；在线自演化中提出智能体、协作和记忆策略的耦合变更，仅保留满足结构约束并提升评估奖励的候选。

Result: 在BBEH、WorkBench、SWE-Bench-Verified和CoMemBench上，TOCOMAS跨不同骨干网络提升任务成功率；CoMemBench还显示其在验证进展、交接和记忆隔离上优于自演化基线。

Conclusion: 通过强制拓扑一致性，TOCOMAS实现了智能体、协作与记忆结构的有效耦合自演化，提升了复杂任务表现与记忆隔离能力。

Abstract: Complex tasks inherently couple workflow structure, agent responsibility, collaboration, and memory access: task regions delimit responsibility and tool scope, cross-region dependencies give rise to handoffs, and ownership boundaries delimit private and selectively shared memory. Existing methods can jointly optimize agent and communication structures, yet such optimization does not by itself require responsibility, handoff, and memory boundaries to remain consistent with task dependencies. We term this requirement topological coherence. We introduce TOCOMAS, a Topology-Coherent Multi-Agent System. TOCOMAS grounds a task graph in tool interfaces, organizes compatible task nodes into reusable responsibility domains, and derives dependency-induced and profile-conditioned collaboration together with boundary-regulated memory visibility. During online self-evolution, TOCOMAS proposes coupled changes to agent, collaboration, and memory policies, retaining for subsequent tasks only candidates that satisfy structural constraints and improve evaluated reward. Across BBEH, WorkBench, SWE-Bench-Verified, and CoMemBench, TOCOMAS improves task success over baselines across backbones. CoMemBench also shows gains over the self-evolving baseline in verified progress, handoffs, and memory isolation.

</details>


### [615] [BrainNet Studio: A Unified Toolkit for Brain Network Construction, Intelligent Analysis, and Visualization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37956)
*Xiwei Zeng,Shengrong Li,Yiheng Liu,Chunwei Tian,Daoqiang Zhang,Qi Zhu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: BrainNet Studio是一个集成脑网络分析工具包，统一支持静态与动态脑网络建模，涵盖27种算法、深度学习与图神经网络，并集成大语言模型辅助解读。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统静态网络无法充分表达脑网络的时变拓扑与高阶时空依赖，现有工具多聚焦静态连接组，缺乏动态建模与现代图/序列学习方法的整合。

Method: 构建统一工作流，涵盖网络构建、特征提取、预测建模、候选生物标志物识别、可视化与辅助解读；集成27种算法（含深度学习、图神经网络、时空序列模型）；使用大语言模型生成可验证的总结。

Result: 支持分类及判别性脑区与连接识别；LLM可生成个体与群体层面的功能连接、结构连接及结构-功能耦合总结；用户可在统一框架中配置任务、比较方法、检视输出并扩展功能。

Conclusion: BrainNet Studio为认知神经科学、脑疾病探索研究与脑机接口提供实用且可扩展的连接组分析平台，已开源。

Abstract: Brain networks characterize structural and functional relationships among brain regions and support research on cognition, brain disorders, and brain-computer interfaces. Their time-varying topology and higher-order spatiotemporal dependencies are not adequately represented by conventional static networks. Existing tools primarily focus on static connectomes and provide limited integration of dynamic network modeling with modern graph and sequence learning methods. We present BrainNet Studio, an integrated toolkit for static and dynamic brain network analysis. It provides a unified workflow encompassing network construction, feature extraction, predictive modeling, candidate biomarker identification, visualization, and assisted interpretation. The toolkit integrates 27 algorithms, including deep learning, graph neural networks, and spatiotemporal sequence models, to support classification and the identification of discriminative brain regions and connections. A large language model generates researcher-verifiable summaries of functional connectivity, structural connectivity, and structure-function coupling at individual and group levels. Within a consistent computational framework, users can configure analytical tasks, compare methods, inspect outputs, and extend functionality without repeatedly assembling application-specific pipelines. BrainNet Studio provides a practical and extensible platform for connectome analysis in cognitive neuroscience, exploratory studies of brain disorders, and brain-computer interfaces. The toolkit is publicly available at https://github.com/xbrainnet/Brainnet-Studio.

</details>


### [616] [KV-Kaizen: Learning Context-Adaptive Cache Compression Choices](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37988)
*Joao Monteiro,Louis Béthune,Anastasiia Filippova,Sonia Laguna,David Grangier,Marco Cuturi*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出 KV-Kaizen，通过学习一个在推理前运行的 selector，沿深度共享、精度降低和低秩截断三轴自适应地为每层配置 KV cache，实现无需驱逐 token 的大幅 cache 压缩。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM 上下文增大导致 KV cache 可能超过模型权重显存，解码受内存带宽限制、随 cache 增大而变慢。已有工作通过丢弃最不相关 token 缓解，但一次性驱逐决策可能后续有害。

Method: 不驱逐 token，而是学习一个基于上下文、为每层生成 cache 配置的 selector，沿三轴压缩：跨层共享同一 cache（depth）、用更少比特缓存（precision）、截断低秩 latent 表示（rank）。关键在于不是对所有层统一施加干预，而是局部、自适应地组合这些选择；selector 在 pre-fill 前只运行一次。

Result: 在指令跟随和推理任务上达到精度-缓存大小的 Pareto 前沿，优于无学习和事后基线；长上下文任务上优于驱逐并可与之组合，14B 模型解码期 cache 缩小 32x 且保持精度；7B 起 4x 压缩无精度损失；压缩后模型比同等 cache 大小的更小未压缩模型更准。

Conclusion: 结果表明可先预训练大模型、事后再压缩 cache，支持"训练大、后压缩"的范式。

Abstract: As the context size of text processed with an LLM grows, the size of KV caches can outstrip the memory allocated for the original model weights. This impacts LLM throughput negatively, since decoding is memory-bound and decode cost grows with cache size. Recent work alleviates this bottleneck by discarding the least relevant tokens. Eviction introduces a tension, since a one-off decision to discard content may prove detrimental later. Instead, we focus on alternative choices that can lead to cache compression without evicting tokens. We achieve this by learning a selector that is able to produce, based on context, a per-layer cache configuration towards an overall compression budget. The selector operates along three axes: sharing one cache across layers (depth), caching at fewer bits (precision), or truncating the low-rank latent cache representations (rank). We call the resulting method KV-Kaizen, for the many small per-layer choices it compounds. We observe that these interventions taken independently and uniformly over all layers limit achievable compression because they degrade accuracy. Crucially, composing them locally and adaptively to the context can instead preserve accuracy while achieving large memory savings. At inference, the selector runs once, before pre-fill. In evaluations on instruction following and reasoning tasks, our selectors reach the Pareto frontier of accuracy against cache size, against learning-free and post-hoc baselines. On long-context tasks, KV-Kaizen improves on eviction and can be composed with it, reaching a 32x smaller decode-time cache on a 14B model while preserving accuracy. A 4x cache size reduction incurs no accuracy degradation from 7B parameters up, and a compressed model is more accurate than a smaller uncompressed one with the same cache size. Together, these findings support pre-training large models and compressing them only afterwards.

</details>


### [617] [Which Attention Heads are like the Human Head? Not the Ones that Compute](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37991)
*Christopher Pinier,Gustaw Opiełka,Hannes Rosenbusch,Taylor Webb,Michael D. Nunez,Claire E. Stevenson*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文比较LLM注意力头与人脑EEG的对齐与其对任务计算的因果贡献，发现二者可分离：脑对齐头参与任务但移除后破坏性远小于归因选取的头。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 脑-AI对齐常被解读为模型与人脑执行相似计算，但很少有人验证这些对齐单元是否因果性地参与模型计算。作者希望检验对齐与因果之间的关系。

Method: 在抽象模式补全任务（AAABAAA→B）上，比较LLM注意力头表征与人类EEG，并做消融实验。对比两类先验定义的头集合：概念向量（CVs，跨格式表示抽象模式）与功能向量（FVs，用于预测正确答案）。在17个模型（3B-72B）上分析。

Result: 对齐与因果分离：脑对齐头有贡献，但移除的破坏性远小于归因挑选的头。脑对齐与FV得分关联弱，与CV关联随模型变化。发现两类脑对齐头：新颖头（关注独特元素）与重复头（关注重复元素）。新颖头追踪显著性、注视人类关注元素，但移除比随机消融破坏更小；重复头贡献较小且与CV相关。FV排序移除比脑排序移除破坏性大得多。

Conclusion: 脑对齐主要反映模型如何读取刺激，仅微弱反映其如何表征模式与解决任务。

Abstract: Brain-AI alignment is often interpreted as a sign that model and brain perform similar computations. Whether the aligned units are causally involved in model computation is rarely checked. On an abstract pattern-completion task (AAABAAA $\rightarrow$ B), we compare LLM attention-head representations with human EEG and test how ablating those heads affects task performance. Alignment and causation dissociate: brain-aligned heads contribute to performance, but their removal is substantially less disruptive than removal of heads selected via attribution patching. We compare two head sets that prior interpretability work defines without reference to the brain: concept vectors (CVs), which represent abstract patterns across formats, and function vectors (FVs), selected for their contribution to correct-answer prediction. Brain alignment shows little association with FV scores, while its association with CV scores varies across models. Among brain-aligned heads, we find recurring attention profiles: one emphasizes distinctive elements (novelty heads), the other repeating elements (repetition heads). The novelty family tracks salience and attends to the same elements that humans look at, yet its removal is less damaging than random ablation on average. Repetition heads contribute modestly to performance and are associated with abstract-pattern representation (CVs). Across 17 models spanning 3B-72B parameters, FV-ranked removal is substantially more disruptive than brain-ranked removal. Brain alignment thus captures how the model reads the stimulus, and only faintly captures how it represents the pattern and solves the task.

</details>


### [618] [Diagnosing and Improving Probabilistic Reasoning in Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38005)
*Huaman Sun,Dingcheng Wang,Jason Hartline,Jessica Hullman*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出决策论框架，将LLM决策损失分解为“信念形成”与“信念到行动转化”两部分，并用合成基准和RL实验刻画概率推理能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM被越来越多地用作需在明确决策成本下进行概率推理的决策助手，但其决策能力究竟是信念不准还是行动转化不佳尚不清楚，需要可分解、可量化的分析框架。

Method: 构建有已知真值的合成基准，将决策损失分解为信念形成与决策转化两部分；对前沿及开源模型进行评估；用RL干预分别针对信念、决策或两者，跨三个领域测试改进是否迁移（跨组件、跨引出格式）。

Result: 针对单一组件训练会重新分配决策损失，改善目标组件但不一定迁移到其他组件；同时训练信念形成与决策可改善两者，但依赖于训练与评估格式匹配；决策表现可在信念形成未改善的情况下提升。

Conclusion: 概率推理的两组件存在权衡与耦合，RL干预效果受格式匹配影响；需针对性设计训练与评估以同时提升信念与决策。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly proposed as decision assistants who must reason probabilistically from available evidence under explicit decision costs. We propose a decision-theoretic framework that decomposes LLMs' decision loss into two components: forming accurate beliefs from provided evidence and translating those beliefs into actions that optimize a provided utility function. Using a synthetic benchmark with known ground truth, we apply the decomposition to characterize probabilistic reasoning in frontier and open-sourced models. We further evaluate whether RL interventions targeting beliefs, decisions, or both improve these components across three domains, whether improvements transfer across components and elicitation formats, and whether decision performance can improve without improvement in belief formation. We find that targeting one component of probabilistic reasoning redistributes decision loss, improving the target without necessarily transferring to others, and that jointly targeting belief formation and decision-making improves both but hinges on matched formats between training and evaluation.

</details>


### [619] [HARISSA: Inference-Time Self-Checks for Efficient and Safe Local Language Model Deployment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38006)
*Kenan Alkiek,Moontae Lee,David Jurgens,V. G. Vinod Vydiswaran*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: HARISSA利用模型隐藏状态预测正确性，仅用单一策略级联不同回答方式，在本地部署中同时优化效率与安全。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 本地运行大模型虽在隐私、延迟和成本上有优势，但硬件仅支持能力较弱的小模型。对难题通常升级到云端会牺牲隐私与成本优势，因此本地部署需自行决定：哪些查询值得投入更多计算（效率），以及哪些答案可安全交付（安全），错误交付不如转人工。

Method: HARISSA基于模型自身隐藏状态做两类判断：生成前prefill状态预测模型能否答对；答案末尾的answer状态预测该答案是否正确。通过微调使两种状态都能预测正确性，再用单一策略沿从最低到最高成本的回答方式级联：跳过prefill预测会失败的路径，若最终答案被预测为错误则转人工。

Result: 单模型设备上，HARISSA准确率与思维链相差不到1个百分点，延迟低2.7倍；服务器持四种规模模型时，同等延迟下比FrugalGPT和Self-REF级联更准；同等转人工率下，answer状态在六组任务与设置中的五组比标准置信信号留下更少错误答案。

Conclusion: HARISSA表明仅凭模型隐藏状态即可同时实现效率与安全的本地部署决策，在精度、延迟和错误控制上优于现有级联与置信方法。

Abstract: Running a language model locally offers advantages in privacy, latency, and cost, but local hardware fits only small models, which are less capable than frontier models. The usual remedy for a hard query, escalating it to a cloud model, gives up the privacy and cost advantages of running locally. A deployment that stays local faces two decisions for hard queries instead. First, it can spend more computation on a query, e.g., reasoning before answering, which raises accuracy at a cost in latency, so it must decide which queries are worth the extra computation (efficiency). Second, some queries are beyond the local model, and delivering a wrong answer is worse than deferring the query to a human in the loop, so it must decide which answers are safe to deliver (safety). We show that both decisions can be made from the model's own hidden states. The prefill state, computed before any token is generated, predicts whether the model will answer correctly, and the answer state, at the end of the generated answer, predicts whether that answer is correct. HARISSA fine-tunes the model so that both states predict correctness, then makes both decisions with one policy that cascades through the ways of answering from cheapest to most expensive, skipping a way the prefill state predicts will fail and deferring the query when the answer it stops with is predicted wrong. On a device running a single model, HARISSA is within one accuracy point of chain-of-thought at 2.7 times lower latency. On a server holding four sizes of one model, HARISSA is more accurate than the FrugalGPT and Self-REF cascades at the same latency, and at the same deferral rate the answer state leaves fewer wrong answers than the standard confidence signals in five of six task and setting pairs.

</details>


### [620] [Brain-SAD: A Brain-Inspired Safe Autonomous Driving Control Framework with Dynamic Fear-Oriented Constraint on Dual-Policy](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38016)
*Huan Rong,Chao Yin,Anouar Imel,Yijie Xia,Tinghuai Ma*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出Brain-SAD，一种受大脑启发的安全自动驾驶框架，通过动态恐惧导向约束解决现有约束强化学习中约束静态化的问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有约束RL在自动驾驶中缺乏动态约束能力：原始-对偶/软约束方法的动作代价是静态的状态到代价映射，硬约束方法依赖由离线演示估计的固定可行域边界的静态投影。这导致约束与训练场景紧耦合，使自动驾驶策略难以应对不同交互场景，因为状态级动作代价不当且投影边界固定。

Method: 提出Brain-SAD框架：通过感知当前车-交互场景，生成动态恐惧信号作为恐惧反应，据此在线决策长期策略（常规交互）或短期策略（紧急碰撞防御）。在这两种策略中，恐惧反应被构建为动态恐惧约束：分别反映与动作影响直接耦合的整体恐惧代价，以及来自不同风险邻近车辆的动态可行域边界，二者进一步用于在线策略优化。

Result: 实验结果表明，Brain-SAD优于现有方法：任务完成时间与碰撞恢复时间更短、成功率更高，并在复杂度波动的连续路口场景中展现出更强的可靠性。

Conclusion: 通过引入动态恐惧导向约束，Brain-SAD克服了静态约束的局限，提升了自动驾驶策略在多变交互场景下的安全性与可靠性。

Abstract: Constrained Reinforcement Learning has recently gained increasing attention in the field of Safe Autonomous Driving, where the general mechanism is to maximize the expected reward while keeping the overall action risk bounded. In this way, the safety issues arising in AD can be mitigated through constrained actions. However, existing Constrained RL methods still lack dynamics on the imposed constraints. For instance, the action cost adopted by the existing Primal-Dual/soft-constrained methods is often defined as static state-to-cost mapping, and the safe-action projection in hard-constrained methods relies on the static projection with the fixed feasible region boundary estimated from offline demonstrations. The above drawback tightly couples the imposed constraints to the training scenarios, leaving the AD policy hard to handle different interaction scenarios, due to the improper state-level action-cost and the static projection boundary. Consequently, in this paper, we propose Brain-SAD, a brain-inspired safe autonomous driving control framework with dynamic fear-oriented constraints. By perceiving the current vehicle-interaction scene, Brain-SAD generates dynamic fear signal as fear reaction to online decide long-term policy for regular interaction or short-term policy for urgent-collision defense. In such two policy, the above fear-reaction will be constructed as the dynamic fear constraints, respectively reflecting the overall fear cost directly coupled with action-impact, and the dynamic fear boundary of the feasible region derived from different risky neighbors, both of which will in turn serve for the online policy optimization. Experimental results show that Brain-SAD outperforms existing methods, achieving higher success rate in shorter task-completion and collision-recovery time, and exhibits stronger reliability across continuous intersections of fluctuating complexity.

</details>


### [621] [PE-EK-PINN: Physics Embedding with Evolving Kernel for Scalable Physics-Informed Neural Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38023)
*Huiwen Zhang,Feng Ye,Chu Ma*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出PE-EK-PINN，将已收敛子系统场"冻结"为可复用的演化核，构建层级复用机制，使活跃核数量与系统规模无关，训练成本从O(N)降至O(log N)。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: PINN依赖损失残差约束高度振荡波动，在含奇异激励、吸收边界、数十波长波场的辐射问题上失效；架构物理嵌入虽能改善，但核字典需人工构造，且随天线阵列、超表面等层级结构深度指数增长。

Method: 将物理核视为可复用的学习表示而非固定解析输入；把已收敛子系统的场冻结并提升为"演化核"，对其做变换复制以表示更高层配置，无需重新推导控制方程，形成层级化核复用体系。

Result: 在偶极子阵列、复合线源几何与十字阵列上显著降低训练成本并保持降低或可比的相对L2误差；256偶极子阵列求解比直接PE-PINN快30倍以上。

Conclusion: 通过演化核的层级复用，峰值活跃核数与系统规模解耦、累计训练成本对数级下降，为大规模波动辐射问题提供可扩展的物理嵌入学习框架。

Abstract: Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINNs) embed governing equations into deep learning, but enforce them only through loss residuals, leaving highly oscillatory wave behavior to be discovered by optimization. As a result, methods that achieve relative $L_2$ errors below $10^{-3}$ on standard manufactured Helmholtz benchmarks can fail on practical radiation problems involving singular excitations, absorbing boundaries, and wave fields spanning tens of wavelengths. Architectural physics embedding addresses this limitation by factorizing the field into analytically derived oscillatory kernels and learnable envelopes. However, the kernel dictionary must be manually constructed and scales with the number of elementary units, growing exponentially with the depth of hierarchically structured systems such as antenna arrays and metasurfaces. We propose PE-EK-PINN (Physics Embedded with Evolving Kernels), which treats physics kernels as reusable learned representations rather than fixed analytical inputs. A converged subsystem field is frozen and promoted to an evolved kernel, whose transformed copies are reused to represent higher-level configurations without deriving new governing equations. The resulting hierarchy makes the peak number of active kernels independent of system size and reduces cumulative training cost from $O(N)$ to $O(\log N)$. Experiments on dipole arrays, composite line-source geometries, and cross arrays demonstrate the dramatic training cost reduction, while achieving a reduced or comparable relative $L_2$ error. One notable example is PE-EK-PINN solves a $256$-dipole array more than 30 times faster than direct PE-PINN.

</details>


### [622] [Retrieval-Augmented Skill Optimization via Cross-Harness Adaptation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38024)
*Jaewon Chu,Ji Soo Lee,Jihwan Park,Dohwan Ko,Jeehye Na,Seunghun Lee,Taehoon Lee,Minseo Yoon,Minseok Joo,Yunyang Xiong,Hyunwoo J. Kim*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出RASO框架，利用外部技能库作为先验知识，通过跨harness适配，将检索增强应用于技能初始化与迭代更新，在四个基准和两个模型上稳定优于基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有技能优化方法忽视海量公开技能库的积累知识，只依赖昂贵的agent rollout反复优化特定任务技能，效率低且知识浪费。

Method: RASO检索已有技能中的相关知识并经跨harness适配处理领域与harness不匹配，包含两阶段：RASI无需rollout即可构建知识基础初始技能；RASU依据执行反馈检索外部知识迭代精炼技能。

Result: 在四个agent基准和两个模型上，RASO持续优于无检索增强初始化与更新的基线。

Conclusion: 检索外部技能库作为先验，可显著提升技能优化效果与效率，是一种有前景的方向。

Abstract: An agent skill is a reusable, actionable natural-language artifact that guides an agent to perform a task effectively under a given harness. Recent studies have explored the optimization of agent skills, contributing to a growing collection of publicly available skills spanning diverse tasks, domains, and harnesses. Despite millions of publicly shared skills, existing skill optimization methods largely overlook this accumulated knowledge, instead relying solely on expensive agent rollouts to iteratively refine skills for a target task. To address this, we propose \textbf{Retrieval-Augmented Skill Optimization (RASO)}, a framework that leverages an external skill corpus as prior knowledge throughout skill optimization. RASO retrieves relevant knowledge from existing skills and adapts it to the target task and harness via Cross-Harness Adaptation, accounting for mismatches in both domain and harness. RASO comprises two complementary stages: \textbf{Retrieval-Augmented Skill Initialization (RASI)} constructs a knowledge-grounded initial skill without requiring agent rollouts, while \textbf{Retrieval-Augmented Skill Update (RASU)} iteratively refines the skill by retrieving external knowledge guided by execution feedback. Across four agent benchmarks and two models, extensive experiments show that RASO consistently outperforms baselines without retrieval-augmented skill initialization and updating.

</details>


### [623] [UserProxyBench: Evaluating LLM User Simulators for Agent Benchmarks and Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38043)
*Ashish Jain,Armaan Sandhu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文提出 UserProxyBench 评测层与 User Fidelity Score (UFS)，用于衡量 tau-bench 中"用户代理"是否忠实执行其私有用户指令，并揭示用户代理选择会显著影响任务奖励与交互过程。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 交互式智能体基准与多轮强化学习 increasingly 用第二个语言模型扮演用户，但现有基准只给智能体打分，不衡量用户是否正确执行其被赋予的角色。

Method: 在 tau-bench 家族上构建 UserProxyBench 评测层，提出 UFS，基于任务私有用户指令的 rubric 标准独立于智能体成功与否进行评分；固定智能体为 GPT-5.5，仅变化用户代理，在 375 个企业任务上评测 7 个代理。

Result: 仅更换用户代理可让平均任务奖励变化 15.2 分；24.4% 的成功回合存在用户规格违规行为。主要失败模式为"提前泄露"信息——用户在被请求前就提供信息。该行为对任务奖励影响很小，但在成功回合中使智能体平均少调用 1.06 次工具，改变了被评测的交互却保持奖励不变。此外识别出经验性的"成本-忠实度前沿"。

Conclusion: 用户代理是评测中不可忽视的变量，其行为会扭曲交互过程与评测结论；UFS 与成本-忠实度前沿可帮助实践者按所需忠实度选择最经济的用户模拟器。

Abstract: Interactive agent benchmarks and multi-turn reinforcement learning increasingly place a second language model in the role of the user. This simulated user controls what information the agent receives and when, yet current benchmarks score only the agent and do not directly measure whether the user correctly executed its assigned role. We introduce UserProxyBench, an evaluation layer over the tau-bench family, and the User Fidelity Score (UFS), which measures adherence to the benchmark's private user instructions using task-grounded rubric criteria scored independently of agent success. Holding the agent fixed at GPT-5.5 and varying only the user proxy across 375 enterprise tasks changes mean task reward by 15.2 points, while 24.4% of successful episodes contain a user-specification violation. The dominant failure is premature disclosure: users provide information before it is requested. This behavior has little effect on task reward, yet among successful episodes it causes the agent to make 1.06 fewer tool calls on average, changing the interaction being evaluated while preserving the reward. Finally, across seven proxies we identify an empirical cost-fidelity frontier, enabling practitioners to select the least expensive simulator that satisfies a required fidelity level.

</details>


### [624] [Probability is Not Enough: Exploring and Counting Divergent Tokens for Reasoning Uncertainty Quantification in LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38070)
*Feiyang Li,Shengjing Liu,Qi Zhan,Sijie Cheng,Weiqing Wang,Hongwen Chen,Yuxuan Yang,Wen Wang,Yile Wang,Hui Huang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出DTC框架，通过统计两个模型在同一推理轨迹上出现强分歧的token数量来估计置信度，实现更优的推理不确定性校准。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大模型推理能力提升，评估与校准其置信度对量化答案不确定性愈发重要；但现有基于关键token概率的方法机制不明，且发现用粗糙替代量也能改善校准，促使探索更有效的置信信号。

Method: DTC通过沿同一推理轨迹计算两模型下一个token分布的Jensen-Shannon散度，识别强分歧token并计数作为置信度信号；支持白盒与黑盒（借助辅助模型）评估，无需训练、不干扰生成过程。

Result: 在多个模型族和六个数学基准上，白盒下仅用计数的估计器平均ECE为13.0%，优于标准全序列置信度方法的32.7%-42.4%；黑盒下较原始言语化分数也有提升，如DeepSeek-V3.2上平均ECE从32.1%-40.2%降至13.7%-16.3%。

Conclusion: 分歧token计数与答案准确性近乎负相关，可作为简单有效的不确定性量化信号，为改进大模型推理不确定性量化提供了新思路。

Abstract: As the chain-of-thought reasoning capabilities of large language models improve, evaluating and calibrating their reasoning confidence is becoming increasingly important for quantifying the uncertainty of their answers. Current methods for estimating the confidence of large language models are generally based on probabilities of selected key tokens, but the underlying mechanism remains unclear. Our pilot study finds that replacing selected token probabilities with coarse substitutes can also improve calibration, motivating us to further explore effective signals of model confidence. We introduce Divergent Token Confidence (DTC), a framework that estimates confidence by counting tokens at which two models strongly disagree during decoding. DTC identifies these divergent tokens using the Jensen-Shannon divergence between next-token distributions evaluated along the same reasoning trajectory. We find that their count is almost negatively associated with answer accuracy, thereby serving as a simple yet effective signal for uncertainty quantification. DTC supports both white-box and black-box evaluation using auxiliary models, without explicit training and affecting the generation process. Experiments across multiple model families and six mathematical benchmarks demonstrate improved calibration over probability-based and verbalized baselines. Under white-box evaluation, the count-only estimator achieves an average expected calibration error of 13.0%, compared with 32.7%-42.4% for standard full-sequence confidence methods. In black-box settings, it also improves calibration over the original verbalized scores. For example, mean expected calibration error falls from 32.1%-40.2% to 13.7%-16.3% on DeepSeek-V3.2. These findings provide new insights for improving reasoning uncertainty quantification in large language models. The code is released at https://github.com/szu-tera/DTC.git.

</details>


### [625] [Character Training for Risk-Averse Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38093)
*Arav Dhoot,Punya Syon Pandey,Jamie Johnson,Daniel Tan,Elliott Thornley,David Demitri Africa*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 通过"角色训练"（character training）向AI智能体注入风险规避偏好，能有效防止失准智能体造成灾难性危害。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 失准但风险规避的AI更倾向于与人达成交易等安全策略，而非反叛等冒险策略，因此风险规避可作为一种缓解机制。

Method: 构建描述恒定绝对风险规避（CARA）的"模型宪章"，并通过在策略蒸馏（on-policy distillation）将其注入模型，实现角色训练。

Result: 尽管训练时从未见过基准决策格式，角色训练模型仍与直接在该基准上训练的基线相当，并在四个模型中的两个上分布外泛化更好；token预算与模型选择是影响最大的因素。

Conclusion: 角色训练是注入广泛性情倾向的可扩展且前景良好的方法，可用于缓解失准AI带来的风险。

Abstract: Risk aversion in resources could prevent misaligned AI agents from causing catastrophic harm. Misaligned but risk-averse agents would tend to favor safer strategies like making deals with humans over riskier strategies like rebelling. We train agents to be risk averse through character training, finding that persona traits provide a robust mechanism for instilling risk preferences. To do this, we construct a model constitution describing constant absolute risk aversion (CARA) over an agent's resources and instill it through on-policy distillation. Despite never seeing the benchmark's decision format during training, character-trained models are competitive with baselines trained directly on it, and generalise better than them out of distribution on two of our four models. We also modulate different aspects of the constitution, finding that token budget and model choice are the most influential aspect of character training to instill risk aversion. We conclude from these results that character training is a promising and scalable way to instil broad dispositions, which we can use to our advantage in mitigating risk from misaligned AI agents.

</details>


### [626] [NeuronEye: Query-Guided Visual Concept Activation for Vision-Language Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38098)
*Ruiyu Yan,Bowen Chen,Shaowen Wan,Lin Zhao*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出NeuronEye插件式框架，通过构建稀疏概念级神经元词表并选择性激活查询相关的视觉概念，提升VLM的视觉推理能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前VLM将视觉信息编码于稠密隐状态中，物体身份、空间布局与局部属性相互纠缠，难以隔离和调节语言查询所需的特定视觉证据。

Method: 受生物视觉稀疏群体编码与自上而下调节启发，从中间VLM表征构造稀疏概念级神经元词表：将视觉token状态分解为概念簇组织的过完备稀疏基，用语言查询激活相关簇并定位概念表达的patch，将聚焦证据注入视觉token；辅以抑制机制衰减主导感知方向以保留弱相关线索；全部操作在冻结backbone单次前向中完成。

Result: 在Qwen2.5-VL-7B上CV-Bench总体+3.1（Distance +9.5），BLINK Multi-view +8.3；LLaVA-1.6-7B上呈类似趋势。

Conclusion: 稀疏神经元词表不仅可作事后可解释性工具，还能作为概念级视觉推理的主动接口。

Abstract: Current vision-language models (VLMs) encode visual information in dense hidden states where object identity, spatial layout, and local attributes are implicitly entangled rather than explicitly disentangled, limiting their ability to isolate and modulate the specific visual evidence required by a given language query. Inspired by sparse population coding and top-down modulation in biological vision, we introduce NeuronEye, a plug-in framework that constructs a sparse, concept-level neuron vocabulary from intermediate VLM representations and selectively activates query-relevant visual concepts during inference. NeuronEye decomposes vision-token states into an overcomplete sparse basis organized by concept-level clusters, uses the language query to activate relevant clusters and localize the patches where selected concepts are expressed, and injects the focused evidence back into vision tokens. A complementary suppression mechanism attenuates dominant perceptual directions to preserve weaker but relevant cues. All operations run in a single forward pass over a frozen VLM backbone. On Qwen2.5-VL-7B, NeuronEye raises CV-Bench overall accuracy by +3.1 with gains of +9.5 on Distance, and improves BLINK Multi-view by +8.3, with similar trends on LLaVA-1.6-7B. These results suggest that sparse neuron vocabularies can serve not only as post-hoc interpretability tools but also as active interfaces for concept-level visual reasoning.

</details>


### [627] [Do LLM Agents Execute the Plans They Declare? From Planning-Mode Declaration to Pattern-Specific Execution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38108)
*Subba Reddy Oota,Francisco Herrera,Jordi Cabot Sagrera,Marcos López de Prado,Shadab Khan*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文研究"计划声明-执行差距"，提出Planning-as-Routing：LLM在四种规划模式中声明其一，由确定性路由器分派给对应执行器，隔离并分析选择与执行两类失败。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM智能体做长程任务需先规划再执行，但成功规划需两种能力：选对计划、忠实执行。现有planner-executor系统在任一阶段都可能失败，而仅看最终成功率无法区分是选择失败还是执行失败。

Method: 提出Planning-as-Routing：LLM声明Predefined、Sequential、Hierarchical、Search四种规划模式之一，确定性路由器将任务分派到对应的模式专用执行器；在4个基准、3个LLM上对比Plan+ReAct。

Result: 三点一致发现：(1) 通用Plan+ReAct常无法保持声明的规划结构，三个基准上仅22%–45%轨迹保持，模式专用执行器则能强制执行预期结构；(2) 规划模式有效性随环境与模型变化，ALFWorld上Search最好、SWE-bench上Hierarchical最好，同一基准内最强模式也因模型而异；(3) 最大增益来自执行：模式专用执行器使ALFWorld成功率从0.48升至0.92，SWE-bench Verified从0.36升至0.44。但当前LLM不能可靠地为每个任务选择最强模式，few-shot示例在部分基准-模型组合中可改善选择。

Conclusion: 可靠的智能体规划需同时具备有效模式选择与忠实执行；routing大幅缩小了执行差距，而任务特定的模式选择仍是未解问题。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) enable agents to solve long-horizon tasks by generating a plan and then executing it in an environment. However, successful planning requires two distinct capabilities: selecting an appropriate plan for the task and executing it faithfully. Existing planner--executor systems can fail at either stage, while final task success alone cannot distinguish selection from execution failures. We therefore study the Plan Declaration--Execution Gap and introduce Planning-as-Routing, where an LLM declares one of four planning modes: Predefined, Sequential, Hierarchical, or Search, and a deterministic router dispatches the task to the corresponding pattern-specific executor. Across four benchmarks and three LLMs, we find three consistent patterns. First, generic Plan+ReAct often fails to preserve declared planning structure, especially for longer plans: across three benchmarks, only (22)--(45%) of trajectories preserve it, whereas pattern-specific executors enforce the intended structure. Second, planning-mode effectiveness varies across environments and models: Search performs best on ALFWorld, Hierarchical on SWE-bench, and the strongest pattern can vary across models within the same benchmark. Third, the largest gains come from execution: pattern-specific executors improve task success from (0.48) to (0.92) on ALFWorld and from (0.36) to (0.44) on SWE-bench Verified over Plan+ReAct. Current LLMs, however, do not reliably select the strongest mode for each task, although few-shot examples improve selection in some benchmark--model combinations. Overall, reliable agent planning requires both effective mode selection and faithful execution: routing substantially closes the execution gap, while task-specific mode selection remains open.

</details>


### [628] [Stochastic World Models for Verifying Vision-Based Neural Feedback Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38120)
*I. Samuel Akinwande,Mykel J. Kochenderfer,Clark Barrett*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出用随机世界模型作为感知代理来验证基于视觉的神经反馈系统，并设计了结合反例搜索、自适应细化、符号与后向分析的验证流程，在紧急制动基准上显著优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 验证视觉神经反馈系统需要对控制器所依赖的观测建模。GAN虽常作感知代理，但参数量大、复杂场景还原差、难以验证，因此需要更丰富的感知代理类别。

Method: 训练带物理 grounded 隐变量的世界模型，由标准验证器可界定的操作构建；并开发结合 falsification、自适应细化、符号分析与后向分析的验证流程。

Result: 世界模型比参数量多至 130 倍的 GAN 代理更忠实地重建留出帧。在 GAN 代理的紧急制动基准上解决全部状态空间（SOTA 遗留 38% 未解决）；在 RGB 版本上首次报告结果，用世界模型解决超 80% 状态空间。

Conclusion: 随机世界模型是比 GAN 更可行的感知代理，配合所提验证流程可大幅提升视觉神经反馈系统的可验证性。

Abstract: Verifying a vision-based neural feedback system requires a model of the observations its controller acts upon. Such a model must capture the variation the sensor produces, while remaining tractable for closed-loop analysis. Generative adversarial networks (GANs) have served as perception surrogates, but they are large, reproduce complex scenes poorly, and are hard to verify. We explore stochastic world models as a richer class of perception surrogates. We train a world model with physically grounded latents, built from operations that standard verifiers bound. It reproduces held-out frames more faithfully than GAN surrogates with up to 130 times as many parameters. To verify these surrogates, we develop a procedure that combines falsification, adaptive refinement, symbolic, and backward analyses. On an emergency braking benchmark with a GAN surrogate, our procedure resolves the entire state space, 38% of which the state-of-the-art verifier left unresolved. On the RGB version of the benchmark, where no verification results have previously been reported, our procedure resolves over 80% of the state space with a world model surrogate.

</details>


### [629] [Thinking Before Thinking: Scaling Agentic Inference Through Meta-Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38147)
*Paras Dahal,Anton Bakhtin,Taco Cohen,Zhengxing Chen,Carole-Jean Wu,Rob Fergus,Scott Yih,Gabriel Synnaeve,Ruslan Salakhutdinov,Sanjeev Arora,Jason Weston,Anirudh Goyal*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出"agentic meta-reasoning"推理时框架，将长时程智能体执行中的控制决策（复用、重启、停止等）显式化，由控制器与worker分工协作，取得显著性能提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着智能体处理更长、更复杂的任务，执行控制本身成为一项独立任务。每一步都带来新的控制选择（如基于哪部分工作继续、是否重启、何时停止），需要显式且结构化的推理过程来管理。

Method: 构建推理时harness：worker执行任务级计算，controller整合已建立成果、探索后续选项、在剩余预算下评估各选项价值，并借助持久记忆派发带上下文的工作；决策间仅保留紧凑的run摘要而非重放完整历史。基线包括生产级编码智能体、研究harness及使用相同worker和预算的Direct Control Agent。

Result: ProgramBench上GPT-5.5达71.5%（Codex 58.0%），Opus 4.8达67.2%（Claude Code 65.5%）；其他基准（抽象推理、多域长时程推理、证明生成）较direct control平均提升3.6–4.2分；在direct control趋于平台期的预算范围内持续改进，但小预算下开销可能有害。

Conclusion: artifact-graph分析显示更多复用先前工作、多数设置下更高正确解覆盖率及非均匀的最终选择增益。结果表明，随着智能体扩展到更长运行，将计算投入结构化控制变得越来越重要。

Abstract: As agents take on longer and more complex problems, controlling the execution becomes a task in its own right. Each step in the run brings new control choices, like which partial work to build on, whether to start fresh, or when to stop. We introduce agentic meta-reasoning, an inference-time harness that makes these choices an explicit and structured reasoning process. Workers carry out the task-level computation, while a controller consolidates what the run has established, explores next options, assesses what each option is worth under the remaining budget, and dispatches the chosen work with context drawn from persistent memory. Between decisions the controller carries only a compact account of the run rather than replaying its full history. Our baselines span production coding agents and research harnesses, together with a Direct Control Agent using the same workers and compute budget allowance. On ProgramBench, which tests long-horizon agentic capability through program reconstruction, meta-reasoning achieves 71.5% with GPT-5.5 against 58.0% for Codex; with Opus 4.8 it achieves 67.2% against 65.5% for Claude Code. On the other benchmarks, spanning abstract reasoning, multi-domain long-horizon reasoning, and proof generation, it gains between 3.6 and 4.2 points over direct control, averaged across three frontier models. It keeps improving over the tested budget ranges where direct control plateaus, though its overhead can hurt at small budgets. Artifact-graph analysis reveals more reuse of earlier work, higher coverage of correct solutions in most settings, and nonuniform gains in final selection. These results indicate that spending computation on structured control becomes more important as agents scale to longer runs.

</details>


### [630] [PrototypeNAS: Rapid Design of Deep Neural Networks for Microcontroller Units](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.15106)
*Mark Deutel,Simon Geis,Axel Plinge*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出PrototypeNAS，一种零样本NAS方法，用于加速并自动化DNN在微控制器上的选择、压缩与特化，可在数分钟内找到适合MCU部署的小型模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在资源受限的边缘设备上部署高效DNN通常需为每个设备单独定制架构；现有NAS方法需从头训练大量网络，计算密集且耗时，且未考虑目标系统的资源约束。

Method: PrototypeNAS为三步式零样本搜索：(1) 提出结合多种架构类型结构优化及其剪枝与量化配置优化的搜索空间；(2) 优化过程中使用零样本代理的集成而非单一代理；(3) 采用Hypervolume子集选择从多目标优化帕累托前沿中提取最具意义精度-FLOPs权衡的架构。该方法将DNN设计与特化从训练中解耦。

Result: 在图像分类、时间序列分类、目标检测三个任务的12个数据集上评估，PrototypeNAS可在数分钟内识别出足够小、可部署于现成MCU、且精度可与大型DNN模型相当的模型。

Conclusion: PrototypeNAS通过零样本、多目标、多架构联合搜索，有效加速并自动化了面向不同MCU的DNN选择与压缩，实现快速部署且保持竞争性精度。

Abstract: Enabling efficient deep neural network (DNN) inference on edge devices with different hardware constraints is a challenging task that typically requires DNN architectures to be specialized for each device separately. To avoid the huge manual effort, one can use neural architecture search (NAS). However, many existing NAS methods are resource-intensive and time-consuming because they require the training of many different DNNs from scratch. Furthermore, they do not take the resource constraints of the target system into account. To address these shortcomings, we propose PrototypeNAS, a zero-shot NAS method to accelerate and automate the selection, compression, and specialization of DNNs to different target microcontroller units (MCUs). We propose a novel three-step search method that decouples DNN design and specialization from DNN training for a given target platform. First, we present a novel search space that not only cuts out smaller DNNs from a single large architecture, but instead combines the structural optimization of multiple architecture types, as well as optimization of their pruning and quantization configurations. Second, we explore the use of an ensemble of zero-shot proxies during optimization instead of a single one. Third, we propose the use of Hypervolume subset selection to distill DNN architectures from the Pareto front of the multi-objective optimization that represent the most meaningful tradeoffs between accuracy and FLOPs. We evaluate the effectiveness of PrototypeNAS on 12 different datasets in three different tasks: image classification, time series classification, and object detection. Our results demonstrate that PrototypeNAS is able to identify DNN models within minutes that are small enough to be deployed on off-the-shelf MCUs and still achieve accuracies comparable to the performance of large DNN models.

</details>


<div id='cs.NI'></div>

# cs.NI [[Back]](#toc)

### [631] [Traffic Congestion Awareness and On-Demand Distribution in Vehicular Delay-Tolerant Networks in California I-210 Freeway](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36156)
*Xiaofei Liu,Milena Radenkovic*

Main category: cs.NI

TL;DR: 本文提出一种面向拥堵事件感知的按需消息分发机制，在V-DTN中通过预测拥堵复现与持续时间来抑制短时自消拥堵事件的广播，基于加州I-210高速公路真实PeMS数据实验验证，该机制显著降低网络资源消耗与网络层拥堵，提升投递可靠性并降低时延。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 车载边缘计算环境下，V-DTN可通过存储-携带-转发机制传播拥堵警告帮助车辆择路。但现有多数车载信息分发方法依赖洪泛或有限洪泛策略，一旦检测到拥堵就全网广播，导致大量冗余副本、消耗节点缓存空间。因此需要一种更高效的按需分发机制。

Method: 提出拥堵事件感知的按需消息分发机制，考虑拥堵的复现性和持续时间，抑制对短时、自消散拥堵事件的广播。基于加州I-210走廊的真实PeMS数据构建I-210高速公路拥堵用例，结合机器学习进行拥堵感知与动静阈值按需分发设计。

Result: 实验表明，预测拥堵复现高度依赖车道历史自由流速度数据；在不引入额外特征维度时，对不同日期类型车道自由流速度建模比较的准确性比机器学习模型的选择更重要，且此类模式难以在模拟器中复现。拥堵持续时间预测可有效作为V-DTN动态阈值按需分发的依据。基于机器学习的拥堵感知结合动态阈值按需分发显著降低网络资源消耗和网络层拥堵，提升投递可靠性，降低投递时延。

Conclusion: 基于机器学习的拥堵感知与动态阈值按需分发相结合，能在V-DTN中有效减少冗余广播、缓解网络层拥堵并改善投递性能，为车载网络拥堵信息分发提供有效方案。

Abstract: In vehicular networks under edge computing environments, vehicle-to-vehicle delay-tolerant networking (V-DTN) can disseminate congestion warnings to other vehicles via a store-carry-forward mechanism, helping them proactively choose suitable routes. However, most existing in-vehicle information dissemination methods rely on flooding or limited flooding strategies, broadcasting alerts across the entire network whenever congestion is detected. This leads to excessive redundant copies and consumes node cache space. To address this issue, this paper proposes a congestion-event- aware on-demand message dissemination mechanism. By considering the recurrence and duration of congestion, the mechanism suppresses broadcasts of short-lived, self-dissipating congestion events. Based on real-world PeMS data from California's I-210 corridor, we construct an I-210 Freeway Traffic Congestion Use Case. Experiments show that predicting congestion recurrence heavily relies on historical free-flow speed data of lanes. Without incorporating additional feature dimensions, the accuracy of modeling and comparing lane free-flow speeds across different day types outweighs the choice of machine learning models, and such patterns are difficult to reproduce in simulators. Meanwhile, congestion duration prediction serves effectively as the basis for dynamic-threshold on-demand dissemination in V-DTN, which demonstrate that machine learning-based congestion awareness combined with dynamic-threshold on-demand dissemination significantly reduces network resource consumption and network-layer congestion, enhances delivery reliability, and lowers delivery latency.

</details>


### [632] [Non-Ionizing Radiation Analysis in Close Proximity to Antenna Tower: A Case Study in Northeast Brazil](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36179)
*André B. F. Diniz,Vicente A. Souza,Marcio E. C. Rodrigues,Halysson B. Mendonça,Gutembregue S. Silva,Fred S. R. Pinheiro*

Main category: cs.NI

TL;DR: 本文监测日常环境中的非电离辐射（NIR）水平，调研国内外相关法规，并对NIR测量领域进行文献计量分析；同时在巴西纳塔尔四个地点各进行24小时实测（靠近基站，含4G/pre-5G频段），结果与现行法规对比并做统计分析。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 全球电信业务快速增长，公众可能更多地暴露于来自多种来源的非电离辐射（NIR），因此有必要了解实际暴露水平、法规现状及研究趋势。

Method: 文献计量学研究（NIR测量相关主要科学产出与趋势，聚焦电信领域）；巴西纳塔尔案例研究，在四个不同地点各连续监测24小时，测量点靠近天线/基站以代表最坏暴露情形；与现行国家和国际法规对比；对测量数据进行统计分析。

Result: 给出了不同时段人群可能暴露的辐射量的定量分析；因巴西运行4G及pre-5G系统，本次测量包含更密集的微波频段使用，区别于以往研究。

Conclusion: 该研究可用于评估特定人群受NIR影响的程度，并为NIR监测、法规对照及后续研究提供量化依据。

Abstract: While the amount of telecommunications services grows rapidly in the whole world, humans get potentially more exposed to Non-Ionizing Radiation (NIR) from a number of different sources. This paper has a number of goals, including monitoring radiation levels in an everyday situation, an investigation of how national and international regulations organs address NIR levels and a demonstration of scientific production trends regarding this topic. The work also presents a bibliometric study about the main scientific productions and trends related to NIR measurements, with focus on the field of Telecommunications. Another contribution is a case study in Natal, Brazil, where NIR levels were monitored in four distinct locations over a period of 24 hours each and compared to the current regulations. The result is a quantitative analysis of the amount of radiation that some populations might be exposed to in distinct moments of the day. Measurements were carried out in the proximity of an antenna spot, since it could represent a source of high NIR levels (a worst case of human exposure). This campaign differs from older studies by including a more intense usage of microwaves frequencies due to operating 4G and pre-5G systems in Brazil. Finally, a statistical study involving the measurements is conducted, concluding the analysis of how some population groups might be affected by NIR.

</details>


### [633] [People effects on IoT indoor wireless channel characterization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36196)
*Millena Michely de Medeiros Campos,Mateus de Oliveira e Mattos,Rafael da Silva Macedo,Alvaro Augusto Machado de Medeiros,Wellerson Viana de Oliveira,Vicente Angelo de Sousa Junior*

Main category: cs.NI

TL;DR: 本文评估人群存在对900 MHz室内窄带无线信道小尺度特性的影响。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 1 GHz以下无线通信适合IoT，但环境中的人和物体可能引起信道变化，需评估人群对信道的影响。

Method: 在900 MHz室内窄带信道上测量，用概率分布表征信号随机部分，采用二阶统计量分析数据，并应用拟合优度检验。

Result: 随着人数增加，通信信道变化更大，反映在概率分布参数的变化上。

Conclusion: 人群存在会显著影响900 MHz室内窄带信道的小尺度特性，分布参数随之改变，需在信道建模中考虑。

Abstract: Wireless communication under 1 GHz is suitable for Internet of Things (IoT) applications due to larger coverage capability with less power consumption. Bearing in mind that people and elements contained in the environment can cause variations in the channel, this paper aims to evaluate the effect of the presence of people on a 900-MHz indoor narrowband wireless channel, as we characterize the small-scale phenomena. With the increase in the number of people, a greater variation in the communication channel was noticed, which is reflected in the parameters of the probability distributions used in the characterization of the random part of the signal. In addition, second-order statistics were used to analyze the data and an adherence test was applied to confirm the behavior of the signal in relation to the distributions.

</details>


### [634] [SCORAS-MoE: Joint Compression and Resource-Adaptive Deployment of MoE-VLMs in LEO Satellite Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36763)
*Tong Quan,Yuanlong Wan,Huasen He,Yunpeng Hou,Shuangwu Chen,Xiaofeng Jiang,Jian Yang*

Main category: cs.NI

TL;DR: 提出SCORAS-MoE，联合压缩与部署框架，使MoE VLM可在LEO卫星网络协同推理，兼顾压缩、放置与动态调度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 星上部署VLM可减少下行数据，但受限于内存与能量（需压缩与分布式部署），且资源动态变化（光照、电量、通信）需快速部署决策。

Method: 对MoE输出扰动测量，按敏感度给专家分配不同低秩秩；将压缩分片分布到卫星协同推理，得到精度-能耗profile；在线调度器选组合与放置，用匈牙利算法解最小代价分配，枚举组合取最优。

Result: 在Qwen3-VL-30B-A3B-Instruct上，保留30%参数时，基于扰动的秩分配比均匀分配平均精度提升3.7%；固定profile调度吞吐更高、切换更少、电量影响更低，比PPO和进化基线分别快8.7×和183.5×。

Conclusion: 扰动驱动秩分配与联合压缩-部署调度可有效应对星上资源约束，自适应profile选择进一步平衡服务质量与能耗。

Abstract: Deploying large vision-language models (VLMs) onboard satellites enables onboard data processing and reduces raw data downlink. However, onboard inference faces two resource challenges. Limited onboard memory and energy require model compression and distributed deployment. Dynamic resource availability requires fast deployment decisions as illumination, battery levels, and communication conditions change. We present SCORAS-MoE, a joint compression and deployment framework for mixture-of-experts (MoE) VLMs in low Earth orbit (LEO) satellite networks. To address limited resources, SCORAS-MoE measures the perturbation of the routed MoE output caused by low-rank approximation, assigns higher ranks to more sensitive experts, and distributes compressed model shards across satellites for cooperative inference. The compressed models yield profiles of measured accuracy and inference energy. To adapt to dynamic resources, the online scheduler selects profile compositions and shard placements in each slot. For each candidate composition, it reduces placement to a minimum-cost assignment problem solved by the Hungarian algorithm, while enumerating the compositions yields the optimal deployment for the current-slot objective. Experiments on Qwen3-VL-30B-A3B-Instruct show that allocating ranks based on output perturbation is particularly effective under aggressive compression, with an absolute gain of $3.7\%$ in mean accuracy over uniform rank allocation when expert projections retain $30\%$ of their original parameters. The fixed-profile scheduler achieves higher throughput with fewer service switches and lower battery impact than the evaluated proximal policy optimization (PPO) and evolutionary baselines, with respective speedups of $8.7\times$ and $183.5\times$. Adaptive profile selection further improves the balance between service quality and energy use.

</details>


### [635] [DSWM: Decomposed Spatio-Temporal World Model for Demand-Driven UAV Base Station Repositioning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36845)
*Shengjie Zhong,Zhongliang Zhao,Jingxuan Chen,Xianbin Cao,Xinmei Qiang,Dapeng O. Wu,Tony Q. S. Quek*

Main category: cs.NI

TL;DR: 提出DSWM：将无人机基站车队重定位建模为隐空间决策时规划，用分解时空世界模型预测需求并规划动作，在三个真实数据集上取得最优服务率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: UAV-BS需覆盖时空变化的需求，但现有重定位方法要么逐时隙重解优化问题，要么学习反应式策略而缺乏显式需求模型。

Method: 将需求驱动的车队重定位转化为隐空间决策时规划；构建DSWM分解时空世界模型：通过滚动观测窗口感知需求场，用隐循环状态保留上下文，基于不确定性惩罚的想象推演评估候选动作，并以重规划的首动作协调车队。模型采用EMA隐预测目标与方差正则训练循环状态空间模型，并附可微服务模拟器在隐推演中重放关联、概率视距信道与香农速率链；规划使用交叉熵方法，想象需求以ρ=0.95锚定当前观测窗口。

Result: 在三个真实数据集（Milan CDR、Shanghai Telecom、YJMob100K）和14种方法（含5个复现IEEE基线）的统一流程上，DSWM工作日服务率分别为0.889、0.908、0.898，各数据集上均列非消融配置第一；Milan上比最强非学习基线Greedy（0.780）提升0.109，该增益来自决策时利用观测而非预测精度。

Conclusion: DSWM表明决策时规划与世界模型结合可有效提升UAV车队需求覆盖，且关键优势在于利用观测进行决策而非单纯提高预测准确性。

Abstract: Uncrewed aerial vehicle base stations (UAV-BSs) are expected to cover traffic demand that shifts across space and time, yet most repositioning schemes either re-solve an optimization problem per slot or learn reactive policies without an explicit demand model. We cast demand-driven fleet repositioning as latent-space decision-time planning and propose DSWM, a decomposed spatio-temporal world model: an agentic controller that perceives the demand field through a rolling observation window, retains operational context in a latent recurrent state, reasons about candidate motions by imagined rollouts under an uncertainty penalty, and coordinates the fleet through replanned first actions. DSWM learns a recurrent state-space model shaped by an exponential-moving-average (EMA) based latent predictive objective with variance regularization. It attaches a differentiable service simulator that replays the association, probabilistic line-of-sight channel, and Shannon rate chain inside latent rollouts. Planning uses a cross-entropy method whose imagined demand is anchored on the current observation window with mixing coefficient $ρ=0.95$. On a unified pipeline over three real datasets (Milan CDR (call detail record), Shanghai Telecom, YJMob100K) and 14 methods including five reproduced IEEE baselines, DSWM attains weekday served ratios of 0.889, 0.908, and 0.898, ranking first among non-ablated configurations on every dataset. On Milan it improves over the strongest non-learning baseline (Greedy, 0.780) by 0.109, a margin that comes from decision-time use of observations rather than prediction accuracy.

</details>


### [636] [Exponential Backoff: Meta-Stability and Implicit Admission Control](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37073)
*Richard Combes,Fabien Mathieu,Thomas Bonald*

Main category: cs.NI

TL;DR: 该论文分析指数退避（用于分布式信道共享，类似802.11），证明其具有亚稳态行为：系统在长时间尺度上于亚稳态配置间振荡，仅部分信源有效接入信道，形成一种隐式准入控制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 指数退避广泛用于802.11等网络标准，其分布式信道共享的实际动态特性尚需深入理解，尤其是长期运行中的稳定性表现。

Method: 结合作者提供的理论工具与数值实验进行分析，实验完全可复现，并公开了Python包 slotted-aloha-simulator。

Result: 发现系统在长时间尺度上于多个亚稳态配置之间振荡，每个配置下只有部分信源有效占用信道；亚稳态带来了隐式准入控制的效果。

Conclusion: 指数退避的亚稳态特性揭示了信道共享的隐式准入控制机制，理论与实验共同支持该结论，且代码开放便于复现与后续研究。

Abstract: We analyze exponential backoff, an algorithm used to share a single communication channel in a distributed manner between several users, in a similar way as many networking standards such as 802.11. We demonstrate that this algorithm has a meta-stable behavior, in the sense that the system oscillates over long time-scales between meta-stable configurations where only a subset of the sources effectively access the channel. In other words, meta-stability creates a form of implicit admission control. We provide both theoretical tools and numerical experiments to understand this phenomenon further. Our experiments are fully reproducible and the code is publicly available as a Python package available at https://pypi.org/project/slotted-aloha-simulator/.

</details>


### [637] [RingStitch: Demand-Aware Optical Stitching for Fragmented TPU Clusters](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37627)
*Huiru Ao,Fan Yang,Binglei Wang,Bo Liu,Jialong Li*

Main category: cs.NI

TL;DR: RingStitch：基于OCS的碎片整理调度器，将机架内零散空闲容量通过低开销逻辑环拼接为可调度资源。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多租户TPU集群中，中小任务常导致机架内残留局部空闲容量；虽总空闲容量足够，但本地放置或整机架拼接无法利用，造成资源碎片化。

Method: 采用局部优先策略，仅在必要时跨机架拼接紧凑碎片，并将选中的机架排序为低成本逻辑环，借助OCS重构机架级互连。

Result: 在类TPU 8t SuperPod模型上的仿真表明，RingStitch相比本地放置和整机架基线提升了可调度性。

Conclusion: RingStitch有效将碎片化机架容量转化为可调度资源，提升多租户集群调度效率。

Abstract: Large-scale AI training clusters increasingly use optical circuit switching (OCS) to reconfigure rack-level interconnects and create elastic accelerator slices. In multi-tenant TPU-style clusters, however, small and medium jobs often leave partial free capacity stranded inside racks. Although the aggregate free capacity may be sufficient for a new job, it cannot be used by local placement or coarse full-rack stitching. This paper presents RingStitch, an OCS-based defragmentation scheduler that turns fragmented rack capacity into schedulable resources. RingStitch follows a local-first policy, stitches compact cross-rack fragments only when needed, and orders the selected racks into a low-cost logical ring. Simulations on a TPU 8t-like SuperPod model show that RingStitch improves schedulability over local and full-rack baselines.

</details>


### [638] [NetLexicon: Learning Discrete Behavioral Representations for Encrypted Web Traffic Analysis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37672)
*Xiangyu Gao,Tong Li,Ziqiang Wang,Yinchao Zhang,Rongbang Wu,Zhenxing Zhang,Jing Hu,Hanlin Huang,Xinle Du,Su Yao,Qi Li,Ke Xu*

Main category: cs.NI

TL;DR: NetLexicon：将无标注流量通过向量量化转为离散"流量词典"，用状态转移预测(STP)与统计特征对齐(SFA)双目标预训练，在四类加密流量基准上Macro-F1最高提升25.5个百分点，单轮微调时间最多缩短23.6倍，并具可解释性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有加密流量预训练方法多沿用NLP/CV的目标函数与序列架构，未针对流量特有的交互行为模式设计学习目标，导致表示效果与效率受限。

Method: 提出NetLexicon离散预训练框架：将上下文流量窗口经向量量化映射为离散状态，构建紧凑"流量词典"；设计两个互补目标——状态转移预测(STP)依据历史预测后续序列结构与包特征，统计特征对齐(SFA)将学习到的状态锚定到窗口级流量统计。

Result: 在Web应用识别、服务类型识别与恶意软件检测四类基准上评估：Macro-F1较最强基线最高提升25.5个百分点，单轮微调时间最多缩短23.6倍；分析表明离散状态可捕捉包大小、时序与数据传输中的可识别模式。

Conclusion: 将可观测行为结构引入预训练，可为加密流量分析提供有效、高效且可解释的表示。

Abstract: Encrypted Web traffic analysis requires effective representations of observable communication behavior. Existing pretraining methods often adapt NLP/CV objectives and sequence architectures, motivating learning objectives that capture traffic-specific interaction patterns. We present NetLexicon, a discrete pretraining framework that learns reusable behavioral states from unlabeled traffic. It converts contextual traffic windows into discrete states through vector quantization, constructing a compact traffic lexicon. We design two complementary pretraining objectives. State Transition Prediction (STP) forecasts subsequent sequence structure and packet features from observed history, while Statistical Feature Alignment (SFA) grounds learned states in window-level traffic statistics. Together, they guide the lexicon to capture recurring communication behaviors and their evolution.
  We evaluate NetLexicon on four benchmarks covering Web application identification, service type identification, and malware detection. NetLexicon improves Macro-F1 by up to 25.5 percentage points over the strongest baseline on each benchmark and reduces fine-tuning time per epoch by up to 23.6 times relative to the evaluated baselines. Further analysis shows that the learned discrete states capture recognizable patterns in packet size, timing, and data transfer. These results demonstrate that incorporating observable behavioral structure into pretraining supports effective, efficient, and interpretable representations for encrypted traffic analysis.

</details>


### [639] [Sequence Models for Layer-3 Protocol Emulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37697)
*Alix Jeannerot,Petko Petkov,Alvaro Valcarce Rial*

Main category: cs.NI

TL;DR: 本文研究Layer-3无线协议行为能否用适合在RAN内布部署的紧凑序列模型表示，提出RRC序列引擎(RSE)混合架构。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探索Layer-3协议行为能否用适合RAN内部署的紧凑序列模型表示。

Method: 提出RRC序列引擎(RSE)混合架构：序列模型预测协议相关消息结构，确定性组件负责安全敏感/配置字段及传输容器；采用协议感知分词、跨栈上下文与显式占位符，基于NR协议轨迹，构建11M参数Mamba引擎。

Result: 在gNB侧测试集达0.90精确匹配，中位生成延迟115 ms，优于微调的0.6B参数模型；协议感知分词、跨栈上下文、显式占位符比模型规模更重要。

Conclusion: RSE可应用于测试、仿真、部署专用化及未来可训练6G控制面，但在投入运营前仍需解决验证、延迟、鲁棒性与安全性挑战。

Abstract: This article investigates whether Layer-3 radio-protocol behavior can be represented by compact sequence models suitable for deployment inside the RAN. We introduce the RRC sequence engine (RSE), a hybrid architecture in which a sequence model predicts protocol-dependent message structure while deterministic components retain control over security-sensitive or configured fields and over transport containers. Using NR protocol traces, we show that protocol-aware tokenization, cross-stack context, and explicit placeholders matter more than general-sequence model scale. A purpose-built 11M-parameter Mamba engine achieves 0.90 exact match on the evaluated next-generation Node B (gNB)-side test set with a median generation latency of 115 ms, sufficient for some timers of Layer-3, outperforming a fine-tuned 0.6B-parameter model. We discuss applications in testing, simulation, deployment specialization, and future trainable 6G control planes, as well as the validation, latency, robustness, and security challenges that remain before operational use.

</details>


### [640] [Pricing IoT Data Delivered via LEO Satellites](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37995)
*Rahul Ramachandran,Suman Banerjee*

Main category: cs.NI

TL;DR: 该论文研究LEO卫星星座为IoT终端提供数据回传服务时的定价机制，揭示“定价悬崖”现象及极地-赤道终端的地理定价不对称，并基于Kinéis星座仿真与价值衰减模型提出整合定价模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LEO星座的存储转发结构使数据传输受限于离散上行窗口与地面站接触时机，导致定价对交付完整性阈值不连续（定价悬崖），并产生极地与赤道终端之间的地理定价不对称，而这些效应此前缺乏系统性定价分析。

Method: 整合三类模型：基于已部署Kinéis星座的完整SGP4轨道仿真、缓冲流模型、以及价值衰减框架（衰减常数源自应用文献中的运营决策窗口时间尺度，并以观测到的卫星影像市场价格为锚）。

Result: 极地与赤道终端由结构上不同的延迟分量主导，需要不同基础设施干预；形式化刻画了定价悬崖及其商业意义；推导出与残值假设完全独立的地理定价溢价。卫星数从1增至25时，极地-赤道溢价降低25倍，超过n=10后收益递减；满星座规模下溢价低于峰值数据价值的1%，且在买家紧迫性全部合理范围内均低于1.5%。

Conclusion: 星座规模扩大可显著削弱地理定价溢价并缓解定价悬崖效应，但其边际收益递减；极地与赤道终端需差异化基础设施策略，所推导的地理溢价对残值假设不敏感，为LEO IoT回传定价提供了可操作的量化依据。

Abstract: IoT terminals served by LEO satellite constellations transmit data to passing satellites in discrete uplink windows. That data is delivered to buyers only when the satellite reaches a ground station. This store-and-forward structure makes the achievable price a discontinuous function of the delivery completeness threshold (a phenomenon we call a pricing cliff) and creates a geographic pricing asymmetry between polar and equatorial terminals that depends on constellation size. We present an integrated pricing model combining a full SGP4 orbital simulation of the deployed Kinéis constellation with a buffer flow model and a value decay framework with decay constants derived from operational decision-window timescales in the application literature and anchored to observed satellite imagery market prices. We show that polar and equatorial terminals are dominated by structurally different latency components requiring different infrastructure interventions, formally characterize the pricing cliff phenomenon and its commercial significance, and derive a geographic pricing premium that is exactly independent of the residual value assumption. Going from 1 to 25 satellites reduces the polar--equatorial premium by 25x, with diminishing returns beyond n=10; at full constellation size the premium falls below 1% of peak data value and remains below 1.5% across the full plausible range of buyer urgency.
